HUMAN RESOURCES GENERALIST

Department: Corporate Affairs – Human Resources

Reports To: Director, Human Resources

Employment Type: Full-Time

FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt

Location: Remote / Hybrid (TBD)

About ASI

Advanced Strategic Insight, Inc. (ASI) delivers mission-critical tactical and technical solutions to address our customers' most challenging and complex problem sets.

At ASI, we pride ourselves on anticipating future operational needs and delivering innovative solutions that enhance warfighter capabilities and decision advantage. Our success depends on attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional professionals who share our commitment to excellence, integrity, and mission success.

Position Summary

ASI is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Human Resources Generalist to support the company's growing workforce and HR operations.

Reporting directly to the Director of Human Resources, this position will serve as a key operational resource responsible for coordinating talent acquisition activities, administering employee benefits programs, and supporting compliance with federal, state, and local employment regulations, and perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Human Resources to support departmental operations, organizational priorities, and evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates sound judgment when handling confidential information, and can independently manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with leadership, employees, candidates, and external service providers.

Key Responsibilities

1. Talent Acquisition & Recruiting

  • Coordinate the full recruiting lifecycle, including job postings, candidate sourcing, applicant screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.
  • Partner with the HR Director, Division Vice Presidents, Team Leads, and hiring managers to understand staffing requirements and recruitment priorities.

2. Employee Benefits Administration

  • Support the day-to-day administration of ASI's employee benefits programs, including retirement and other employer-sponsored benefits.

3.Human Resources Compliance

  • Support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, regulations, and reporting requirements. Escalate potential compliance concerns, missing documentation, and regulatory risks to the HR Director.
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee personnel files, employment documentation, and required HR records.

4. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Support

  • Coordinate onboarding activities, including new-hire documentation, BambooHR task assignments, communications, and tracking completion of outstanding tasks with new hires, supervisors, and department leadership.
  • Assist with employee offboarding, including separation documentation, exit checklists, equipment return coordination, and benefits-related notifications; monitor and respond to employee inquiries on HR-related topics.
  • Develop and maintain HR procedures, checklists, templates, and resources while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, automate processes, and improve HR efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in human resources, recruiting coordination, benefits administration, or a related administrative HR function.
  • Working knowledge of HR processes, employee benefits administration, and general employment compliance requirements.
  • Experience using a Human Resources Information System (HRIS) or Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, accuracy, and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a distributed team.
  • Strong customer service skills and a professional approach to employee and candidate interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • SHRM-CP, PHR, aPHR, or other relevant HR certification.
  • Experience with BambooHR, including HRIS, ATS, onboarding, benefits, and reporting functions.
  • Experience supporting a federal government contractor or defense industry organization.
  • Familiarity with recruiting candidates for technical, engineering, military, and government contracting positions.
  • Experience supporting employees across multiple states.
  • Familiarity with 401(k) administration and employee benefits eligibility requirements.
  • Knowledge of federal contractor compliance requirements, including OFCCP-related obligations where applicable.
  • Experience with HR reporting, process improvement, and administrative workflow automation.

Additional Information

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. ASI reserves the right to modify job responsibilities based on organizational and operational needs.

Advanced Strategic Insight, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ASI is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Salary: $75,000 - $90,000

Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.

In Wilhelmsen Ship Management, our people don’t just hold jobs here. They make innovative ideas a reality and, in the process, shape the maritime industry. With a global network and a strong presence in ship management, we deliver services and solutions that support the safe, efficient, and sustainable operation of vessels worldwide. Through our iRute Travel Services, we help corporate and marine clients navigate their travel needs with technology-driven solutions and dedicated travel management expertise.


As a Client Success Manager in iRute Travel Services, you will drive client success by leading the onboarding, implementation, and adoption of corporate and marine travel management solutions. You will serve as a trusted partner to clients, ensuring they are equipped to effectively use travel booking platforms, technology solutions, and travel policies while delivering a seamless and efficient travel management experience.


Who you report to

You will report to the General Manager of iRute Travel, working closely with clients and internal teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of corporate and marine travel management services.


What you’ll do

You will play a key role in helping clients get the most out of iRute Travel’s technology and services to get the most value from their travel spend. You will lead client onboarding, drive user adoption, and build strong relationships with stakeholders to deliver an excellent travel management experience.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the end-to-end onboarding and implementation of travel management technologies and services for corporate and marine clients.
  • Develop and manage onboarding plans, project timelines, and implementation milestones.
  • Conduct training sessions for travel bookers, travellers, approvers, and client administrators on booking platforms, reporting tools, and service processes.
  • Guide clients on travel policy implementation, configuration, and compliance.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the onboarding and post-implementation journey.
  • Monitor client adoption, satisfaction, and travel programme performance, ensuring alignment with travel budgets and business objectives.
  • Manage client concerns and escalations, working closely with internal operations, technology, product, and service delivery teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve client experience, service delivery, and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare onboarding reports, track implementation outcomes, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

What you bring

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in corporate and/or marine travel, travel management, client services, or account management.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate travel operations, booking processes, and travel policy management.
  • Experience managing client onboarding, implementation projects, or user training programmes.
  • Proficiency in travel management technologies and online booking tools.
  • Strong stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

What we’re looking for

  • A strong relationship builder who can establish trust and credibility with clients and stakeholders.
  • A customer-focused professional with a passion for service excellence and client success.
  • Someone who is confident in leading training sessions, facilitating discussions, and managing implementation projects.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can manage client concerns and drive solutions across different teams.
  • A structured and organised individual who can manage multiple priorities and deliver successful client outcomes.
  • A collaborative team player with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to adapt to a changing business environment.

Join Wilhelmsen and be part of a team that is shaping the future of corporate and marine travel management.

raw.excerpt: At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success.
raw.description:
At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success. Our people are down to earth, trail blazin’ folks who value innovation.

While mostly virtual, we collaborate closely to produce leading-edge software solutions much needed in the restaurant industry.

Our technology team is a rapidly growing group of talented and experienced engineers building the leading enterprise software company focused on restaurant technology. We use modern technologies, automation, and AI-assisted engineering practices to build products that power restaurant operations at scale.

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who is strong in both manual and automated testing, across backend APIs and frontend UIs. You'll test end-to-end flows that cross several Qu products, such as an order that starts in POS or web ordering and ends on the kitchen display. You'll make sure every case is tested at the right level, from API checks to end-to-end and manual tests.

You'll work inside QuDLC, Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle. AI agents refine each story, propose its test cases, and write the tests before the code; people decide at review gates, on evidence. As the team's quality engineer, you own two of those gates: you approve the test cases before development starts, and you sign off the story when the test results are in.

What You'll Do Here

  • Review the test cases AI agents propose from each story's acceptance criteria: tighten vague steps, add missing negative and edge cases, and approve them in AIO Tests.
  • Review each story's test plan before development starts: the right test level for every case (unit, API, end-to-end or manual), and which existing tests to reuse, update or retire.
  • Review, debug and fix the backend API and frontend UI tests that agents write in TypeScript and Playwright. Keep the shared fixtures, page objects and API clients healthy, and the smoke suite focused on critical paths.
  • Run exploratory testing and the cases that stay manual, then sign off each story using the pipeline's results: smoke tests, the story's own tests and the AIO Tests run.
  • Test end-to-end flows across services, such as POS, web ordering, the in-store server and the kitchen display, including scheduled and multi-channel orders.
  • Investigate failing, flaky and blocked tests: read the pipeline's diagnosis, separate environment, test data and product issues, and fix the test plan or cases when they are the cause.
  • Give feedback that improves how the AI agents write test cases and tests.
  • Answer testing questions during story refinement, and partner with developers and product managers on release validation.

Experience We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in QA or Quality Engineering, with hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
  • Strong test design and exploratory testing: turning acceptance criteria into clear test cases, finding edge and negative cases, and writing defect reports with precise repro steps.
  • Knowledge of test levels (unit, integration, API, end-to-end) and when to use each.
  • Hands-on UI and API automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including the Page Object Model, REST APIs and JSON payloads.
  • Programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, or in another language such as Java or Python with readiness to work in TypeScript; strong enough to review and fix test code you didn't write.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (ideally Azure DevOps), Git and pull request reviews, and with debugging flaky tests and environment issues.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing AI-generated test cases, tests or code, and deciding on evidence whether to trust them.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Bonus Experience

  • Experience with agentic development tools such as Kiro, or with AI-first delivery workflows where agents generate tests and code.
  • Experience with test-first development (TDD), where tests fail before the code exists and pass after.
  • Experience with restaurant technology, POS, kitchen display systems or online ordering.
  • Experience testing systems where on-premise components sync with cloud services.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools such as AIO Tests or TestRail.
  • PowerShell or other scripting to set up Windows test environments.
  • Experience with code-quality tooling: ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks.

Technology Environment

  • TypeScript / Node.js
  • Playwright (UI and API tests)
  • REST API testing
  • Azure DevOps (Repos and Pipelines)
  • Git
  • Jira
  • AIO Tests (test case management)
  • ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks
  • PowerShell (Windows test setup)
  • QuDLC (Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle): Kiro agents in Azure Pipelines, human review gates, and an AI pull request reviewer

The Type of Team Player We Need

  • Proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Passion for quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical thinker and creative problem-solver.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
  • Curious about AI-assisted software development, and careful to verify what AI produces.
  • Team-oriented professional who enjoys partnering across Engineering, Product, and QA disciplines.

Role Title: Senior Metallurgist / Welding Inspector
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (US-based preferred)

Job Summary

We are looking for experienced Senior Metallurgists and Welding Inspectors to support a project in advanced manufacturing and materials engineering. You’ll apply your expertise to evaluate materials, welds, coatings, and additive manufacturing components for AI training. AI experience is not required.

Scope of Work

  • Evaluate metallographic microstructures for material acceptance and compliance.

  • Review heat treatment processes according to AMS 2750, ASTM E112, and related standards.

  • Assess weld quality through macro etch evaluation and CWI acceptance criteria.

  • Conduct coating inspections based on NACE/AMPP and SSPC standards.

  • Review and disposition LPBF additive manufacturing defects.

  • Provide clear documentation and technical reasoning for accept/reject decisions.

  • Apply relevant ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience evaluating micrographs, welds, coatings, or additive manufacturing components.

  • Strong knowledge of ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC standards.

  • Current or previous AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification or equivalent.

  • Experience in metallography, heat treatment, welding inspection, and coating assessment.

  • Knowledge of additive manufacturing, particularly laser powder bed fusion (LPBF).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and technical decision-making abilities.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Required Skills

  • Metallographic Microstructure Evaluation

  • Heat Treatment Acceptance (AMS 2750, ASTM E112)

  • Weld Macro Etch & CWI Acceptance

  • Coating Inspection (NACE/AMPP, SSPC)

  • Additive Manufacturing (LPBF) Defect Disposition

raw.description:
Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Italy

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Italy. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

raw.description:
Octus

Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Since 2013, tens of thousands of professionals across hedge fund, investment banking, management consulting, and law firm verticals have come to rely on Octus to make better, faster, and more confident decisions in pace with the fast-moving credit markets.
For more information, visit:

Working at Octus

Octus hires growth-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Our core values – Action Oriented, Customer First Mindset, Effective Team Players, and Driven to Excel – define an organizational ethos that’s as high-performing as it is human. Among other perks, Octus employees enjoy competitive health benefits, matched 401k and pension plans, PTO, generous parental leave, gym subsidies, educational reimbursements for career development, recognition programs, and much more.

Role

We're hiring a hands-on Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to own the security technology that protects Octus employees, endpoints, and enterprise systems. You'll keep our security stack healthy and well tuned, and you'll harden the security settings in the business systems people use every day.

Our security team is small, so this role is broad. Your main focus is IT and enterprise security. You'll also work on cloud security, application security, incident response, vendor risk, and audits. Anyone who joins gets real exposure across the whole program.

You'll also help us secure AI tools. Octus uses AI heavily, and we want someone who can make tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT safe to use at scale.

Responsibilities

Primary focus: IT and enterprise security

  • Own the care and feeding of our security tools. Tune policies, manage upgrades, fix integrations, and retire what we no longer need.
  • Manage endpoint security across Mac and Windows with Microsoft Defender, Intune, and Jamf Pro.
  • Manage Netskope policies for web, SaaS, and data loss prevention.
  • Harden identity in Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. This covers SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and admin access reviews.
  • Set and enforce security configuration in enterprise systems like Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other SaaS apps.
  • Manage email security with Abnormal Security and Google Workspace controls.
  • Support secrets and credential management in 1Password.
  • Harden AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT. Configure admin settings, connector and MCP controls, audit logging, and data protections.

Also in scope: the broader program

  • Build and tune detections in Google SecOps with our managed SOC partner.
  • Respond to incidents and lead post-incident reviews. Join the team on-call rotation. Calls are rare.
  • Track and drive remediation of cloud and code findings from Wiz and Snyk.
  • Partner with Engineering on AWS security and secure development practices.
  • Automate security work with Python, APIs, and workflow tools.
  • Collect evidence for SOC 2 and support client security reviews.
  • Assess security risk in new vendors and tools.
  • Mentor teammates and share what you learn across Technology.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in cybersecurity or security-focused IT engineering.
  • Hands-on experience running EDR and MDM tools across Mac and Windows fleets.
  • Strong working knowledge of identity platforms like Okta or Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, and conditional access.
  • Experience hardening SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.
  • Experience with SSE or secure web gateway tools, and with DLP.
  • Experience tuning a SIEM and responding to security incidents.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR, and how technical controls support them.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell. Comfort working with REST APIs.
  • Clear writing and speaking with both technical and non-technical people.
  • Comfort working across many areas at once on a small team.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with our stack, including Okta, Microsoft Defender, Intune, Jamf Pro, Netskope, Google SecOps, or Wiz.
  • Experience hardening enterprise AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT, including MCP servers and connectors.
  • Experience building security automation or workflows that cut manual work.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, Security+, or a cloud security cert.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Octus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse work environment where all individuals are valued, respected, and treated fairly. We believe that diversity enriches our workplace and enhances our ability to innovate and succeed.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Fullstack Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
Transportation Electrification Consultant

Location: US Remote

Preferred Location: VA, DC, NY, or MA


Ready to make a difference?

ICF is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative Transportation Electrification Consultant to join our Transportation Electrification Team. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to research, design, implement, and support transportation electrification programs and advisory engagements for utilities, government agencies, and other clients.


Transportation electrification initiatives support the adoption of electric vehicles across passenger, commercial, and fleet applications, as well as the deployment of electric vehicle charging infrastructure. ICF’s work includes utility program and regulatory support, market and policy research, program design and implementation, customer and stakeholder engagement, data analysis, and technical assistance.


As a consultant, you will contribute to client-facing advisory and implementation projects, develop research and analysis, prepare high-quality deliverables, and help clients navigate the evolving transportation electrification market. You will work directly with clients and internal subject-matter experts to advance practical strategies that support transportation electrification, decarbonization, and emissions reductions.


Why you will love working here

  • Our purpose: Build a more prosperous and resilient world for all.
  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements and work-life balance.
  • Investment in the community: Donation matching and volunteer opportunities.
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, professional development resources, 401(k) matching, and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
  • Professional growth: Bring your interests and experience while developing new analytical, consulting, and subject-matter expertise.
  • Employee community networks: Connect with colleagues who share or support common characteristics, interests, and goals.

What you will be doing:

  • Support transportation electrification advisory, program implementation, and operational engagements for utilities, government agencies, and other clients.
  • Conduct research and analysis related to electric vehicles, charging infrastructure, utility programs, managed charging, load management, regulatory proceedings, market trends, and emerging transportation electrification policies and technologies.
  • Translate research, program data, and technical information into clear findings and actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Contribute to the design and evaluation of transportation electrification programs, strategies, processes, and customer offerings.
  • Develop client-ready reports, memoranda, presentations, newsletters, webinar materials, case studies, and other written deliverables.
  • Support regulatory and policy analysis, including reviewing filings, proceedings, program requirements, stakeholder comments, and related materials.
  • Perform data collection, cleaning, validation, analysis, and interpretation using Microsoft Excel and other project tools.
  • Support program implementation and operations, including reviewing applications or program records, tracking customer or stakeholder activity, conducting quality assurance and quality control, and maintaining project documentation.
  • Participate in client meetings and stakeholder discussions by preparing agendas and presentation materials, presenting findings, documenting decisions and action items, and coordinating follow-up activities.
  • Respond to client, customer, contractor, and stakeholder questions in coordination with project leadership and subject-matter experts.
  • Coordinate across internal teams to support project schedules, workplans, deliverables, and recurring client communications.
  • Engage with utilities, government agencies, contractors, technology providers, trade allies, and other transportation and energy industry representatives.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen project processes, increase efficiency, improve data quality, and enhance the client and customer experience.
  • Build and maintain knowledge of the transportation electrification, utility, energy, and decarbonization sectors.

What we need you to have: Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental studies, energy, engineering, economics, business, public policy, transportation, data analytics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of relevant professional experience in consulting, research, program implementation, project coordination, client engagement, data analysis, energy, transportation, sustainability, public policy, or a related area. (A Master’s degree may substitute for up to one year of required experience)
  • Experience conducting research and analysis and communicating findings through written deliverables or presentations.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Excel.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Ability to travel occasionally, as required by project and client needs.

What we would like you to have:

  • Knowledge of or experience in the transportation electrification, electric utility, energy, sustainability, or decarbonization sectors.
  • Experience supporting consulting or advisory engagements for utilities, government agencies, or other public- or private-sector clients.
  • Familiarity with electric vehicles, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, managed charging, utility programs, electricity rates, regulatory proceedings, or transportation and energy policy.
  • Experience collecting, reviewing, cleaning, analyzing, or visualizing quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills or experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Query, customer relationship management systems, program databases, or other analytics and reporting platforms.

Professional skills you will use

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain research, data, and technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to develop clear, concise, and client-ready written materials and presentations.
  • Confidence participating in client meetings, presenting findings, and communicating with external stakeholders.
  • Ability to prioritize and balance multiple assignments while meeting project deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, seek direction when needed, and contribute effectively as part of a team.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues across disciplines and levels of seniority.
  • Strong organizational, project coordination, and follow-through skills.
  • Flexibility and willingness to learn in a rapidly evolving industry.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. 


Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.


Bot and Third-Party Applications

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. 


However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at . We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.  


Pay Range

There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position.


The pay range for this position based on full-time employment is:

$67,355.00 - $114,503.00Nationwide Remote Office (US99)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for Journalists/Writers to support a project focused on evaluating AI-generated content. You will apply your expertise in writing, editing, journalism, and fact-checking to assess the quality, accuracy, clarity, and relevance of AI-generated responses.

No prior AI experience is required.

  • University degree from an institution in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Professional experience as a journalist, reporter, editor, copy editor, sub-editor, fact-checker, ghostwriter, or published author.
  • Strong skills in technical writing, editing, critical analysis, and content evaluation.
  • Experience fact-checking or editing content according to editorial or style guidelines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AI evaluation or annotation projects.
  • Familiarity with digital content review platforms.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated or machine-generated content.
  • Strong research, fact-checking, and analytical abilities.

raw.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Bridge Specialty Group is seeking an Analyst, Brokerage Placement

to join our growing team.


This position is on the Personal Lines Retention/Service Team within LocalEdge. This team within LocalEdge acts as Managing General Agent (MGA) to multiple carriers, with underwriting/binding authority. The Personal Lines Brokerage Placement Analyst is responsible for evaluating and processing insurance renewal applications by assessing risk, determining appropriate underwriting actions, ensuring compliance with quality standards, collaborating with brokers, and continuously seeking opportunities for process improvement and market optimization.

 

How You Will Contribute:     

  • Assess risk, determine appropriate coverage and pricing, and determine renewal underwriting actions for personal lines insurance policies across multiple lines of business including home, auto, inland marine, umbrella, & other lines.
  • Develop and implement strategies to retain existing clients, including conducting policy reviews, identifying coverage gaps, and offering tailored solutions.
  • Maintains knowledge of all markets available to maximize opportunities to negotiate placements.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by addressing client inquiries via email or phone, resolving issues, and ensuring positive client experience.
  • Analyze client information and assess risk factors to make informed underwriting decisions (including accepting or declining risks based on own analysis of options).
  • Ensure all underwriting activities comply with Quality Control guidelines, company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.
  • Perform additional job functions/responsibilities as assigned.

Skills & Experience to be Successful: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Insurance, or a related field. Related industry experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Property & Casualty License and Surplus Lines License in resident state required within 45 days of start date.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in personal lines underwriting or a related role within the insurance industry.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills, excellent communication (including exceptional telephone demeanor) and interpersonal skills, and proficiency in insurance knowledge.
  • Detail-oriented, customer-focused, proactive, and able to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred:

  • Relevant insurance certifications (e.g., CPCU, AINS) and/or prior Surplus Lines Industry experience preferred.

Physical Requirements Necessary on a Regular Basis:

  • Manual dexterity, arm and upper body range of motion sufficient for use of a keyboard, mouse and telephone 7-8 hours per day.
  • Speech and hearing sufficient for in-person and telephone communication 7-8 hours per day.
  • Vision sufficient for use of a computer monitor.
  • Ability to sit at a desk 7-8 hours per day.

 

About Us:   

Bridge Specialty Group creates a seamless way to connect the varying needs of our retail partners with the market clout and talents of our wholesale entities. Our more than 25 niche-focused brands reflect our deep experience and specialization in construction, general casualty, environmental liability, professional liability, health care, public entity, workers’ comp, property and personal lines.With more than 50 locations and more than 2,000 team members throughout the United States and Europe, Bridge has access to more than 200 standard and excess & surplus lines carriers that support our $7+ billion premium book.Our focus is on bringing the power of collective size and specialty to the wholesale brokerage marketplace. Bridge Specialty Group – aligning risk with greater reach. 

Pay Range

$45,000 - $55,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.


Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement

Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

The Power To Be Yourself

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment comprised of people from all backgrounds, with a variety of experiences and perspectives, guided by our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) motto, “The Power to Be Yourself”.

raw.description:
About the Role

As a Seasonal Lead Virtual Tax Professional, you will lead a remote team of Virtual Tax Professionals and play a key role in delivering accurate tax outcomes, a consistent client experience, and strong team performance. You will do this through virtual leadership, technical expertise, and ongoing coaching. This role combines people leadership with hands-on tax guidance and quality oversight in a fully virtual environment.

Day to Day you'll:

  • Recruit, interview, and hire seasonal Virtual Tax Professionals to meet business needs
  • Deliver training on tax policies, transcript analysis, virtual platforms, and workflow systems
  • Create, manage, and adjust team schedules to support coverage and performance goals
  • Monitor attendance, productivity, and compliance with virtual work expectations
  • Review performance metrics and provide timely coaching and feedback
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive virtual work environment
  • Provide technical tax support and guidance on complex tax scenarios
  • Ensure adherence to Internal Revenue Service requirements and company compliance standards
  • Support client escalations and virtual service delivery as needed

Required Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

Work Experience:

  • Ability to lead, motivate, and coach remote teams effectively
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Experience serving clients in a virtual or remote environment
  • Flexibility to work extended or varied hours during the seasonal period
  • Internet speed of at least 15 Mbps
  • Supervisory or people leadership experience
  • 3 years of experience in tax preparation and/or tax research

Preferred Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent through a combination of education and related work experience.

Work Experience:

  • Circular 230 credential (attorney, EA or CPA)
  • Experience leading remote teams
  • Experience Artifical Intelligence or other digitial productivity tools
  • Prior Team Lead experience

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.
Pay Range Information

The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.
Pay Range

$25.10 - $37.64/Hr.

Job Description: Systems Architect / Chief Systems Architect

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – US-Based Preferred (Worldwide Candidates with Relevant Experience Considered)

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Systems Architects or Chief Systems Architects to support an AI training project focused on complex engineering workflows. You will leverage your expertise in system architecture and multidisciplinary engineering leadership to design realistic technical tasks, coordinate domain experts, and establish clear architectural objectives and evaluation criteria. Your contributions will help improve AI systems' understanding of architecture, interfaces, dependencies, and engineering trade-offs.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design realistic engineering projects requiring architectural decisions across mechanical, electrical, hardware, software, and manufacturing disciplines.
  2. Define system architectures, including system boundaries, subsystem responsibilities, interfaces, and technical constraints.
  3. Break complex architectural challenges into structured tasks with clear inputs, deliverables, dependencies, and responsibilities.
  4. Coordinate contributions from multidisciplinary engineering experts.
  5. Establish technical objectives and evaluation criteria for assessing architectural decisions and solutions.

Required Qualifications

  1. Substantial experience as a Systems Architect, Chief Systems Architect, or in a comparable technical leadership role.
  2. Proven experience designing complex engineer

raw.title: Relationship Manager
raw.excerpt: Company Overview:GovSpend provides data and analytics to organizations buying and selling in the public sector.
raw.description:
Company Overview:

GovSpend provides data and analytics to organizations buying and selling in the public sector. With transparency and accountability at the center of what we do, we strive to place critical market intelligence into the hands of our customers so they can win more government business.

Our Mission:

At GovSpend, our vision is to be the indispensable system of action that powers how organizations discover, pursue, and win opportunities in the public sector marketplace.

Through our cutting-edge technology and platform, we harvest the data and produce the insights that enable our clients to make data-driven decisions and thrive in the dynamic landscape of government procurement. Together, we shape a more efficient, informed, and impactful public sector ecosystem.

Position Summary:

The Relationship Manager serves as the primary point of contact and sales enabler, driving revenue for a book of GovSpend’s largest customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Responsible for account planning to ensure proactive customer outreach and training with the goal of increasing users and usage.
  • Act as the customer point of contact, ensuring clear and consistent communication across inbound service activities, upsells into the account and outbound customer outreach.
  • Serve as the main negotiator for commercial terms with customers on contract issues, renewal pricing and past due payments in addition to being proactive with renewals.
  • Manage and coordinate the processing, communication, and implementation of all customer changes, including performing modifications on searches per customer requests.
  • Maintain awareness of all service matters including, troubleshooting, screen sharing, support sessions, and any other solution needed.
  • Coordinate service activities with GovSpend’s internal teams to ensure all customer needs and expectations are met.
  • Adhere to customer needs and expectations, by interfacing between sales and the customer to build a strategy for success during a customer’s subscription period.
  • Ensure compliance levels are met in accordance with all maintenance contracted service level agreements.
  • Maintain a high level of awareness of service issues affecting GovSpend’s product environment including proactive problem avoidance, behavior, and maintenance practices.
  • Identify, facilitate, and ensure effective communication of all technical queries and problem resolution from the customer.
  • Escalate appropriate retention efforts to their manager.
  • Participate in Root Cause Analysis including incident and problem management activities.
  • Ensure that GovSpend’s best practices and methodologies are adhered to on a consistent basis.
  • Other job duties as assigned to meet the business needs.

Security Responsibilities:

  • Follow GovSpend's Information Security Policy and Acceptable Use Policy, and acknowledge the Acceptable Use Policy before receiving system access.
  • Complete security awareness training at hire and on an ongoing basis.
  • Use only the access needed for the job. Never share passwords or accounts, and use multi-factor authentication (MFA).
  • Use only the company-issued laptop for GovSpend work, with encryption and automatic screen lock turned on.
  • Do not send company data to personal email or store it in personal cloud storage.
  • Connect to the company VPN before accessing GovSpend systems on public Wi-Fi.
  • Report suspected security incidents, phishing, or a lost or stolen device right away to DevSecOps or the ISMS Lead. Lost or stolen devices are also reported to IT.
  • Get ISMS Lead review before adopting a new tool or vendor that will access or store GovSpend data.
  • Oversee the vendor day to day and raise security concerns to the ISMS Lead.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related area. Proven work experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
  • 3+ years of sales or relationship management experience driving customer-related strategy, preferably in a SaaS or information services business.
  • Background in customer success, operations, customer engagement, satisfaction, and retention with a proven track record of success negotiating agreements and driving increased retention rates.
  • Background in customer training and support and ability to provide training independently.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing technology products for use by external customers.
  • Highly data-driven mindset and passion for analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive customer renewals and customer success.
  • Ability to define new models and processes from the ground up and operate at scale.
  • Ability to make effective decisions.

raw.description:
We are looking for an Operations Research Engineer to join the Workforce Management (WFM) product stream and help build the optimization capabilities behind workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource allocation for a large-scale contact center environment.
The role focuses on applying operations research, mathematical optimization, and algorithm design to solve complex workforce planning problems at enterprise scale. You will work closely with Product, Workforce Management experts, Architects, and Engineering teams to transform business requirements into optimization models and production-grade optimization services that support scheduling, staffing, coverage management, and operational efficiency.
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong expertise in optimization, constraint programming, mathematics, and software engineering who enjoys solving real-world planning and resource allocation challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop optimization models for contact center workforce planning, scheduling and resource allocation.
  • Design and implement the schedule optimization engine using OR-Tools/CP-SAT.
  • Own the constraint model end to end: formalize business rule into a solvable, maintainable model.
    Build the production-grade solver as a service within the WFM platform that meets latency targets for real forecast group volumes.
  • Define and validate schedule quality metrics (coverage attainment, constraint violations, solve time, solution stability across re-solves) and instrument the service so quality can be monitored in production.
  • Build and execute tests and validation of optimization algorithms to deliver performance, scalability, and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to integrate optimization models into an enterprise-grade optimization engine of the workforce management platform.
  • Partner with workforce-planning and real-time-analyst stakeholders to validate that generated schedules are operationally usable.
  • Effectively communicate and present findings, methodologies, and results to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • 6+ years of professional experience designing and implementing optimization solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with OR-Tools (CP-SAT), or a comparable constraint-programming / mixed-integer-programming solver.
  • Strong foundation in linear programming, integer programming, or stochastic optimization.
  • Direct experience modeling and solving workforce or resource scheduling problems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and solving large scale optimization problems.
    Proficiency in Java, Python, or C++.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into mathematical models and optimization objectives.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to build production-ready services and validation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of WFM domain.
  • Experience building optimization solutions for workforce planning, scheduling, logistics, transportation, or resource allocation.
  • Knowledge of forecasting and decision-support systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

Deputy Chief Data Officer (Deputy CDO)
Cyprus / Worldwide – Remote (Any Location) · Full-Time · Research Center

Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer for the Research Center of the Core Business Unit — the #2 role in a data function that directly drives company P&L.

We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results.

Your main tasks will be:

  • Lead part of the Research Center’s strategic initiatives end-to-end — from business case and prioritization to delivery and measurable impact.
  • Work directly with C-level executives and business heads: align priorities, commitments and trade-offs, negotiate resources and timelines with clear, numbers-based arguments.
  • Own the execution of key cross-functional initiatives across the Research Center: data platform and BigQuery migration, ML projects with complex dependencies, experimentation process, AI for analytics, UX research, data quality / SLA / freshness.
  • Unblock stalled projects: when work is stuck between teams or has no clear owner, define scope, owners, next steps and blockers, escalate early and drive it to delivery.
  • Manage resources and backlog across teams: prioritize by business value, allocate capacity, manage dependencies between ML, backend, product and analytics, stop or rethink initiatives that don’t deliver.
  • Build and run the operating system of the function: monthly reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retros, commitment tracking, escalation process and a single status dashboard — working with or without any single person.
  • Measure everything in business terms: translate initiatives into numbers, benefits and expected impact; track ROI and results against plan; make sure “we shipped the task” is never mistaken for “the business changed”.
  • Strengthen the team leads (Product Analytics, Data Engineering, ML, UX Research): help them set goals, prioritize, give honest feedback and grow as managers.
  • Own the operational health of the function: data freshness, platform uptime, ML platform stability, delivery predictability and experimentation throughput.

We expect from you:

  • 7+ years in data, analytics or ML in product tech companies, including 4+ years in leadership roles managing strong specialists and team leads.
  • Experience as a CDO, Deputy CDO or Head of Data / Analytics in a mid-size or large product organization is highly desirable.
  • Readiness and ambition to grow into the CDO role: strategic thinking combined with the willingness to own day-to-day execution.
  • A broad understanding of all Research Center domains: product and marketing analytics, A/B testing and experimentation, the ML lifecycle from idea to production, data platforms, data quality and SLA, BI / self-service, unit economics. Hands-on depth in at least one of them.
  • Proven track record of execution: concrete examples of delivering complex cross-functional data / ML projects to measurable results.
  • Strong operational management skills: project decomposition, planning, resource and backlog management, risk management, clean escalation, running many parallel initiatives.
  • Business leader mindset: thinks in numbers, benefits and business impact; understands trade-offs between speed, quality, value and risk; always asks “what changed for the business?”.
  • Experience working with and negotiating with C-level executives: confident, precise with numbers, persuasive through facts.
  • Influence without formal authority: earns trust through competence and results; able to push hard and handle conflict without becoming toxic.
  • Systematic, disciplined and persistent; comfortable with ambiguity and multitasking.
  • Fluent Russian and English are a must.

What do we offer:

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full time;
  • The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
  • Compensation of kindergarten or school fees for your child;
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
  • 50% payment for professional training, international conferences and meetings;
  • Corporate discount for English language lessons;
  • Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);
  • Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;
  • Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for merch, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!
