raw.description:
THE ROLE: Vice President Sales & Partnerships Insights

LOCATION: Remote

DEPARTMENT: Legends Global Insights

REPORTS TO: Insights Leadership

ABOUT LEGENDS GLOBAL

Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated suite of premium services through a white-label model that keeps our partners front and center — from feasibility and project development to sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and world-class content and booking.

With a global network of more than 450 venues, hosting 20,000 events and welcoming 165 million guests annually, Legends Global brings unmatched scale, expertise, and connectivity to help our partners grow. The Legends Global Way guides how we operate: Align, Scale, Connect, Team, Win — shared success, repeatable systems, connected solutions, unstoppable teams, and wins that are earned every day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Vice President of Sales & Partnerships Insights will lead the insights and analytics function supporting Legends Global Sales and Global Partnerships, the teams responsible for sponsorship, premium, and ticket sales revenue across our client portfolio. This is a senior, highly visible role. You will be the analytics counterpart to our sales and partnership executives, to the venue leaders they serve, and to the clients whose revenue outcomes we are accountable for.

The role mirrors the model our Operational Insights leader has built on the Hospitality, Merchandise, and Venues side of the business. Where that function embedded analytics inside operations, you will do the same for the commercial side, standing up a consistent, scalable insights practice across a set of sales organizations that today operate with uneven data maturity. You will build the team, set the standards, and personally carry the most consequential executive conversations.

This leader will partner closely with our Central Insights function, which owns CRM, data science, AI, guest research, and other enterprise data capabilities, to ensure Consulting Insights draws on shared infrastructure and models rather than building in isolation. You will also work alongside our feasibility and consulting practice, which owns partnership valuation and market study work. The strength of this role is in the connective tissue: translating enterprise capability into commercial outcomes at the venue and client level.


WHAT YOU’LL DO (KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & OUTCOMES)

Executive Partnership & Influence

  • Serve as the primary insights partner to Global Sales and Global Partnerships executive leadership, translating commercial questions into analytical work and analytical work into decisions leaders will act on.
  • Build and own trusted relationships with venue leaders and property-level sales leadership, ensuring insights are adopted on the ground and not simply delivered from the center.
  • Represent the insights function in client-facing settings including pitches, renewals, annual business reviews, and property leadership meetings, with the credibility to be in the room when revenue decisions are made.
  • Set the agenda on what the business should be measuring rather than fulfilling requests as they arrive.

Partnership Sales Analytics

  • Own the reporting and measurement layer for partnership sales performance: pipeline, pacing, close rates, category coverage, and revenue against plan across the portfolio.
  • Build sponsor fulfillment and delivery analytics that show what a partner actually received, giving our sellers evidence to bring into renewal conversations.
  • Develop renewal risk, whitespace, and prospecting analytics that shape where partnership teams spend their time.
  • Standardize how partnership performance is defined and reported across properties so results are comparable, credible, and repeatable.
  • Partner with our feasibility and consulting practice on valuation and market study work, supplying the operating data and performance evidence their analysis depends on rather than duplicating it.

Ticketing & Premium Sales Analytics

  • Lead analytics supporting season, group, premium, and single-event ticket sales, including pricing strategy, demand and pacing forecasts, and inventory and yield management.
  • Partner with Central Insights to deploy lead scoring, propensity, churn, and retention models into the hands of sales teams through CRM, and drive adoption once they are there.
  • Build pipeline, productivity, and rep performance reporting that sales leaders use to manage their business week to week.
  • Support premium and new-build sales efforts with pricing, positioning, and take-rate analysis.

Team, Standards & Delivery

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a team of directors, managers, and embedded analysts supporting sales and partnership organizations across the portfolio.
  • Establish the operating model for the function: intake, prioritization, delivery standards, and the reporting layer every property can rely on.
  • Partner with Central Insights and enterprise data teams on data architecture, CRM data quality, model deployment, and AI-enabled tooling, ensuring the commercial side of the business has a clear and well-represented voice in enterprise roadmaps.
  • Bring thought leadership on emerging analytics, AI, and commercial measurement practices, and drive their adoption across the sales organization.

WHAT YOU BRING (QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE)

This is an analytics leadership role, not a sales role. We are looking for a leader whose depth is in analytics and insights, who has applied that depth to commercial problems and can hold their own with revenue executives.

  • 8+ years in analytics, insights, business intelligence, or quantitative consulting, including meaningful time interacting with senior organizational leadership
  • Demonstrated experience leading and scaling an analytics team, including managing director- or manager-level talent
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, live events, or venues is strongly preferred
  • Track record of building analytics that support revenue functions such as sponsorship, ticketing, premium, or media, and evidence that the work was adopted and changed decisions
  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in business analytics, statistics, economics, or a related field
  • Experience building an analytics function where one did not previously exist, or standardizing analytics across a decentralized portfolio, is a strong differentiator

Core Skills

  • Executive Communication - The ability to take a complex analysis and land it in three minutes with a leader who has no interest in the methodology
  • Fluency in commercial analytics: pricing, forecasting, pipeline and funnel measurement, segmentation, and performance measurement
  • Hands-on analytical capability. SQL, Excel, Python, R, and Tableau experience is useful, though we care less about any specific tool than about the judgment to know what question to ask and whether an answer holds up
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tooling such as Claude Code, and a point of view on how it changes what a small analytics team can deliver
  • Strong understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce) as both a data source and an adoption channel for analytics
  • Consultative stakeholder management. Able to develop, own, and expand relationships across internal leadership, venues, and clients

KEY LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

  • A builder's instinct. Comfort standing up a function, setting standards, and creating structure where none exists.
  • Commercial judgment over analytical purity, and the willingness to give a leader a directionally right answer today rather than a perfect one next month.
  • Credibility with sellers. This role does not work if the sales organization does not want you in the room.
  • A collaborative posture toward Central Insights, Operational Insights, our feasibility and consulting practice, and peer insights leaders. Leverage the enterprise, do not rebuild it.
  • Curiosity about how data drives revenue, partner value, and fan engagement in live sports and entertainment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Sales and partnership executives bring you into decisions early, on pricing, deal structure, and resourcing, rather than asking for a report after the fact.
  • A consistent measurement and reporting standard exists across properties, so partnership and ticketing performance can be compared and benchmarked portfolio-wide.
  • Sponsor renewals are supported by clear evidence of what was delivered and how it performed, and valuation work produced by our consulting practice is grounded in Legends operating data rather than external assumptions.
  • Models and tools built with Central Insights are adopted by sales teams in their daily workflow, with measurable impact on pipeline conversion and retention.
  • The function is staffed, developing talent, and no longer dependent on any single person, including you, to deliver.

COMPENSATION

Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, and a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, and 401k plan.

The salary range for this position is $225,000 - $245,000 (+ performance bonus)

At Legends Global, our people power every success. You’ll work alongside exceptional talent, learn from world-leading experts, and contribute to projects that set the standard across sports, entertainment, hospitality, and live experiences. If you’re driven to operate at the highest level, build with purpose, and help partners win on the biggest stages, you’ll thrive here.


Legends Global is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and encourages Women, Minorities, Individuals with Disabilities, and protected Veterans to apply. VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Position Overview

As a Customer Service & Support Manager, you will lead a team responsible for delivering exceptional client experiences while driving operational excellence across a complex, multi-channel service environment. This role serves as a strategic leader who influences customer care operations, enhances service delivery, and ensures business outcomes align with organizational objectives.
You will collaborate with partners across the enterprise to develop and execute service strategies, improve customer experiences, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires a leader who can balance strategic thinking with operational execution, use data to inform decisions, and inspire teams through change.
The ideal candidate is an innovative and intellectually curious leader who can navigate a large organization, build strong partnerships, influence outcomes, and create an environment where employees are engaged, empowered, and focused on delivering exceptional customer service.

•Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, innovation, and continuous improvement.

•Serve as a thought leader who identifies emerging opportunities and challenges and develops strategies to address them.

Leads and directs the overall client/client experience and outcomes in order to deliever consistently elevated performance outcomes. Delivers PNC's standard of service to clients and service partners.

Collaborates with key partners across the enterprise to enhance client experience outcomes. Responsible for the real time management to enhance the business, client, and employee outcomes for the organization.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

raw.description:
Vill du vara med och förändra vården?

Då vill vi prata med dig!

Om den digitala tjänsten

Hej! Jag heter Maria Lundqvist och är verksamhetschef på Kry Digital. Jag tror på en enkel sak: vården blir bättre när vi vågar göra den annorlunda. I vår digitala tjänst jobbar vi nära varandra med hjälp av våra digitala verktyg. Det är lika självklart att be om hjälp som att komma med en ny idé. Vi är ett psykologteam på 50 medarbetare som delar samma övertygelse – att hög tillgänglighet, ny teknik och ett genuint fokus på kvalitet och patientnöjdhet inte är motsatser. Det bevisar vi varje dag.

Varför Kry?
Vi har förändrat hur vård bedrivs i Sverige i över tio år. Gjort den digital, tillgänglig och mer jämlik. Men vi är inte klara och det är poängen.På Kry tror vi att det modigaste du kan göra i vårdbranschen är att vara snäll. Och att de som kan vården ska styra den. Hos oss får du mandat att göra det - ta det, be inte om det.

Vad du faktiskt gör

I arbetet som digital psykolog på Kry ingår behandling, triagering och handläggning. Du tar emot patienter på primärvårdsnivå via videomöten samt finns som stöd via chatt till IKBT patienter. Du har stöd i form av riktlinjer, behandlingsmaterial, kollegor online samt handledning. Du genomför digitala konsultationer via vår plattform och du gör det på ett sätt som får patienter att känna sig sedda. Du samarbetar nära vårdcentralerna och övriga vårdflöden. Vi tror inte att digital och fysisk vård är varandras motpoler. De är varandras förutsättningar. Dina erfarenheter är med och formar hur vi arbetar, idag och framåt. Det kallar vi Kry-modellen.Läs mer om den här.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

  • Du är legitimerad psykolog med KBT-inriktning.

  • Du besitter erfarenhet från arbete inom primärvård, psykiatri eller företagshälsovård.

  • Du tar ansvar och får saker gjorda.

  • Du trivs i förändring och ser det som kul.

  • Du levererar vård med hög kvalitet och sätter patienten först.

  • Du är flytande i både svenska och engelska.

Praktiskt

Start: Vintern 2026

Ersättning:Ackordsbaserad lön/ arvode

Omfattning: flexibel % ej fast
Arbetstid:Alla dagar i veckan mellan kl 07-22

Är du redo?
Skicka din ansökan senast 31/12 2026. Vid eventuella frågor, vänligen ämnesraden "Rekrytering psykolog".

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Ta hand om dig ❤

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

About the role


We’re looking for a Finance Administrator to join our new Connect to Work Tees Valley programme.


This is a varied role where you’ll provide essential finance and administrative support to help ensure the programme operates effectively, meets its contractual requirements and delivers positive employment outcomes for the people we support.


You’ll play an important role in managing financial information and claims, ensuring expenditure is accurately recorded and evidenced, while also working closely with colleagues, partners and external stakeholders.


As this is a new contract, you’ll have the opportunity to become involved in a wide range of tasks and help establish effective processes as the service develops.


What you’ll be doing


Your responsibilities will include:


  • Developing a strong understanding of the Connect to Work Grant Guidance and ensuring financial activity complies with programme requirements.
  • Preparing, monitoring and submitting Connect to Work financial claims.
  • Reviewing expenditure and supporting documentation to ensure claims are accurate, eligible and fully auditable.
  • Working closely with operational and finance colleagues to gather and verify information required for financial claims and audits.
  • Processing and reconciling financial transactions and payments accurately and efficiently.
  • Responding to and resolving payment queries, escalating potential risks where appropriate.
  • Supporting month-end processes in line with organisational requirements.
  • Ensuring financial controls, policies and procedures are followed.
  • Supporting meetings through tasks such as preparing agendas, gathering information and taking minutes.
  • Managing the Connect to Work shared mailbox, ensuring enquiries are dealt with promptly and appropriately.
  • Producing and distributing monthly newsletters for partner agencies.
  • Gathering information from operational, performance and partnership teams to support newsletter content.
  • Providing wider administrative and project support to the Connect to Work team as required.

About you


We’re looking for an organised and detail-focused individual who can manage financial and administrative responsibilities accurately and confidentially.


You’ll be comfortable working with a range of colleagues, partners and external stakeholders and will have strong communication and organisational skills.


You’ll be able to prioritise your workload in a busy environment, manage competing demands and ensure deadlines are met.


Experience in a customer care, healthcare, education or social care environment would be valuable, alongside previous clerical, administrative or reception experience.


While experience of the employability sector would be beneficial, we’re also open to candidates who can demonstrate strong transferable finance and administration skills.


What you’ll need


Essential:


  • Demonstrable clerical, administrative or reception experience.
  • Experience within a customer care, healthcare, education or social care setting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office packages, including Outlook, Word and Teams.
  • Effective interpersonal, organisational and communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, visitors, partners and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to work with discretion and sensitivity and maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage your workload within a busy environment.

Desirable:


  • NVQ Level 3 in Business Administration or equivalent qualification/related experience.
  • Driving licence and access to a vehicle.

raw.description:
Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.

Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.
But we don’t stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:

→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution
→ Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

  • FT1000 ranking: among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025

  • The Europas: featured in the list of 100 hottest startups

  • Pixalate Ranking: #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.

  • We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins.

  • We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.

  • We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding.

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

The mission

This is a pure supply-side business development role: you sell Sparteo’s CTV monetization to the owners of the screens and the apps, not to advertisers. As an independent contractor working closely with our CTV and Supply leadership in Europe, you will be the tip of the spear for Sparteo’s CTV supply in the US.

Your mission is to leverage your existing network to open doors at CTV OEMs and leading CTV / FAST app publishers, sign long-term partnerships and grow the revenue they generate on our platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Development: Identify and approach smart TV manufacturers, streaming device makers and top CTV / FAST app publishers in the US. Pitch Sparteo’s CTV monetization stack and its value against their current setup.

  • Deal Execution: Lead commercial negotiations and close partnership agreements, working with our legal and business teams in Europe.

  • Partner Launch: Coordinate onboarding with our integration and account management teams (VAST, app-ads.txt, ad pods) and follow the first months of performance until the partnership scales.

  • Account Growth: Act as the primary US point of contact for your partners, monitor revenue and fill, and drive expansion (new apps, new formats, new markets).

  • Market Feedback: Provide on-the-ground intelligence to Sparteo’s leadership on US CTV market dynamics, pricing expectations and competitor movements.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in business development or partnerships in AdTech or digital media, including at least 2-3 years focused on CTV in the US market.

  • The Network: Active, warm relationships with decision-makers at CTV OEMs (Samsung, LG, Vizio, Roku, TCL...) and / or CTV and FAST app publishers with scale. You can secure a meeting with a Head of Monetization or a VP Partnerships next week.

  • CTV Expertise: Solid understanding of the CTV monetization ecosystem: SSPs and DSPs, SSAI, VAST, ad pods, app-ads.txt and supply chain transparency.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: A self-starter comfortable working autonomously as an independent contractor, with a team based in Europe.

  • AI-native Reflex: A strategic thinker, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints. You don’t just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision.

Your mindset to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like “Yes, but we’ve been doing it this way for years...” make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You’re looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Why work with us

  • 🌍 Fully remote: You work from anywhere in the US, in close collaboration with our CTV and Supply leadership in Europe.

  • 🚀 High-impact mission: You open the US CTV market for a fast-growing, independent ad tech group.

  • 🤝 Strong support: You work hand in hand with our integration, account management and legal teams to launch and scale your partnerships.

  • 📈 Rapid growth: You join a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and the US.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to work with Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and start the process!

Here are the stages in our recruitment process

  • Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  • Analytical and business logic tests

  • Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including the leaders you will work with

  • Taking up references

Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

Greystone Energy Systems manufactures sensors, transmitters and gas detection equipment for HVAC and building automation applications. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for developing the sales team, strengthening channel partnerships and expanding market share throughout the United States. The successful candidate will play a key role in executing growth initiatives, supporting major customer opportunities and delivering measurable business results.
This is a remote position in the USA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the US sales strategy and achieve revenue, gross margin and new customer growth objectives.

  • Establish territory and account priorities that focus resources on the most promising growth opportunities.

  • Participate directly in key customer opportunities, negotiations and business development activities.

  • Expand existing customer relationships and secure new business opportunities across the Greystone, QEL and AMC product portfolios.

Channel and Strategic Account Development

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with distributors, manufacturers' representatives, controls contractors, system integrators and OEM partners.

  • Build strong relationships with strategic accounts and identify opportunities to expand business across multiple customer locations.

  • Collaborate with priority channel partners to develop growth plans, monitor results and overcome barriers to success.

  • Identify market coverage gaps and establish new channel relationships to improve customer access and support.

  • Resolve channel conflicts and coordinate account responsibilities to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Market Development and Sales Coordination

  • Generate demand through engagement with consulting engineers, contractors and end users, involving technical resources as required.

  • Support business development initiatives within priority markets, including indoor air quality, gas detection and data center applications.

  • Represent Greystone at customer meetings, trade shows and industry events.

  • Collaborate with inside sales, technical support and operations teams to ensure exceptional customer service and successful project execution.

  • Utilize CRM tools and sales analytics to guide decision-making, monitor performance and manage expenses effectively.

Education Training and Experience

  • Demonstrated success delivering profitable B2B sales growth in HVAC controls, building automation, sensors, gas detection or related technical industries.

  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams across multiple geographic regions.

  • Strong knowledge of US sales channels and experience building successful distributor, representative and strategic account relationships.

  • Excellent commercial acumen with experience in pricing, negotiations, sales forecasting and pipeline management.

  • Ability to understand technical products and communicate their value effectively to customers and partners.

  • Postsecondary education in business, engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

The ideal candidate is a results-oriented leader who sets clear priorities, develops strong teams and follows through on commitments. You are an effective communicator who can translate technical and commercial concepts into customer value. You build trusted relationships, work collaboratively across functions and are comfortable leading a remote team while maintaining a strong focus on growth and accountability.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Achievement of revenue and gross margin objectives.

  • Growth in new customer acquisition and strategic account penetration.

  • Expansion and effectiveness of channel partnerships.

  • Improved forecasting accuracy and pipeline management.

  • Development and engagement of a high-performing sales team.

  • Consistent delivery of customer-focused business results.

Travel and Working Conditions

This position is based remotely within the United States. Regular travel is required for customer meetings, partner engagement, team coaching, industry events and occasional visits to our corporate headquarters in Moncton, New Brunswick, Canada. Compliance with customer and site-specific safety requirements is required during facility visits.

At Greystone Energy Systems, we believe that diversity drives business success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates differences and promotes equity. We welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, religions, abilities, and sexual orientations. We strongly encourage applications from women, minorities, and individuals with disabilities. Please advise if you require accommodation throughout the recruitment process.

Join us in building a diverse and inclusive team!

Only those who will be considered for the next step of the application process will be contacted.

Compensation and Benefits

At Greystone Energy Systems, compensation is determined based on several factors, including experience, qualifications, internal equity, and market competitiveness. This position is also eligible for comprehensive group benefits, bonus program, and retirement savings program.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Federal IT Specialists to contribute their technical expertise to a project focused on federal IT operations and AI training. In this role, you will help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems by assessing their understanding of federal IT processes, technical deliverables, and cybersecurity requirements. The engagement focuses on GS-2210 activities, incident response, information security compliance, and technical documentation. You will leverage your hands-on experience in hardware repair, network administration, and incident management to evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs based on realistic federal IT scenarios.

Scope of Work

  1. Review, analyze, and provide expert feedback on AI-generated content related to federal IT processes, including Authorization to Operate (ATO) packages, IT investment business cases, incident reports, and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs).
  2. Evaluate AI-generated troubleshooting approaches for complex hardware, software, network, and application incidents in realistic federal IT environments.
  3. Provide actionable insights and technical guidance to support the development of accurate AI training resources for federal IT operations.
  4. Evaluate and refine AI-generated technical documentation, system configurations, and security controls for accuracy and compliance.
  5. Support incident response simulations and use-case evaluations to improve AI model performance in identifying, analyzing, and addressing security incidents.
  6. Assess AI-generated outputs for alignment with federal cybersecurity, privacy, and information assurance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  1. Minimum of 5 years of experience in federal IT roles (GS-2210 or equivalent), with demonstrated expertise in hardware repair, network administration, and incident response.
  2. Proven experience implementing information security controls and maintaining compliance with federal frameworks, including FISMA and NIST standards.
  3. Strong technical expertise in diagnosing and troubleshooting diverse IT environments, including hardware, software, networks, and applications.
  4. Experience preparing, reviewing, or maintaining federal IT documentation, such as ATO packages, Privacy Impact Assessments, incident reports, and IT investment business cases.
  5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate technical solutions and identify gaps in system performance or security.
  6. Commitment to maintaining data integrity, information security, and privacy across all project activities and deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Familiarity with evaluating AI-generated technical content for accuracy, security compliance, and operational relevance.
  2. Experience supporting AI training, model evaluation, technical content validation, or data annotation projects.
  3. Experience participating in federal IT incident response exercises, cybersecurity assessments, or security control evaluations.
  4. Strong technical writing skills and the ability to communicate complex federal IT concepts clearly and accurately.

Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo Group is seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer II to join our Network Automation Software Engineering team. Our team develops and maintains the software platforms, microservices, and automation solutions that enable the provisioning, configuration, and management of Zayo's large-scale telecommunications network infrastructure.


In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions that automate complex network operations and improve the efficiency and reliability of network service delivery. You will work primarily in Python, developing microservices that communicate through gRPC APIs defined using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf), and leverage Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO) to automate network device configuration and service provisioning.


The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in software development, experience building and maintaining production applications, and is able to solve complex technical challenges. You will work across a broad range of teams to provide perspective on technical design and take ownership of software development tasks and features.


Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications and microservices supporting network automation and orchestration.
  • Develop and integrate gRPC-based services using Protocol Buffers to define APIs and service contracts.
  • Implement new features, enhancements, and integrations across software platforms.
  • Build reusable software components, libraries, and APIs that integrate with internal systems and network infrastructure.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code following SDLC best practices.
  • Troubleshoot software defects, investigate application issues, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute ideas for improving application architecture, performance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to develop solutions.

Network Automation & Orchestration

  • Develop and maintain automation solutions using Cisco NSO, including service packages, service models, and integrations with network devices.
  • Build software that interfaces with Cisco NSO APIs to support network configuration, provisioning, and service lifecycle operations.
  • Work with network engineering and operations teams to understand network requirements and translate them into automated workflows.
  • Develop and enhance automation that reduces manual configuration, minimizes errors, and accelerates service delivery.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving network automation workflows, system integrations, and device interactions.
  • Develop an understanding of Zayo’s network infrastructure, provisioning processes, and operational requirements.

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, application builds, and deployment.
  • Build, package, and deploy containerized applications using Docker, with services hosted through Docker Swarm.
  • Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining the reliability of production microservices.
  • Implement automated tests and participate in code reviews to ensure software quality.
  • Support continuous improvement of development workflows, deployment processes, and application reliability.
  • Work within established operational practices to identify and resolve production issues.

Collaboration & Professional Growth

  • Participate in an Agile development environment, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, code reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, network engineers, product stakeholders, and operations teams to deliver automation solutions.
  • Take ownership of assigned features and development tasks, delivering quality solutions with appropriate testing and documentation.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute constructive feedback.
  • Work with senior engineers to improve technical skills, learn new technologies, and develop a deeper understanding of the team’s systems and architecture.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, technical documentation, and ongoing improvements to software quality and maintainability.
  • Communicate technical progress, challenges, and potential solutions clearly to team members and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, including experience developing, testing, and maintaining production applications.
  • Proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, common Python libraries, and software development best practices.
  • Experience developing or integrating APIs and backend services.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and distributed application concepts.
  • Understanding of software design principles, data structures, and common programming patterns.
  • Experience using Git-based source control and collaborative development workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD processes, automated testing, and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience working with Docker or similar containerization technologies.
  • Experience debugging applications, investigating software issues, and implementing fixes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering team.
  • Ability to independently complete well-defined development tasks and contribute to moderately complex technical projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing gRPC services using Protocol Buffers (Protobuf).
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including Python APIs, service packages, or YANG models.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD and Docker Swarm.
  • Familiarity with network automation technologies and protocols such as NETCONF, RESTCONF, SSH, and YANG.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, MPLS, and BGP.
  • Experience with network provisioning, configuration management, or service activation systems.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts such as service-to-service communication, asynchronous processing, retries, and error handling.
  • Experience with Linux systems and command-line tools.
  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, metrics, and application troubleshooting.
  • Experience with relational or non-relational databases.
  • Experience writing automated tests using frameworks such as pytest.
  • Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Previous experience in telecommunications, network infrastructure, or related industries.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently deliver reliable, well-tested software features and enhancements that support network automation.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of our Python microservices, gRPC APIs, and Cisco NSO integrations.
  • Take ownership of assigned development work from implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Effectively troubleshoot application issues and contribute to improving system reliability.
  • Collaborate with other engineers and network operations teams to solve technical challenges.
  • Demonstrate growing independence in technical problem-solving and implementation decisions.
  • Contribute to code quality, documentation, and continuous improvement across the engineering team.

Why Join Our Team?

At Zayo, network automation is essential to supporting the scale, reliability, and operational efficiency of our telecommunications infrastructure.

Our engineering team works at the intersection of modern software development and large-scale network infrastructure, building solutions that have a direct impact on how network services are provisioned, configured, and managed.


As a Software Engineer II, you will have the opportunity to work with Python-based microservices, gRPC, Cisco NSO, and containerized applications while collaborating with experienced engineers on meaningful technical challenges.

You'll gain hands-on experience with complex distributed systems, deepen your understanding of network automation, and have opportunities to expand your technical capabilities and responsibilities as you grow.

If you enjoy building software, solving practical engineering problems, and developing automation that makes a measurable difference, we'd love to hear from you.


Estimated base salary range: $89,800 - $138,200 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.


The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.


This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: Zayo will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from any applicant's or employee's Biometric Data. By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge this disclosure. Prior to any collection of Biometric Data — including through CLEAR — you may be presented with a separate consent form and asked to provide your written authorization in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI), and other applicable biometric privacy statutes.

raw.description:
***Active DoD Security Clearance Preferred***

***US Citizenship Required***

***NO VISA SUPPORT or C2C***

Primary Function

Long Wave Inc. is seeking a Senior Principal Quality Engineer – Program Quality Assurance (PRQA) to support program execution, contractual quality compliance, and Quality Management System (QMS) activities within an aerospace and defense environment.

Essential Responsibilities

Program Quality Assurance & Contractual Compliance

  • Serve as lead PRQA for assigned programs, providing quality oversight throughout program development, production, testing, integration, and acceptance.
  • Review and analyze contracts, Statements of Work (SOW), Supplier Quality Assurance Requirements (SQAR), purchase orders, specifications, and other customer requirements to identify quality obligations, compliance gaps, and risks.
  • Develop and maintain program quality plans, contractual quality requirements matrices, compliance documentation, and associated program quality records.
  • Identify contractual quality concerns and coordinate recommended clarifications, exceptions, or resolutions with Contracts, Program Management, and other responsible organizations.
  • Coordinate with program and functional teams to ensure quality requirements are incorporated into program planning, schedules, technical activities, and deliverables.
  • Review technical documentation, design changes, inspection and test requirements, and contractual deliverables for applicable quality compliance.
  • Support program design reviews, technical reviews, production readiness activities, verification, testing, and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate applicable First Article Inspection (FAI), source inspection, product verification, and acceptance requirements with responsible functional organizations.
  • Support supplier quality oversight, contractual quality flowdowns, nonconformance resolution, and corrective action activities in coordination with Supply Chain Management and Hardware Quality Assurance.
  • Review and coordinate Quality Assurance inputs and approvals for contractual deliverables, including applicable SDRLs/CDRLs.
  • Identify, document, communicate, and track program quality risks, nonconformances, corrective actions, and compliance concerns through resolution.
  • Support nonconformance reporting, Material Review Board (MRB) activities, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes.
  • Interface with customer and government quality representatives to support program reviews, inspections, audits, and quality issue resolution.
  • Develop and report program quality metrics, compliance status, risks, trends, and corrective action performance.
  • Serve as QA Control Account Manager (CAM) for assigned program, supporting budget and resource planning, ETC/EAC forecasting, cost and schedule performance monitoring, variance analysis, and applicable EVMS reporting requirements.

Senior Technical Quality Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical resource for complex aerospace and defense quality engineering, customer quality requirements, and compliance matters across the organization.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations to Quality Assurance, Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Supply Chain Management, and other functional organizations.
  • Lead or support complex cross-functional quality investigations, risk assessments, and improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing quality processes, systems, and controls; recommend and implement improvements to strengthen compliance, effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Provide technical mentoring, coaching, and knowledge transfer to quality personnel and other functional stakeholders.
  • Advise Quality leadership on complex quality concerns, technical risks, and opportunities for improvement.

QMS Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Support implementation, sustainment, and continual improvement of the AS9100/ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
  • Support QMS process improvements, digital quality management applications, and associated workflows, including TipQA/TipSFE, as assigned.
  • Participate in internal, customer, and certification audits, including objective evidence reviews, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
  • Support integration of program-specific contractual quality requirements into established QMS processes and controls.
  • Perform other assigned QA and QMS support activities based on department priorities.

Work Conditions

  • Remote or on-site work arrangement based on business needs and position requirements.
  • Occasional travel may be required in support of program, customer, supplier, QMS, audit, or inspection activities.
  • Remote employees must be able to perform assigned duties and access authorized company systems in accordance with company and contractual requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline with a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience; graduate degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or 16 years of directly related experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Mastery-level knowledge of quality engineering, program quality assurance, contractual quality requirements, and related disciplines.
  • Extensive experience in aerospace, defense, or similarly regulated industries performing quality engineering, program quality assurance, or related quality functions.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and implementing complex contractual, customer, technical, and regulatory quality requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems and applicable aerospace/defense quality practices.
  • Experience developing or implementing program quality plans, contractual requirements matrices, compliance verification activities, and associated quality documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex quality issues, identify compliance risks, recommend solutions, and coordinate resolution across functional organizations.
  • Experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective action, and quality risk management.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership, influence stakeholders, and communicate complex quality matters with management, customers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience serving as a lead Program Quality Engineer or Program Quality Assurance representative supporting aerospace/defense programs.
  • Experience supporting major defense contractors, Department of Defense programs, or government contractual quality requirements.
  • Experience performing detailed contractual quality requirements analysis, developing compliance matrices, and establishing program-specific quality controls.
  • Experience with AS9102 First Article Inspection, customer/government source inspection, product acceptance, and supplier quality requirements.
  • Knowledge of AS9145/APQP/PPAP, configuration management, engineering change control, and technical data requirements.
  • Experience supporting complex quality investigations, RCCA/CAPA activities, and cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
  • Experience implementing, sustaining, or improving AS9100-certified Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience implementing or supporting electronic QMS applications, including TipQA, TipSFE, or similar systems.
  • Experience with CAM, program budgeting, ETC/EAC forecasting, or Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) in a DoD program environment.
  • ASQ or other relevant professional Quality certification, including CQE, CQA, CRE, CMQ/OE, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical mentoring and guidance to quality engineering personnel.
  • Active or previously held Secret security clearance.

Position Benefits:

As a full-time employee of Long Wave, you are eligible for our benefits package including:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • 401k
  • Educational Assistance
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
  • Paid Time Off
  • This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

EOE AA M/F/Vet/Disability

raw.description:
WSP is seeking a Transmission Line Project Engineer to join our Power Delivery Team. This position offers a flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or from one of our offices across the Southeast region. Preferred locations include

  • Indian Land, SC

  • Charlotte, NC

  • Orlando, FL

  • Birmingham, AL

  • Richmond, VA

  • Atlanta, GA

Join a growing organization where you will contribute to impactful projects, support our clients’ goals, and help solve complex engineering challenges.

This Opportunity
Provides technical leadership and guidance for the planning, design, and delivery of high‑voltage overhead transmission line projects. Tasks may include research, design, concept development, planning, client interactions, business and proposal development, construction support, and staff mentorship. Supports project development through disciplined engineering practices, coordination across multidisciplinary teams, and adherence to established quality and safety standards. Ensures responsibilities are executed with a level of technical excellence, clarity, and functional performance that meets or exceeds industry expectations.

Your Impact
The successful candidate will be able to lead, support, and coordinate the following:

Project Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and execute the engineering of transmission projects up to 765kV.
  • Lead and/or support the initial project execution layout to ensure an efficient and effective project plan has been established.
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining a project schedule.
  • Conduct weekly or bi-weekly project meetings to outline upcoming deliverables and tasks with the responsible personnel identified clearly.
  • Coordinate with clients on project status and support project meetings as necessary.
  • Maintain project workflow and thorough communication across multi-disciplinary projects, both internal and external to WSP.
  • Forecast upcoming project requirements to assist in resource planning.
  • Facilitate and adhere to WSP’s QA/QC procedures.
  • Participate in industry conferences, both internal and external, to improve professional growth while fostering knowledge transfer to colleagues.
  • Demonstrate transmission line design expertise pertaining to PLS-CADD, structure staking, foundations, assembly drawings, structure loading, material procurement, construction specifications, construction methods, construction estimates, and construction support.
  • Lead project teams of varying sizes.
  • Travel to client offices/field/vendor facilities, as needed.

 Project Manager (PM) Support

  • Support the Project Manager with project status reports.
  • Work with PMs to develop scope, schedule, and budget for new projects.
  • Work with PMs to identify out-of-scope items and support work scope variances.
  • Provide weekly or bi-weekly project updates and project forecasting.
  • Lead and/or support the PM with meetings with clients, both in person and remotely.
  • Develop client relationships, allowing WSP the opportunity to position ourselves to win future work.

Department Support

  • Support resource forecasting.
  • Support recruitment efforts.
  • Provide business improvement methodologies and procedures.
  • Support staff performance and technical development with department leadership.
  • Contribute to the business planning efforts.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
  • 7 -10 years’ experience in the transmission field of designing/managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams
  • Professional Engineering (PE) licensure.
  • Understanding of the NESC, RUS, and/or GO-95.
  • Strong understanding of transmission line fundamentals and PLS-CADD operation
  • The candidate must have a strong command of the English language with good written and oral communication skills to work effectively with internal team members and external client personnel.
  • Experience using the Microsoft Office software suite
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Field program planning, management, and execution.
  • Subcontractor management.
  • Cost estimating and scheduling.
  • Field experience.
  • MBA degree from an accredited university.
  • Involvement in technical societies (IEEE, CIGRE, ASCE…)
  • Experience using ArcGIS, AutoCAD/MicroStation, Foundation Design Software (FAD Tools, SHAFT, LPILE).
  • POLE and TOWER experience.

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

Expected Salary for the Richmond, Virginia Area: $107K-$183K

raw.description:
Remote Employee BPO has an outstanding opportunity for you!

Role: Interim Assistant Controller (Commercial Real Estate)
Compensation: Competitive Basic Salary
Work Schedule: 5-day work week, 12:00 a.m. 9:00 a.m. Philippine time
Target Start Date: October 12, 2026﻿
Work Setup: WFH﻿
Important Notes: 4 months initial assignment and may extend up to 6 months.

﻿

﻿﻿

Responsibilities:
﻿﻿﻿﻿

Monthly Reporting and Financial Review

  • Review property-level financials prepared by third party operators for accuracy, completeness, and proper coding before release
  • Deliver monthly operating reports (MORs) to capital partners on a fixed schedule, with due dates ranging from the 10th of the month through the 25th across six deals and four institutional partners
  • Prepare quarterly reporting packages on an accelerated 5th business day timeline for two of those deals
  • Provide GL coding guidance to third party operators on expense classification as questions arise
  • Place assets in service quarterly, calculate depreciation, and provide entries to third party operators for recording
  • Produce supporting schedules and maintain organized close support files and MOR archives
  • Distribute loan statements to the property management partner on the applicable deal

Capital Calls, Draws, and Treasury

  • Prepare capital calls as needed to fund construction draws and other operating expenses
  • Push down funding from the fund entity to JV accounts, and from JV accounts to property operating accounts
  • Route draw packages to third party operators for payment, track payment status, and chase down delays
  • Initiate ACH and wire transfers as needed

Distributions and Fees

  • Produce cash analyses supporting distribution decisions
  • Prepare distribution memos and supporting schedules
  • Issue distribution packages to third party operators for payment
  • Prepare quarterly incentive fee invoices as needed

Accounts Payable and Corporate Card

  • Route property expense invoices to the correct 3rd party operator for payment, with coding guidance as needed
  • Route corporate invoices to the outsourced bill pay provider
  • Route tax and insurance invoices to the lender for payment where applicable
  • Circulate monthly AMEX statements and QBO reports for payment; prepare the quarterly AMEX chargeback allocation to properties
  • Pay annual registered agent and entity maintenance fees (CT Corp, CSC, Vcorp)

Audit and Tax Support

  • Compile and coordinate audit support for four separate audits, including three property or JV level audits and the fund entity, working with third party operators and delivering to the external audit firm
  • Provide requested tax return support to the external tax firm
  • Prepare and transmit quarterly tax projection reporting for JV partners, including partner-specific projection packages

Investor, Lender, and Partner Reporting

  • Produce and distribute quarterly JV reporting
  • Produce and distribute quarterly lender reporting
  • Produce and distribute quarterly non-profit partner reporting
  • Tie-out sources and uses worksheets at the JV level on a quarterly basis

Administrative

  • Monitor incoming mail, scan and distribute to the appropriate parties
  • Coordinate physical delivery of checks for deposit as needed

﻿Qualifications:﻿

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. CPA, or the Philippine CPA equivalent, strongly preferred
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 4 years in commercial real estate. Experience gained supporting US-based real estate owners, operators, or funds is required
  • Demonstrated ownership of a monthly close cycle end to end, including review of work prepared by others rather than only preparing entries
  • Hands-on experience with joint venture and fund structures: capital calls, capital contributions and distributions, waterfall and promote mechanics at a working level, and push-down funding between fund, JV, and property entities
  • Experience reviewing property-level financials prepared by third party property managers, including the ability to spot miscoded expenses, missing accruals, and variances worth questioning
  • Working knowledge of fixed assets and CAPEX: placed-in-service determinations, depreciation schedules, and construction draw processes
  • Experience preparing or coordinating audit support packages for external auditors, and supporting external tax preparers with return workpapers and quarterly projections
  • Familiarity with lender reporting requirements and loan covenant or draw compliance reporting
  • Track record of meeting recurring, externally imposed deadlines across multiple entities simultaneously

﻿

Communication, Client Service, and Working Style:﻿

  • Native or near-native written English. Correspondence goes directly to institutional investors, lenders, auditors, and property operators. Emails must be concise, correctly formatted, and free of errors
  • Proactive follow-up. A large share of the workload is chasing: draw payments that have not cleared, audit items outstanding with an operator, coding questions unanswered. The person in this seat must track open items and pursue them without being reminded
  • Comfortable directing people who do not report to them. Third party operators and outside firms must be guided, sequenced, and held to deadlines through influence rather than authority
  • Escalates early and accurately. Knows the difference between a problem to solve and a problem to raise, and raises it with a recommendation attached
  • Multitasking under fixed deadlines. Six reporting deadlines land between the 10th and the 25th of each month, overlapping with quarterly close, audit cycles, and ad hoc capital activity. The ability to sequence work and protect the deadlines is essential
  • Discretion. Handles partner-level financial information, distribution data, and compensation-adjacent detail; strict confidentiality is expected
  • Adaptable to a fast pace. Capital calls, draws, and wires arrive with short notice and must be turned around same day or next day

Preferred, Not Required:

  • Big 4 or large regional firm background, particularly in real estate assurance or tax
  • Prior experience supporting a US real estate sponsor from an offshore or shared services team
  • Experience with affordable housing, LIHTC, or public agency and non-profit partner reporting
  • Familiarity with Juniper Square or a comparable investor portal
  • Prior work in an interim or leave-coverage capacity, with a demonstrated ability to absorb a workload quickly and hand it back cleanly
