raw.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.


About this role

Our Integration Engineer will support Abound-related and building intelligence projects, from onboarding, integration and solution development through customer turnover. They will be the technical lead on the project team. We will rely on this individual to participate in internal and external meetings, providing their expertise to all teams as we build successful projects and exceed customer expectations.

The ideal candidate will come from a strong software integration background, preferably having worked with Enterprise Software (on premise or cloud-based), building management systems and controllers, HVAC assets, and various communication and data transfer protocols. Experience installing, configuring, supporting, and troubleshooting enterprise software systems and devices is strongly desired.

Carrier Abound offers a suite of intelligent solutions that help facilities teams optimize performance, reduce costs, and elevate occupant experiences. Whether you’re managing energy, maintenance, operations, or comfort,

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, hardware/software installations, configuration, troubleshooting, and technical consultancy to customers
  • Collaborative project management activities that include, but are not limited to, interacting with company and customer stakeholders, work with company and customer project/IT managers, and assist with project scoping
  • Ability to multitask and handle various projects at the same time
  • Manage/Coordinate customer Installation/Upgrade progress from start to finish, lead customer Installation/Upgrade meeting sessions, and open/track/close completed projects using internal tracking tools
  • Maintain proficiency with current and newly released Carrier Software products and technologies through self-directed (reading documentation) and formal training (provided by Product Management)
  • Ability to work independently with various OSes, databases, and an understanding of Networking/Firewall ports and protocols
  • Analyzes customer sites and company system requirements for use/integration and recommends and implements technical solutions to meet the needs
  • Responsible for identifying and mapping BACnet points for consumption into the Abound or related platform
  • Configures and troubleshoots integrated products and devices
  • Diagnoses and resolves network/integration technical problems on customer sites (or remotely) and provides appropriate reports to management
  • Manage a pipeline of pre-existing and target account customers

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or Computer Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience HVAC systems, including, but not limited to, AC package units, VAV air distribution, cooling towers, pumps, and building automation systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the operation and maintenance of various HVAC systems, including, but not limited to, AC package units, VAV air distribution, cooling towers, pumps, building automation systems, DDC controls and sensors, air compressors, and pneumatic controls, life safety systems, generators, electrical distribution, and luminary
  • Professional services consulting with B2B/B2E experience
  • Experience working in a building controls setting/environment (BMS)
  • Responsible for the design, operation, and implementation of a diverse set of features, processes, paradigms, and technologies that support integration to a cloud-based platform
  • Contribute to architectural definition, technology evaluation and selection, and best practices to consult with engineering teams to build, debug, test, release, manage, and secure a cloud-based or integration solution.
  • Support diagnostics, troubleshooting and operation across various technologies; identify areas for continuous improvement with emphasis on quality, performance, and security.
  • Highly proficient in Network Architecture (routers, switches), Network Configuration, and Protocols, both wired and wireless
  • Highly proficient in communication and data transfer protocols, such as MQTT, BACnet, SNMP, HTTP/HTTPS, various Web Services, TLS, etc.)
  • Experience with API and webhook configuration and possible scripting using JavaScript, C++, or AI aided tools

Additional Information

  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.
  • Able to pass Background Checks to obtain Security Clearances is required.
  • While employees may work remotely, the role is organizationally aligned to Kennesaw, GA, and associated with Carrier's corporate headquarters in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.

Job Title

Remote Application Specialist

Job Description

Provide expert remote clinical applications support for the Philips Advanced Molecular Imaging product line, combining strong clinical and product knowledge with exceptional multitasking and customer service to deliver efficient, consistent support that positively impacts customers and patients.

Your role:

  • Providing telephone and remote clinical applications support to internal and external customers for the Philips Advanced Molecular Imaging product line.
  • Providing detailed documentation of case notes, product data and patient data in a timely, accurate and confidential manner.
  • Driving increased productivity through utilization of remote tools, technical and clinical skill, and optimized solution delivery.
  • Multitasking between telephone and multiple software programs, with the soft-skills to deliver a caring, efficient and consistent experience.
  • Delivering remote clinical problem solving, solutions, services training, guidance where applicable, and education for Advanced Molecular Imaging solutions.

You're the right fit if:


  • 2+ years of experience in advanced molecular imaging, including single-photon emission computed tomography, single-photon emission computed tomography/computed tomography, positron emission tomography, and positron emission tomography/computed tomography.
  • Your skills include strong knowledge of advanced molecular imaging and anatomy, with advanced troubleshooting, clinical support, remote diagnostic, and accurate documentation skills. Excellent communication, customer service, independent decision-making, teamwork, and Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • You have at least an associate’s degree and a license or certification in nuclear medicine in good standing.
  • You must be able to successfully perform the following minimum Physical, Cognitive and Environmental job requirements with or without accommodation for this Field Service position.
  • You must be able to work flexible hours based on business need.

How we work together

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

This is a field role.

About Philips

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

  • Learn more about our business.
  • Discover our rich and exciting history.
  • Learn more about our purpose.

In addition, other compensation, such as an annual incentive bonus, sales commission or long-term incentives may be offered. Employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive Philips Total Rewards benefits program, which includes a generous PTO, 401k (up to 7% match), HSA (with company contribution), stock purchase plan, education reimbursement and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here.

At Philips, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each case.

raw.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development - Defense and Government
raw.excerpt: Company OverviewAt Continuous Composites Inc. , we are Delivering the Future of Manufacturing.
raw.description:
Company Overview

At Continuous Composites Inc., we are Delivering the Future of Manufacturing. Our unique CF3D® technology for composite 3D printing opens new frontiers in Aerospace and Defense. We thrive on innovation, rapid iteration, and empowering every team member to take initiative and drive breakthrough solutions. Our mission is to transform industrial manufacturing through pioneering research, creative problem-solving, and relentless execution.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proven Aerospace and Defense business developer who knows where the government’s money is, how to shape it, and how to get CCI on contract fast. This role is measured on dollars of orders closed. The ideal person will thrive on bringing in business. Our sales are not transactional: dollar values are high, sales cycles are long and complex, and most wins require shaping requirements and funding before a solicitation exists.

Our CF3D® technology 3D prints continuous-fiber composites, both polymer matrix (PMC) and ceramic matrix (CMC), producing complex, lightweight, high-performance parts for hypersonics, missiles, propulsion, reentry, unmanned systems, and other demanding defense applications. You will work alongside our Sr. Director of Defense Strategy & Business Development and partner closely with Engineering, Applications, and Finance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Find and Create Funding: Identify and shape the budget lines, program office funds, and congressional adds that can pay for CCI’s technology, and position CCI in requirements before solicitations are released.
  • Get CCI on Contract Fast: Choose and execute the fastest path for each opportunity: SBIR/STTR (including Phase III sole-source), OTAs and consortia, CSOs, BAAs, STRATFI/TACFI, ManTech, direct awards, and congressionally directed funding.
  • Sell Directly and Through the Primes: Build relationships with program offices, labs, end users, and congressional staff, and get CCI written into prime contractors’ bids and programs through teaming and subcontract agreements.
  • Move Technology into Programs: Carry CCI from development and prototype awards to follow-on production and programs of record (PoR).
  • Lead Capture and Proposals: Own white papers, proposals, and pricing strategy with Engineering and Finance, including technical data rights and IP considerations.
  • Own the Pipeline: Build and forecast a qualified pipeline, track defense priorities and funding trends, and close orders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, materials science, aerospace, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in government business development, defense contracting, federal capture management, government-funded technology development, or a related field.
  • A Record of Closing: Personally closed government or defense orders in the last three to five years. You can name the awards, customers, dollar values, contract vehicles, and your role in winning them.
  • Long-Cycle Selling: Carried high-value pursuits from first contact through award.
  • Deep Contracting Knowledge: Hands-on fluency with FAR/DFARS, SBIR/STTR, OTAs, and other fast-path vehicles.
  • Funding Knowledge: Understanding of how program budgets are built, and how appropriations reach programs.
  • Government Network: Working relationships across several of: Air Force, Space Force, Army, Navy, Missile Defense Agency, DIU, DARPA, and the primes.
  • Technical Aptitude: Able to learn advanced materials and manufacturing well enough to explain CCI’s value and translate customer needs to Engineering. Deep product expertise is not required.
  • Strong Writing: Experience leading or substantially writing proposals and white papers.
  • Ability to Travel: ~50% Travel Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Moving SBIR Phase I or II awards into Phase III, follow-on procurement, or production.
  • Prior DoD acquisition experience as a contracting officer, program manager, or legislative or budget liaison.
  • Experience securing congressional adds or working with appropriations staff.
  • Transitioning a new material or manufacturing process into a program of record, especially additive manufacturing or composites.
  • Understanding of the qualification and manufacturing-readiness challenges new materials face.
  • Background in hypersonics, missiles, high-temperature materials, or reentry systems.
  • Experience at a growth-stage defense or advanced manufacturing company.

This Role Is Not

  • Contracts administration. You choose and shape the path to contract; you don’t primarily process paperwork.
  • Relationships for their own sake. Access matters because it leads to orders.
  • Product or engineering leadership. The technical roadmap stays with Engineering.

Why Join Us:

At Continuous Composites, you will be part of a team that is redefining how advanced composites are manufactured. We move fast, communicate clearly, and innovate constantly. If you thrive in a dynamic, hands-on environment and are passionate about cutting-edge technology, we want to hear from you.

Continuous Composites, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidate must be eligible to work in the U.S. Candidates need to be lawfully able to work on ITAR or controlled information which requires that the applicant be a U.S. Person as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

Continuous Composites generally does not provide sponsorship for work visas.

This is an individual contributor role, based remotely in North America.

About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions, and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. As a Senior Director within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, you will establish yourself as a credible voice in the application security space at local, regional, and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, you will produce pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

Hot Topics of Discussion with Client CIOs and Heads of IT:

  • How to create a security compliance policy for ERPs vendors to adhere to?
  • How to create a risk assessment program to evaluate ERPs vendors?
  • How to develop metrics to measure success?
  • How to create an application security policy that achieves an enterprise’s overall application and business strategies?
  • Identifying strengths and weaknesses of the major application vendors (i.e., SAP, Salesforce, Workday and Oracle) security tools
  • Have a good understanding of the capabilities of security tools from 3rd party vendors that are compatible with mega vendor applications which enable vulnerability identification
  • How to build and operate an application security vulnerability testing program.
  • Advise on the Key Vulnerabilities and Attack Surfaces to Test for mega vendors.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in application security, enterprise applications, or IT leadership
  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience in security strategies and roadmaps for major ERP vendors
  • Extensive knowledge in working with CIOs (or ‘Heads of IT’) and business leaders on developing application security strategies with delivering business value (i.e., performance metrics, decision authority between the business and application teams, relationship management with the business, etc.)
  • Strong familiarity with creating ERPs Security Roadmaps and Performance Metrics preferred
  • An ability to articulate the role application security technology plays in delivering business value
  • Experience in organizing and leading application security teams (i.e., location of work, roles & responsibilities, operating model, organization design, evaluating application team performance, budget / finance, relationships with Enterprise Architect and PMO teams, etc.)
  • Remain ahead of the curve on developments and issues within these specified areas as well as applicable adjacent areas of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

Why Cisco?

Working at Abbott

The Opportunity

If you are interested in joining Abbott's high caliber ICE Specialist, EP program, we want to network with you!

In this role, you will assist with the implantation and support of cardiac mapping procedures. Assists in the day-to-day management of various clinically-related issues. Working under direct supervision, provides educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff. What You’ll Work On

Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.

Full Time

Nationwide IT Services, NIS, is seeking a System Administrator V to serve as a senior technical resource supporting USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), Veterinary Services (VS) application operations and maintenance.

The position provides application-facing systems administration and operational support across the VS hosting environment, helping maintain the availability, reliability, security, and recoverability of mission-critical applications while working within USDA-established infrastructure, cybersecurity, configuration-management, and change-control processes. This position is fully remote.

The role supports application components hosted across Azure Kubernetes environments, WebLogic clusters, virtual machines, and associated application platforms.

Responsibilities include application availability monitoring, deployment and configuration support, environment troubleshooting, SSL certificate and credential lifecycle activities, patch and version coordination, backup and recovery support, disaster-recovery preparation, and production incident and root-cause analysis.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Support application-facing administration across Azure Kubernetes clusters, WebLogic clusters, virtual machines, and associated application components.
  • Monitor and support application availability; troubleshoot application/platform interactions and coordinate infrastructure issues with USDA teams.
  • Manage application-level SSL certificate, credential, and version-currency activities within assigned authority.
  • Support application backup/recovery procedures, recovery testing, dependency documentation, and disaster-recovery coordination with USDA infrastructure/DBA teams.
  • Support deployment, configuration, environment troubleshooting, patch/version coordination, and production incident/root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain operational documentation and provide evidence for security, accreditation, and change activities as required.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience supporting federal or enterprise production system administration.
  • Experience with cloud and container platforms, including Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration.
  • Experience supporting enterprise application servers such as WebLogic and Windows/Linux virtualized environments.
  • Experience with SSL/certificate lifecycle, credentials, availability troubleshooting, backup/recovery support, and operational documentation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Azure and Kubernetes administration/support experience.
  • WebLogic administration/support experience.
  • Federal application availability and incident-response experience.
  • Experience supporting RMF/ATO artifacts, vulnerability remediation, and disaster-recovery exercises.
Contract / Work Environment
  • Support USDA APHIS Veterinary Services application operations and maintenance in a remote delivery environment.
  • Normal support coverage is 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, Monday through Friday. Routine after-hours, weekend, and on-call support are not required.
  • This position is fully remote.
  • Must satisfy applicable USDA personnel-security, suitability, PIV, training, and system-access requirements before performing access-dependent work.
  • Work is performed using Government-furnished systems, tools, software, and processes. Personnel must follow USDA change, release, security, accessibility, and documentation requirements.
About Nationwide IT Services:
NIS is a CVE-verified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and an IT and management consulting company. Our mission is to deliver value-added services to our customers, leveraging technology, people, and industry best practices to implement innovative solutions through our trusted employees and team members.
 
Our benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; a 401(k) plan with employer match; paid holidays; PTO (sick/vacation); commuter benefits; an employee assistance program (EAP); educational reimbursement; and pet insurance.

Salary range $105,000 to $115,000 annually

Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™

OUR MISSION

Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.

CORE VALUES

At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.

COMPENSATION & LOCATION

The salary for this role is $55,000.

This is a remote position with occasional travel for team or customer meetings. Candidates located near our Elk Grove, Illinois or Columbus, Ohio offices are preferred.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Specialty Pharmacy Program Analyst position works in collaboration with the Program Manager to provide support for assigned manufacturer program(s) and therapies. The analyst will be a key contact interacting with the manufacturer, HUB and case management teams, prescribers, prescriber office staff and patients.

The role will require a high sense of urgency and the ability to answer questions quickly or respond/resolve issues that may arise. This support includes providing concise and accurate patient status information, participate and facilitate manufacturer status update meetings, ensure manufacturer contract obligations met, and provide prompt follow-up on inquiries from assigned manufacturer(s). Works as part of account team to build strong manufacturer relationships. The analyst will support internal therapy team by assisting in processing orders and/or handling escalated cases as time allows around manufacturer activities. The analyst will be actively engaged in manufacturer program manager and therapy team to ensure program requirements are met and program is operating as designed.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

  • Provide concise and accurate patient status information from system and/or via collaboration with other team members to assigned manufacturers.
  • Collaborates with internal SPP teams or team members to expedite patient processing as needed.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve escalated issues and cases related to complex reimbursement.
  • Serves as point of contact to manufacturer field reps, MD offices, and/or patients for all assigned orders.
  • In conjunction with Program Manager, leads weekly (or more or less frequently as needed) calls with manufacturer.
  • Perform manufacturer-specific enhanced services such as specialized welcome calls or contractual timed patient calls directed by Program Manager/Therapy Team Manager
  • In collaboration with program manager, identify patients with potential for a delay in initial or refill shipment and create strategy to expedite or escalates situation to management as necessary.
  • Attend scheduled manufacturer, program manager and therapy team meetings.
  • Prepare and/or review internal reports for assigned therapy and manufacturer as requested.

Disclaimer: The information written in this job description indicates the general nature and level of work to be performed. This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as totally comprehensive of every job duty, responsibility, or qualification required by an employee assigned to this job. While employed in this position, an employee may be required to perform other assignments not listed in this job description.

  • Must have experience working in manufacturer settings and/or with manufacturer account representatives. Ability to collaborate effectively with a diverse customer base - including MD office staff, and patients - is strongly preferred.

  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Excel Required
  • Experience in providing excellent customer service skills to internal and external customers and able to react with strong sense of urgency when needed to prevent or resolve issues.

  • Ability to manage intake of issues via phone and email and segregate urgent from non-urgent.

  • Ability to multitask and deliver on tight deadlines.

Work Environment

  • Work from home role based and working full time in the UK only.
  • You'll collaborate with colleagues across GMT, Central European and US time zones (PST to EST).
  • Occasional overtime may be required for special programme events.

Visas

  • We are unable to provide or continue UK or Irish visa sponsorship for this role.

What you'll be joining?

  • Our Legal team is small, busy and works closely with every part of the business. (multiple businesses across geographies including Ireland UK/ USA)
  • You will be joining a growing international business, where priorities shift quickly, new challenges appear regularly and no two days look quite the same.
  • You'll need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable juggling several things at once. Some days you'll have your priorities neatly mapped out. Other days, the business will have different ideas!
  • We value people who can adjust, make sound decisions and keep things moving without losing sight of the detail.

Why choose this role?

  • Real legal experience from day one. You'll work on commercial contracts and third-party reviews, gradually taking on more complex matters and negotiations.
  • Breadth that builds your Inhouse legal career. Exposure to commercial contracts, company secretarial, data privacy and, over time, intellectual property, supporting multiple service areas and teams.
  • A genuine opportunity to improve how we work. Good ideas are welcome, whether that's simplifying a process, improving a workflow or introducing a better tool.
  • Practical experience with AI. As an AI native company, ee use enterprise-approved AI tools in our everyday work, giving you exposure to how modern legal teams operate.
  • Work with purpose. Your contribution supports technology that helps patients receive faster, more accurate diagnoses.
  • Real autonomy. We don't micromanage so you can expect plenty of autonomy to shape your days
  • A small but night team: The opportunity to learn quickly, with a super supportive team around you. We're non hierarchical team and company so expect to have access to all levels and decision makers.

About this Role (Responsibilities):

  • Commercial contracts: Draft, review and support negotiations across NDAs, customer and service agreements, pilot and evaluation agreements, supplier and vendor contracts, data processing agreements, research and collaboration agreements, licensing agreements and consultancy agreements.
  • Contract management: Help administer our case management system and contract repository, maintaining templates, approval workflows, signatures, renewals, expiries, obligations and accurate records.
  • Legal compliance and research: Monitor regulatory developments, research legislation, regulations, case law and legal precedents, and support compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Company secretarial and governance: Support the Company Secretary, maintain accurate company records as the source of truth, manage record requests, statutory registers, filings and general corporate housekeeping.
  • Data protection and privacy: Support our Data Protection Officer with GDPR and UK GDPR requirements, including Records of Processing Activities, Data Protection Impact Assessments, data subject requests, data processing agreements and privacy queries.
  • Business support: Work with Commercial, Finance, Quality & Regulatory and Information Security teams on contracts, policies, customer due diligence and security or compliance questionnaires.
  • Intellectual property: Support trademark and copyright registrations, monitoring and enforcement of intellectual property rights.
  • Legal documentation and queries: Prepare first drafts using approved templates and playbooks, triage incoming contract requests and act as a first point of contact for routine legal queries.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with colleagues across the business, providing legal guidance and support while helping maintain compliance with legal requirements.
  • Knowledge management: Keep legal research, templates, guidance and resources organised, accurate and accessible.
  • AI-enabled legal work: Use approved AI tools for contract review, summarisation, research and drafting, following our AI Governance Policy and ensuring appropriate human review and verification.
  • Team administration: Support calendars, meetings, legal files and other day-to-day administrative requirements.

The above Job Description reflects the requirements of this position at time of issue. As duties and responsibilities change and develop, this will be reviewed and may be subject to amendments.

About You (Skills and Experience):

  • A degree in Law, Legal Studies or a related field.
  • Previous industry experience as an In-house Paralegal or in a similar legal support role, ideally in-house within technology or healthcare.
  • Experience across commercial contracts, data protection/privacy and corporate secretarial matters.
  • Compliance and intellectual property experience would be an advantage.
  • A solid understanding of contract law, corporate governance and legal research methodologies.

Skills get you in the door - Will (Attitude & Approach ) gets your hired

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced business with constantly changing priorities.
  • Able to juggle deadlines, prioritise effectively and adapt quickly.
  • Explain complex legal matters clearly to colleagues across the business.
  • Detail-focused, thorough and committed to accuracy.
  • Take ownership, use sound judgement and follow through.
  • Work independently, ask questions and know when to escalate.
  • Confident using legal research tools, document systems and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Keen to use AI contract management systems and enterprise AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude).
  • Handle sensitive legal and commercial information with discretion and confidentiality.

Desirable

You don't need experience in every area below, but we'd welcome:

  • Experience in pathology, laboratories, oncology, academic medical centres or clinical services.
  • Familiarity with healthcare or pathology services in the UK or Republic of Ireland.
  • Knowledge of clinical guidelines and regulations.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR and data protection practices.

Your development and career progression:

  • We want this role to be a strong foundation for your long-term legal career.
  • You'll work closely with our Legal team on varied, commercially meaningful matters, gaining practical experience across contracts, governance, privacy and other areas as your skills develop.
  • We actively support professional development and welcome conversations about further qualifications, including routes to qualifying as a solicitor in the UK or Ireland.
  • Depending on your development goals and business needs, support may include study flexibility, mentoring from qualified solicitors and exposure to work relevant to qualifying experience requirements.
  • You'll have opportunities to build confidence, develop your judgement and take on greater responsibility over time.
  • We're growing, and we'd love someone who wants to grow with us.

What else can Deciphex offer you?

💼 Competitive salary with performance-based annual increments recognising commercial impact.

🏥 Healthcare coverage supporting long-term wellbeing.

🌴 Annual leave that gives you time to properly switch off and recharge.

🫀 Purpose-driven work supporting faster, more accurate patient diagnoses.

🚀 Ownership of interesting, complex and commercially significant legal work across healthcare, technology and AI.

🌍 The opportunity to work with a high-performing international team in a growing digital pathology business.

📈 Regular, meaningful performance feedback, clear accountability and opportunities to develop.

🤝 A collaborative, inclusive and multicultural team built on trust, respect and shared standards.

More About Us

Founded in Dublin in 2017, Deciphex is helping address one of healthcare's biggest challenges: the growing demand for pathology expertise.

Our AI-powered software supports faster, more accurate diagnoses and helps pharmaceutical companies accelerate essential drug development.

Today, we're a team of over 230 people, with offices in Dublin, Exeter, Oxford, Toronto and Chicago, and we're continuing to grow internationally. Our people bring together expertise in software development, clinical pathology, AI engineering, operations and many other disciplines. We're ambitious about what we're building and equally committed to how we work together.

Our culture is grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration and giving people the space to do meaningful work. Life in a growing technology business brings variety, evolving priorities and plenty of opportunities to learn.

We value people who approach challenges with curiosity, take responsibility and enjoy finding practical solutions.

If you're looking to build your legal career in a business where your work has purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

Learn more about Deciphex and meet our team on our Careers Page.

raw.description:
Summary

The SEC Reporting Consultant serves as an accounting expert and applies accounting acumen to customers on a project basis, providing customer project management, XBRL data modeling, mapping, tagging, and review of customer XBRL projects in compliance with quality and customer satisfaction standards. We are committed to providing comprehensive training of XBRL principles and equipping you with the proficiency to effectively utilize the Workiva platform in facilitating our clients' XBRL filings.

What You’ll Do

  • Model the XBRL Mapping, utilizing the applicable Taxonomy, selecting the appropriate line item concepts, axis, and members

  • Interpret guidance from the applicable taxonomy to determine accuracy of tag choice and ensure that extensions follow the relative intent of the taxonomy

  • Tag the values in the companies’ Financial Statements and Notes, Financial Statement Schedules, and other information requiring tagging with the concepts identified

  • Determine whether values are stated at a point in time (Balance Sheet), or over a period of time (P&L), and whether monetary values represent debits or credits.

  • Master the intricacies of financial reporting, spanning a range of vital components including stock-based compensation, fair value assessment, derivatives, pensions, income taxes, inventory valuation, investments, property, plant and equipment, comprehensive income, leases, revenue recognition, and the latest accounting standards. Your expertise will illuminate our financial landscape, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and transparency in every facet of reporting.

  • Maintain knowledge of taxonomies, SEC regulations, emerging XBRL requirements, and accounting

  • Map the Financial Statements and Notes, and Financial Statement Schedules to the appropriate XBRL taxonomy (GAAP, IFRS)

  • Review the accounting policies, statements, notes, and schedules, and gain an understanding of the amounts presented to identify the related accounting standards concepts in the appropriate taxonomy

  • Understand the industry accounting disclosures specific to company customers

  • Maintain knowledge of taxonomies, regulations, and accounting standards' changes

  • Stay current with industry trends, updates on accounting standards and regulatory requirements, identifying and apply new skills

  • Collaborate with other internal teams, including Product Development, Sales, Marketing, and Learning & Development, to advance company training and standardize changes

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field

  • 2+ years of experience, experience working in a CPA firm or financial reporting environment preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CIA certification

  • Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field

  • Proven track record of delivering projects on time, on budget, and to a high-quality standard

  • Successful experience working cooperatively and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Sound knowledge of and competency with SEC and SEDAR reporting requirements

  • Strong U.S. GAAP (or other accounting standards where applicable) acumen and understanding of financial reporting

  • Understand and interpret taxonomy structure

  • Demonstrated capacity for self-motivated initiation, execution, and consistent follow-through

  • Ability to allow for contingencies, prioritize multiple and potentially overlapping customer requirements, and plan filing dates

  • Willingness to travel, less than 10% travel expected for team and corporate meetings, contributing to building strong relationships and representing the company's interests

Travel Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Minimal travel for internal meetings

  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office

Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $68,000.00 - $110,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

Candescent is searching for a Principal Software Engineer specializing in React Native mobile development to join our Engineering team. This role will partner closely with Enterprise Architects, Product Management, UX/UI Design, and engineering leads to shape strategic architecture decisions and deliver secure, scalable, and intuitive mobile banking experiences.

The Principal Software Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership across design, development, deployment, and production support. The successful candidate will combine deep React Native and native mobile expertise with sound architectural judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to use AI-enabled development tools responsibly to accelerate the software development lifecycle.

  • Design and develop highly configurable, extensible, and pluggable React Native applications.

  • Provide development guidance, reusable code examples, technical documentation, and unit-test strategies.

React, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, iOS, Swift, Objective-C, CocoaPods, Android, Kotlin, Java, Node.js, Xcode, Android Studio, Visual Studio Code, Playwright, NativeBase, Tamagui, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure, Bitrise, Firebase, Claude, and Cursor.

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Senior Counsel – Retirement & Employee Benefits

Join Empower Legal Department as a principal legal advisor supporting one of the industry's growing defined contribution and multiemployer retirement businesses.


As a Senior Counsel, you will have primary legal responsibility for Empower's defined contribution and multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) business, serving as the principal legal advisor to business partners supporting these products and services. You will provide practical, business-focused legal counsel on complex ERISA, tax, fiduciary, operational, administrative, and regulatory matters that support the successful operation and continued growth of the business.


As Empower continues to expand and evolve its defined contribution offerings, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the business while helping shape future growth through product enhancements, operational improvements, strategic initiatives, and client solutions. You will also provide legal support for our multiple employer plan and pooled employer plan business, and partner with other members of the Legal Department to support defined benefit plans, consumer directed healthcare (CDH) offerings, our health and welfare plan business, IRAs, and other retirement products and services as business needs require.


In this highly collaborative role, you will partner closely with leaders across Product, Operations, Client Service, Sales, Investments, Compliance, Risk Management, Marketing, Finance, Technology, and other corporate functions to develop practical legal solutions that enable innovation, effectively manage risk, support operational excellence, and deliver exceptional outcomes for Empower, plan sponsors, and participants.


What You Will Do

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to business leaders supporting Empower's defined contribution and multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) business.
  • Lead legal support for the ongoing operation of Empower's growing defined contribution and multiemployer business, advising on complex ERISA, tax, fiduciary, administrative, operational, compliance, and regulatory matters affecting products, services, client relationships, and day-to-day business operations.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities to enhance existing products, services, operational capabilities, and client retention while supporting the continued growth and evolution of the defined contribution and multiemployer businesses.
  • Advise on the development, enhancement, and administration of retirement and employee benefit products and services, helping move strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Partner across Product, Operations, Client Service, Sales, Investments, Marketing, Compliance, Risk Management, Finance, Technology, and other business functions to identify legal considerations early and develop practical, business-focused solutions.
  • Collaborate with attorneys across the Legal Department to provide consistent, enterprise-wide legal guidance and leverage the broader legal team's expertise in support of the business.
  • Develop and enhance legal frameworks, governance processes, and compliance practices that support effective risk management by balancing legal, regulatory, operational, and reputational risks while enabling innovation, operational excellence, and business growth.

Defined Contribution, Taft-Hartley & Employee Benefits Expertise

  • Serve as the Legal Department's primary attorney supporting defined contribution plans and multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) plans, advising on complex ERISA, tax qualification, fiduciary issues and prohibited transactions, reporting and disclosure rules, and regulatory matters.
  • Provide legal counsel on the unique governance, fiduciary, operational, compliance, and regulatory issues affecting multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) plans, multiple employer plans and pooled employer plans.
  • Advise on defined contribution plan qualification, design, administration, funding, operational compliance, plan freezes, mergers, spin-offs, and plan terminations.
  • Provide ongoing legal guidance supporting the administration and operation of Empower's defined contribution business, including recordkeeping, trust and custody services, administrative services, participant services, investment-related offerings, and the resolution of escalated client concerns.
  • Provide legal support for health and welfare plans and CDH benefit arrangements, including Health Savings Accounts, Health Retirement Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts.
  • Provide sophisticated legal counsel regarding ERISA, the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, IRS and Department of Labor guidance, SECURE Act developments, HIPAA, COBRA, ACA and other federal laws governing retirement and employee benefit plans.
  • Partner with colleagues across the Legal Department to support defined benefit plans, IRAs, rollover solutions, and other retirement products and services as business needs require.
  • Advise on operational and fiduciary correction matters, including the IRS Employee Plans Compliance Resolution System (EPCRS), Department of Labor correction programs, related compliance strategies and Empower client contract commitments.
  • Monitor legislative, regulatory, and industry developments affecting the administration of retirement plans, health & welfare plans and CDH arrangements and translate emerging legal requirements into practical guidance for business partners.
  • Support negotiations involving retirement plan services, recordkeeping, trust, custody, administrative services, investment products, and related commercial arrangements.

Leadership

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders across business and legal teams.
  • Build collaborative relationships and influence decision-making across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Foster a culture of partnership, sound judgment, and practical, business-oriented legal advice.
  • Exercise sound risk analysis and judgment in balancing legal, regulatory, operational, and business considerations to achieve practical, business-focused outcomes.

What You Will Bring

  • Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law.
  • 5-7+ years of relevant legal experience.
  • Recognized expertise advising on defined contribution plans and multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) plans, including plan qualification, contributions, administration, fiduciary matters, operational compliance, correction programs, and related ERISA and tax issues.
  • Experience advising on multiple employer plans (MEP) and pooled employer plans (PEP), including plans sponsors by a professional employer organization (PEO).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ERISA, the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, IRS and Department of Labor guidance, and other laws governing retirement and employee benefit plans.
  • Proven ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, business-focused advice that supports both ongoing operations and strategic business initiatives.
  • Experience partnering with business leaders and influencing decisions across multiple business functions.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to navigate complex legal and business issues with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate sophisticated legal concepts clearly to legal and non-legal audiences.

What Will Set You Apart

  • In-house experience supporting retirement plan recordkeeping, financial services, insurance, trust, custody, asset management, or other employee benefits or financial services organizations.
  • Deep expertise across defined contribution plans, multiemployer (Taft-Hartley) plans, and the laws governing retirement and employee benefit plans.
  • Experience advising on health and welfare plans and CDH benefit arrangements.
  • Experience supporting both the ongoing operation and strategic growth of retirement or other employee benefits businesses, including product enhancements, operational transformation, and client-focused initiatives.
  • Experience interacting directly with IRS and Department of Labor regulators and managing examinations, audits, or enforcement matters.
  • Demonstrated success building strong cross-functional relationships and providing practical legal advice that advances business objectives while effectively managing legal and regulatory risk.***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup

raw.description:
schön, dass du hier bist

Als wachsende D2C Brand ist die langfristige Bindung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden einer der wichtigsten Erfolgsfaktoren unseres Unternehmens.

Du verstehst CRM als Wachstumstreiber und setzt Deine Ideen selbst um. Du verbindest Daten, Kreativität und Business-Verständnis, um Kundinnen und Kunden langfristig zu begeistern. AI und Automationen gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag: Du nutzt sie, um schneller zu testen, Abläufe zu verbessern und mehr zu bewegen.

Please note that German residency and a C1/C2 German level are prerequisites for this role. Unfortunately we can't consider applications that don't fulfil those requirements.

die stelle

  • Du konzipierst, baust und optimierst CRM-Maßnahmen – von E-Mail-Flows und Kampagnen bis zu Segmentierung und personalisierter Kundenansprache.
  • Du analysierst das Wiederkaufverhalten unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen für mehr Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value ab.
  • Du setzt regelmäßig Tests auf, wertest Ergebnisse aus und entwickelst erfolgreiche Ansätze weiter. Dabei zählen pragmatische Umsetzung und schnelles Lernen.
  • Du nutzt AI und Automationen, um unsere Retention-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und den Weg von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu verkürzen.
  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Retention, E-Commerce und Management zusammen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der operativen Arbeit; perspektivisch kannst Du auch fachliche Führung übernehmen.

das bringst du idealerweise mit*

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre operative Erfahrung in Retention oder CRM im E-Commerce oder D2C.
  • Du hast Flows, Kampagnen und Tests selbst umgesetzt und kannst zeigen, welchen Beitrag sie zum Geschäftserfolg geleistet haben.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Kundenansprache, Wiederkaufrate und Customer Lifetime Value.
  • Du setzt AI bereits produktiv ein und hast Erfahrung damit, wiederkehrende Aufgaben und Prozesse zu automatisieren.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit unserem Tool-Stack aus Klaviyo, Klar, Chatarmin, n8n und Claude mit.
  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten, entscheidest pragmatisch und bleibst dran, bis eine Idee live ist und Wirkung zeigt.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und arbeitest gern mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen.
  • Erfahrung mit stark wachsenden Brands, personalisierter Kundenkommunikation oder Abo-Modellen ist ein Plus. Ebenso erste Führungserfahrung oder Interesse an einer späteren Teamlead-Rolle.
  • Dein Arbeitsort liegt in Deutschland. Du kannst Dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und auf Englisch gut im beruflichen Alltag verständigen.

das möchten wir dir bieten

  • Full Mobile Office Work & Flexibilität: Arbeite deutschlandweit mit maximalem Vertrauen
  • 30 Urlaubstage + 2 Charity-Tage on top
  • Corporate Benefits, Fitnesszuschuss, mentale Gesundheits-Plattform (Nilo Health)
  • Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, Tierpatenschaft, Teamevents, Produktpakete
  • Und am wichtigsten: immer ein offenes Ohr für dich!

bist du überzeugt?

*Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, nicht Computern - wenn etwas nicht ganz auf dich zutrifft, deine Skills und Werte sonst aber zu uns passen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung:-)

Schau' wenige Tage nach dem Versenden deiner Bewerbung sicherheitshalber bitte auch in deinem Spam-Ordner nach einer Mail von uns nach.

Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

The Software Support Engineer serves as a primary customer-facing technical resource supporting Candescent’s Digital Insight Software Solutions and integrated third-party vendor products. This role requires a strong service mindset, collaborative approach, and the ability to diagnose and resolve routine and semi-routine technical issues while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.

Software Support Engineer team members act as trusted advisors to high-profile customers, helping them get up and running, troubleshoot issues, apply best practices, and maximize the value of Candescent offerings. Customer Support & Service Delivery

  • Serve as a primary interface for customers (assisted and self-support) during onboarding, issue resolution, and ongoing support

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve known technical issues using defined practices, procedures, and company policies

  • Match customer needs to the appropriate Digital Insight offerings and recommend best-practice usage

  • Deliver clear guidance and training to customers on how to effectively use supported solutions

  • Maintain a strong focus on successful customer outcomes and customer satisfaction

Case Management & Documentation

  • Manage multiple customer cases and small projects concurrently

  • Create clear, concise, and accurate case documentation

  • Ensure timely, appropriate escalations with fully documented issue details

  • Effectively frame, update, reuse, and contribute knowledge to support resources

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

  • Create knowledge base articles when solutions are known but not yet documented

  • Contribute to and improve existing knowledge content

  • Identify, communicate, and participate in process improvement opportunities

  • Share learnings, problems, and solutions with team members and cross-functional partners

Collaboration & Brand Representation

  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams across Candescent and Digital Insight Software Solutions

  • Represent the Candescent brand professionally in all customer interactions

  • Adapt communication style to customer needs, including de-escalating emotionally charged situations

Most Highly Valued Skills

  • Consistently delivers successful customer outcomes

  • Builds and maintains delighted, long-term customer relationships

  • Produces clear and thorough case documentation

  • Actively contributes to the Knowledge Base

  • Executes timely and appropriate escalations

  • Recommends and supports process improvements

  • Effectively balances case workload and concurrent projects

  • Demonstrates strong brand and customer advocacy

  • Flexes communication style to meet diverse customer needs

  • Clearly documents and shares technical problems and solutions

Technical Skills & Qualifications

  • Ability to analyze and diagnose technical problems and apply known solutions

  • Working knowledge of the most commonly used Digital Insight offerings and their capabilities

  • Ability to proactively apply product functionality to customer scenarios

  • Proficient in general computer and technical troubleshooting skills

  • Ability to differentiate between issues caused by Digital Insight offerings and non–Digital Insight factors

  • Comfortable working on routine or semi-routine assignments under established procedures

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. raw.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a highly analytical and solutions-oriented Revenue Operations Analyst to partner with our Sales Leaders in driving scalable growth. This role will leverage data insights, experimental design, and structured processes to help manage expanding sales teams, improve productivity, and ensure the organization is equipped to execute with efficiency.


The ideal candidate is both a critical thinker and a builder—comfortable with analytics, systems, and experimentation—who can translate insights into operational strategies that drive revenue performance.

You Are:

  • Analytical. You are an expert in interpreting data, spotting trends, and identifying actionable insights.
  • Strategic. You understand how to connect the dots between data and business objectives.
  • Detail-Oriented. You ensure accuracy in your analysis and clarity in your reporting.
  • Communicative. You can translate complex concepts into simple, actionable guidance for all levels of the organization.

You Will:

  • Partner with Sales Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, providing data-driven insights, forecasting support, and performance analysis to guide decision-making.
  • Sales Team Performance Management: Build and maintain reporting frameworks, scorecards, and performance metrics to track attainment, productivity, and pipeline health across teams and individuals. Provide insights that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Sales Productivity & Prioritization: Develop frameworks and tools to help reps prioritize high-value activities, focus on the right accounts, and increase efficiency across the funnel.
  • Sales Admin Management: Support and streamline sales administrative processes (territory assignments, quota setting, incentive tracking, CRM hygiene) to reduce time spent on non-selling activities and ensure accuracy in reporting.
  • Experimental Design & Insights: Apply the science of testing and control (A/B tests, pilots, cohort analysis) to evaluate sales strategies, incentive programs, and process changes.
  • Scalability & Structure: Design repeatable processes, dashboards, and reporting structures that enable management of larger and more complex sales teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and recommend improvements to increase sales effectiveness and coverage.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to align revenue operations initiatives with broader business goals.

Must Have’s:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role within Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analyst, or a similar function.
  • Advanced proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Domo, Power BI, Looker) and creating impactful dashboards.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, advanced formulas).
  • Strong experience with CRM systems, particularly Salesforce, including report generation and dashboard creation.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI/automation tools in the workplace to improve efficiency, streamline processes, or scale reporting/insights.
  • Strong understanding of sales metrics and sales processes.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and moderate technical skills for data querying, transformation, and modeling.

Nice to Have’s:

  • Experience with SQL or Python for data extraction and modeling.
  • Knowledge of lead scoring, account-based marketing (ABM), and customer lifecycle management.
  • Ability to travel when required (2-5 times per year)

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

  • Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

  • Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program

  • Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

  • Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

  • Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

  • Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range of

Annual Salary: $70,000.00 - $95,000.00

(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


The Senior Manager Stock Plan Participant Services is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of Empower's Stock Plan Participant Services team, ensuring participants receive timely, accurate, and high-quality support across all equity compensation plan types. This leader is accountable for supervising Equity Compensation Consultants to achieve their individual and team business goals, driving operational excellence, maintaining regulatory compliance, and delivering an exceptional participant experience through effective coaching, process execution, and service delivery.

Working closely with the Director of Stock Plan Participant Services and cross-functional partners, the Senior Manager ensures service standards are consistently achieved, operational procedures are executed effectively, business goals are met, and the team is equipped to support participants through trading, equity education, and stock plan transactions.

What You Will Do


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Equity Compensation Consultants to achieve individual and team business goals through exceptional participant service and equity compensation consultations.
  • Oversee daily operations of the Stock Plan Participant Services team, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality support across equity compensation plan types.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, and coaching sessions to support employee engagement, professional development, and accountability.
  • Manage staffing, scheduling, workload distribution, and service coverage to achieve operational efficiency and established service standards.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex participant inquiries, trading-related issues, operational exceptions, and service concerns.
  • Supervise participant trading support and stock plan transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 trading plans and Rule 144 transactions, in accordance with established procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure participants receive accurate information regarding equity compensation plans, trading procedures, stock plan transactions, and available financial resources.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including service levels, quality, productivity, participant satisfaction, and operational accuracy.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and collaborate with leadership to implement process improvements, technology enhancements, and service delivery solutions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, case management practices, supervisory controls, and adherence to established operational procedures.
  • Ensure team compliance with Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and internal supervisory requirements.
  • Review operational activities, identify potential regulatory and operational risks, and escalate issues through appropriate channels.
  • Support internal audits, compliance reviews, quality assurance activities, and supervisory control processes.
  • Collaborate with Workplace Stock Plan Services, Operations, Compliance, Trading, Technology, and other cross-functional partners to resolve participant issues and support issuer expectations.
  • Support associate onboarding, training, departmental initiatives, and implementation of new products, procedures, and technology.
  • Provide leadership with operational insights, participant trends, performance results, and recommendations to improve service delivery.

What You Will Bring


  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in equity compensation, stock plan services, wealth management, or financial services
  • Strong knowledge of equity compensation plans, stock plan administration, participant servicing, and brokerage operations
  • Experience overseeing operational workflows and service delivery within a regulated financial services environment
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and motivate teams to achieve individual and organizational performance goals
  • Strong understanding of complex equity compensation transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 trading plans and Rule 144 transactions
  • Active FINRA Series 7, Series 24 (or both Series 9 and Series 10 in lieu of Series 24), and Series 65 or Series 66 registrations at the time of hire
  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation required within corporate approved timelines
  • FINRA Fingerprinting required

What Will Set You Apart


  • 2 or more years of people leadership or supervisory experience
  • Experience leading participant service teams within an equity compensation, stock plan administration, brokerage services, or wealth management organization
  • Experience supporting complex equity compensation plans, including restricted stock units (RSUs), employee stock purchase plans (ESPPs), stock options, and other equity-based awards
  • Experience using stock plan administration platforms, brokerage trading systems, customer relationship management (CRM) tools, or case management applications
  • Demonstrated success improving operational performance, service quality, participant satisfaction, and team productivity through data-driven coaching and process improvements
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, supervisory controls, and risk management activities within a FINRA-regulated brokerage environment
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to implement operational enhancements, technology solutions, and participant service initiatives

For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
