Key priorities include co-developing and executing operational processes and documentation, supporting new project deployments, and providing comprehensive post-COD support—from issue identification and resolution to project reporting, system testing, compliance, and analytics.

By combining strategic leadership with operational excellence, this role ensures that energy storage projects deliver lasting value to both customers and the business.

  • Support/Lead/Facilitate internal and external Root Cause Analysis and Management of Change Activities

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Highly developed interpersonal skills with ability to interface with multiple levels of customer organization.
  • Deep planning, organizing and coordination experience among multiple stakeholders to achieve common goals directly impacting business performance.
  • Project Management, meeting leadership and facilitation experience.
  • Excellent MS Office; SCADA Experience; MODBUS Experience
  • Must be willing and able to travel up to 50% of the time in support of existing & new Energy Storage fleet

In compliance with California pay transparency regulations, the base salary range for this position is $173,000.00 - $216,000.00+ per year. Final compensation will depend on experience and qualifications.

Our Culture

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. All In

We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

Partner with the best

About the Role:
As part of our ambitious growth plans, Eyelit Technologies (Eyelit) is expanding its presence across Europe. We offer a rare opportunity to contribute to a fast-scaling business with a differentiated product offering, combining startup-style innovation with the resources, client base, and stability of an established market leader.

The Senior Sales Account Executive will be responsible for winning new business and driving revenue by selling our manufacturing plant focused full stack solution suite including Planning, Scheduling, and Execution (SIOP, APS, and MES) solutions to complex manufacturing enterprises. You will play a critical role in our growth strategy, working closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to fuel expansion and build strong strategic partnerships.

Our sales are Industry focused based on plant level positioning. For this role, a successful candidate will have deep plant and multi-plant APS/MES sales experience within the complex manufacturing marketplace with a history of successful sales in A&D preferred.

Your Responsibilities:
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, position, negotiate, and close new enterprise accounts at the plant level within the complex manufacturing sector.
  • Drive revenue growth through new logo acquisition by positioning Eyelit’s full stack solution suite designed to drive plant and multi-plant benefits across multiple software categories including SIOP, APS, and MES. The nature of the suite enables customers to close the gap between planning and execution through a unified data model and AI enabled decision making and inference.
  • Detail a sales strategy for each opportunity which includes a plant level solution thesis, pain points, power map, value prop, process analysis, demo strategy, pricing, competitor analysis, differentiation positioning, and deal resource planning.
  • Demonstrate the ability to develop and execute a step-by-step sales playbook targeting decision makers and stakeholders at the plant and multi-plant levels laying out all activities and planned outcomes to achieve the win.
  • Develop and execute both ABM and install base expansion account plans, consistently building a strong pipeline of high-quality opportunities.
  • Provide accurate forecasting based on realistic opportunity progression and close timelines.
  • Influence product roadmaps by sharing field insights and customer feedback with Product Management and Executive Leadership.
  • Collaborate internally with Sales Engineering, Services Delivery, and Product teams to drive seamless client engagement and implementation.
  • Maintain up-to-date opportunity and customer records within CRM (HubSpot preferred).
Experience and Education:
  • 10+ years of successful experience selling, plant and multi plant APS and MES to manufacturing plant leadership.
  • Strong experience selling into sectors such as A&D, medical devices, and industrial.
  • A proven hunter mindset with a consistent track record of closing new named accounts and exceeding $1MM+ ARR sales targets.
  • Skilled in consultative, value-based selling techniques and capable of building compelling business cases to multiple constituencies (e.g., Manufacturing Ops, Finance, IT, Demand Management, Plant Leadership).
  • Ability to penetrate and sell to plant-level decision-makers and influence complex buying groups.
  • Previous experience working in a North American-based or global software company is a strong asset.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Fluency in English; additional languages a plus.

raw.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Modern Workplace Engineering Manager is a technical people-leader responsible for the daily operation, engineering, and continuous improvement of Southern New Hampshire University's Modern Workplace services. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and administrators while remaining actively engaged in technical design, troubleshooting, implementation, and escalation support across Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration, identity, automation, and related technologies.

You will translate departmental strategy into technical execution ensuring work is properly prioritized and delivered. You will develop the capabilities of the team, and provide hands-on technical leadership for complex or high-impact initiatives. The position requires a strong balance of people leadership, operational discipline, and current technical expertise. You will report to the Director of Modern Workplace Engineering.

What you'll do:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Modern Workplace engineers and administrators.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration, identity, security, automation, and device-management technologies.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex technical incidents, service disruptions, implementation challenges, and architectural decisions.
  • Participate directly in technical discovery, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and documentation when needed.
  • Review technical designs, implementation plans, scripts, configurations, and operational procedures for quality, security, scalability, and supportability.
  • Manage work intake, prioritization, resource assignment, execution, and follow-through across operational and project-based work.
  • Translate departmental strategy and institutional requirements into technical roadmaps, delivery plans, and team assignments.
  • Establish clear technical standards, engineering practices, documentation requirements, and accountability expectations.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, technical coaching, and professional-development planning.
  • Identify skill gaps and create opportunities for cross-training, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and technical growth.
  • Partner with the Director on platform strategy, architecture, workforce planning, budgeting, vendor management, and service improvement.
  • Coordinate technical delivery across Microsoft 365, Intune, Windows, macOS, MECM, Autopilot, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, Power Platform, Copilot, and related technologies.
  • Work with Information Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Service Management, and other ITS teams to design and deliver secure, reliable solutions.
  • Support incident, problem, change, request, release, and configuration-management practices.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to the Modern Workplace environment.
  • Develop automation and encourage the use of scripting, standardization, and repeatable engineering practices.
  • Monitor service performance, technical debt, workload distribution, platform health, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate technical risks, dependencies, status, resource needs, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Represent Modern Workplace Engineering in technical reviews, governance forums, project meetings, and operational discussions.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned

What we're looking for:

  • Seven or more years of progressive experience in Microsoft 365, endpoint engineering, infrastructure, systems administration, Modern Workplace technologies, or a related technical field.
  • Three or more years of formal people-management, supervisory, technical-leadership, or team-leadership experience.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in lieu of degree acceptable
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and at least two major Modern Workplace disciplines, such as endpoint management, collaboration, identity, automation, messaging, or device engineering.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and guiding engineers through resolution.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Experience reviewing technical designs, scripts, configurations, implementation plans, and operational documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching technical employees, managing performance, and supporting career development.
  • Experience managing competing operational priorities, escalations, projects, and technical resources.
  • Working knowledge of IT service-management, security, governance, and change-management practices.
  • Strong communication, decision-making, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

The annual pay range for this position is $94,130.00 - $150,634.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $104,012.00 - $140,723.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

The opportunity

The Senior Business Systems Analyst – Workday Adaptive Planning is a hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning administrator, model builder, and reporting expert responsible for the administration, development, optimization, and ongoing support of the organization's Workday Adaptive Planning environment.


This position is a key member of the Financial Analytics and Insights team and will play a critical role in expanding the organization's use of Adaptive Planning as an enterprise planning, reporting, and decision-support platform. The Senior Business Systems Analyst will have significant ownership of the Adaptive environment, including model development, configuration, reporting, dashboards, OfficeConnect, security, data management, system administration, and platform optimization.


You will bring demonstrated, hands-on experience building and administering Workday Adaptive Planning—not simply experience as an end-user. You will understand how to translate complex financial and operational requirements into well-designed Adaptive models, reports, dashboards, and planning solutions that are scalable, intuitive, controlled, and sustainable.


The role will partner closely with Finance, Human Resources, IT, and other business stakeholders to understand business requirements, improve planning and reporting processes, develop solutions, and maximize the value of the Adaptive Planning platform.


This is an opportunity for an experienced Adaptive Planning professional to play a significant role in shaping how the organization uses technology, data, and planning systems to support financial and workforce decision-making. You will report to the Senior Director Financial Analytics and Insights.



What you'll do:

  • Be the primary Workday Adaptive Planning administrator and subject matter expert, with responsibility for the day-to-day administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the platform.
  • Own and maintain Adaptive Planning structures, including models, dimensions, accounts, levels, versions, sheets, assumptions, formulas, business rules, attributes, and security.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Adaptive configurations, including model structures, dimensions, assumptions, formulas, calculations, workflows, and reporting solutions to support evolving budgeting, forecasting, reporting, workforce planning, and business requirements.
  • Manage Adaptive Planning user access, roles, permissions, and security while maintaining appropriate data governance and internal controls, while monitoring system performance, data integrity, integrations, and user experience and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration standards, technical documentation, and administrative procedures, as well as training materials, documentation, user guides, and other resources that support effective adoption as well as conduct training and knowledge-transfer sessions for users and stakeholders.
  • Design and build Adaptive Planning models and planning solutions that apply strong understanding of FP&A processes to ensure that the solutions appropriately support financial planning and management practices, that balance flexibility and usability with appropriate controls, standardization, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to define complex reporting requirements and translate those requirements into effective Adaptive reporting solutions supporting budgets, forecasts, actuals, variances, trends, workforce metrics, and other key financial and operational measures.
  • Partner with Human Resources to develop and maintain workforce planning models and reporting solutions within Adaptive Planning.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, reconcile and troubleshoot integrations and data flows between Workday Financial Management, Workday HCM, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Partner with FINSYS, HRIS and ITS and other technical teams on complex integrations, data architecture, APIs, and technical issues.
  • Facilitate discussions with business stakeholders to understand underlying business needs and evaluate alternative solutions and recommend approaches that balance business requirements, system capabilities, scalability, controls, and maintainability.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of progressive hands-on experience in an administrator, developer, model builder, reporting, or systems analyst capacity of which 3+ years utilizing the Workday Adaptive Planning system.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field. Equivalent years of experience in lieu of degree acceptable.
  • Demonstrated experience developing complex Adaptive Planning reports, dashboards, and management reporting solutions.
  • Experience withAdaptive OfficeConnect, including development and maintenance of management reporting packages.
  • Strong experience working with Adaptive Planning dimensions, accounts, levels, versions, sheets, assumptions, formulas, calculations, business rules, and model structures.
  • Experience creating in/out bound integrations between Workday Financial Management, Workday HCM, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Strong understanding of financial planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and variance analysis.

If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.


Compensation


The annual pay range for this position is $80,128.00 - $128,226.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $88,540.00 - $119,788.00.

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

raw.description:
Strategic Risk Solutions Inc. (SRS) is seeking a Senior Account Manager, Captive Insurance to oversee a portfolio of captive insurance company clients.

The successful candidate will be responsible for client service delivery, financial statement oversight, regulatory reporting, audit coordination, board meeting preparation, and account team leadership. This position requires substantial captive insurance experience and the ability to serve as a senior-level resource for clients and colleagues.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting knowledge with exceptional client relationship skills and a passion for delivering outstanding service in a specialized insurance environment.



Why Join SRS?
  • Move beyond traditional accounting into a specialized, client-facing captive insurance career.
  • Manage accounting and regulatory deliverables for captive insurance companies, including risk retention groups.
  • Build deeper technical expertise through more complex account work.
  • Expand your review responsibilities and support the development of junior team members.
  • Collaborate with clients, auditors, regulators, service providers, and experienced SRS colleagues.
  • Grow within a niche industry where accounting accuracy, client service, and business judgment matter.

Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of captive insurance clients.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client executives, board members, regulators, auditors, actuaries, tax advisors, and banking partners.

  • Lead client meetings and participate in board meetings and strategic planning discussions.

  • Provide timely and professional written and verbal communication regarding client financial, regulatory, and operational matters.

Financial Reporting & Accounting Oversight

  • Review and oversee preparation of financial statements and supporting schedules.

  • Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and accounting deliverables.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Support statutory reporting and NAIC-related filings where applicable.

Regulatory & Compliance Management

  • Oversee preparation and submission of domicile regulatory filings.

  • Coordinate annual reports, premium tax filings, and other regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with regulators and external service providers to ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist clients in responding to regulatory inquiries and examinations.

Audit & Examination Support

  • Manage annual financial statement audits and regulatory examinations.

  • Coordinate information requests, documentation, and communication among auditors, regulators, and clients.

  • Review audit deliverables and ensure timely issue resolution.

Leadership & Team Development

raw.description:
Job Title: Account Manager  

Compensation Range: $80,000-90,000 Base + Commission (OTE $140,000-150,000)  

Location: This role can be remote anywhere in the US.  

Become one of the changemakers. At Quid, you won’t just be joining a team but contributing to a culture of innovation, where every challenge becomes an opportunity to learn and grow. When you join our team, you’re not just stepping into a job—you’re embracing a future where we lead the game with the unmatched advantage of foresight.  

Position Overview

As an Account Manager at Quid, you will own the success, retention, and growth of a portfolio of customers. You will manage the full post-sale customer lifecycle—from onboarding and adoption through renewal, contract execution, and expansion—while serving as the customer’s primary relationship owner and internal advocate.

This role blends strategic account management, customer success, and program management. You will help customers achieve measurable value from Quid, monitor product adoption and account health, coordinate complex customer initiatives, and manage renewals from early planning through signature. The ideal candidate is a proactive, strategic, and execution-oriented Account Manager with the technical aptitude to understand customer workflows, identify barriers to adoption, and coordinate the right resources to solve them.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Success and Adoption

  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s priorities, use cases, desired outcomes, and measures of success.

  • Create and manage customer success and adoption plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, risks, and next steps.

  • Monitor product usage, engagement, support trends, and stakeholder participation to identify risks and opportunities early.

  • Recommend training, configuration, workflows, or additional capabilities that improve adoption and customer value.

  • Conduct strategic business reviews that connect Quid usage and outcomes to the customer’s broader priorities.

Relationship and Program Management

  • Build strong relationships across users, champions, program owners, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and executive sponsors.

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for customer initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and internal teams.

  • Establish clear objectives, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and follow-up actions.

  • Maintain momentum between meetings and hold internal and external stakeholders accountable for commitments.

  • Act as the voice of the customer and share actionable feedback with Product, Engineering, Support, Education, and leadership.

Technical and Product Fluency

  • Develop a strong working knowledge of Quid’s platform, product configuration, data sources, workflows, integrations, usage reporting, and AI capabilities.

  • Help determine whether customer challenges stem from product limitations, configuration, adoption, enablement, or business processes.

  • Translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, and customer technical teams to resolve challenges and improve the customer experience.

Renewals and Contract Execution

  • Own renewal strategy and execution for an assigned book of business, including retention, upsell, and cross-sell goals.

  • Begin renewal planning early by confirming stakeholders, timelines, budgets, decision criteria, procurement requirements, and potential risks.

  • Manage renewals through pricing, proposal development, contract preparation, procurement, legal, security and AI reviews, negotiation, signature, and internal handoff.

  • Maintain accurate renewal and expansion forecasts, clearly documenting risk, expected outcomes, last steps, next steps, and required support.

Growth and Account Planning

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on customer outcomes, emerging business needs, additional use cases, and opportunities across departments or business units.

  • Develop account plans covering customer goals, stakeholders, adoption, risks, renewal strategy, and growth opportunities.

  • Multi-thread customer relationships to reduce reliance on a single contact and strengthen the overall partnership.

  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with the appropriate internal stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, contract, and activity information in Quid’s systems of record.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Gross and net revenue retention

  • Renewal and expansion performance

  • Timely and successful contract execution

  • Product adoption and customer engagement

  • Customer health and risk mitigation

  • Achievement of documented customer outcomes

  • Forecast accuracy and account-plan execution

  • Strength and breadth of customer relationships

Requirements

  • Five to seven years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, or another customer-facing commercial role, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.

  • Demonstrated history of exceptional performance, with consistent renewal, retention, and growth results that have placed you among the top 5–10% of performers in your current and previous roles.

  • Proven success retaining and growing a book of business while helping customers achieve measurable outcomes.

  • Experience owning renewals and managing commercial and contractual processes through negotiation and signature.

  • Strong program-management skills, including the ability to coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives through completion.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand product configuration, usage data, workflows, and integrations.

  • Ability to interpret customer-health and adoption signals and translate them into clear actions.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation, forecasting, communication, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to build credibility with users, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, and senior executives.

  • Exceptional organization, accountability, and follow-through.

  • Bachelor’s degree

Total Rewards

  • 20 days of paid time off

  • 12 company holidays

  • Company-provided equipment

  • 401(k) with company match

  • FSA and HSA options

  • Paid parental leave and reintegration program

  • Employee wellness resources

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Four-week sabbatical after five years

Still Not Sure? 

We understand many candidates tend to only apply for jobs if they meet every single requirement listed. However, if you’re genuinely enthusiastic about this position and confident in your ability to excel, we strongly urge you to submit your application! You might just be the perfect fit for this role—or another exciting opportunity within Quid.  

Remote Work! 

We’ve been passionate about remote work since day one! Our team is comfortable collaborating across different time zones. While we’re excited about future growth and expansion, certain legal restrictions require that we can only accept candidates eligible to work in the United States.  

About Quid   

Quid helps business leaders turn complexity into clarity, and clarity into outcomes. 
We leverage our proprietary AI to listen to the market at scale, leveraging billions of conversations, articles, and signals, and translates that noise into clarity. Then we go further: we show you our customers how to act on it. 
Whether it’s protecting brand health, driving in-season sales, fueling product innovation, or shaping company strategy, Quid raises the bar for what business leaders should demand.   
We’re not a dashboard company. We’re an outcome engineering organization, relentless in our focus on helping organizations make smarter and bolder decisions that drive positive outcomes for their business. 
Quid has been featured in Forbes, Fortune, The Stanford AI Index, and more, highlighting our leadership in the consumer and market intelligence space, and illustrating  how Quid helps organizations achieve their business outcomes to stay ahead of their competition.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritise candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling's broader suite of products. This position will play an important part of our team covering the APAC region. As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadKeystead, an AI-native insurance brokerage venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Keysteadis an insurance brokerage built for the small businesses traditional brokers can't afford to serve. AI agents run the full workflow, from intake and multi-carrier quoting to binding and certificates of insurance, with licensed agents stepping in where judgment matters. Keystead starts with the businesses that need proof of coverage again and again, such as contractors, event vendors, and product brands selling into retail. For these owners, a certificate that takes days to arrive can cost them the job. Keystead issues it in minutes, explains coverage in plain language, and re-shops the market at every renewal.

Market Context

Roughly 35M small businesses in the US are underserved by a broker model built for larger accounts. Across the US and Canada, small business insurance represents a $6.2B commission pool. About $4.5B of that comes from businesses that already carry commercial insurance. Digital buying is proven, with the leading digital insurer serving more than 750K small businesses. The multi-carrier, servicing-first model remains open.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across insurtech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with small business owners in certificate-heavy verticals, convert them to bound policies, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to commercial P&C insurance distribution, such as agency, brokerage, MGA, or insurtech experience, ideally with carrier relationships or a producer license

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, We deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE GTM TEAM

The Go-to-Market team at GenLogs is responsible for bringing our nationwide commercial-vehicle intelligence platform to the agencies and enterprises that depend on trustworthy, real-time freight visibility. We work directly with state and federal law-enforcement partners, departments of transportation, ports, shippers, carriers, and brokers to define problems, scope operational deployments, and scale high-impact programs. As the commercial face of GenLogs, we translate the capabilities of our sensor network and freight intelligence data platform into clear value propositions that strengthen public safety, reduce fraud and theft, and improve supply-chain reliability. The team operates with urgency, precision, and deep market understanding, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to ensure our solutions solve the most important problems in the freight ecosystem.

ABOUT THE JOB

As we expand our Go-to-Market team, the Business Development Representative will play a foundational role in building a predictable revenue engine and shaping GenLogs’ presence in the market.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) drives top-of-funnel pipeline across LSPs, Shippers, and accounts within GenLogs’ commercial auto insurance vertical. This includes working with retailers, wholesalers, carriers, and MGAs.

This role requires strong communication skills, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to operate within both mid-market and enterprise outbound motions. Based on experience, candidates may focus on strategic enterprise accounts or mid-market accounts.

You will work closely with Account Executives, Product, and Customer Success to understand buyer pain points, refine and develop messaging, and contribute to the broader go-to-market strategy.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Outbound Prospecting

  • Research and identify high-quality prospects across logistics and commercial auto insurance verticals.
  • Execute consistent multichannel outreach including calls, email, and LinkedIn.
  • Tailor outreach to specific workflows across logistics and insurance stakeholders, including underwriting, claims, operations, compliance, and distribution channels.
  • Maintain daily activities and expectations to generate a healthy volume of qualified meetings.

Qualification & Discovery

  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges.
  • Align prospect pain points with GenLogs’ capabilities, particularly within the commercial auto insurance ecosystem.
  • Qualify prospects to sales qualified leads based on defined criteria including fit, need, urgency, and role alignment.
  • Schedule meetings for Account Executives with clear, detailed handoff notes.

Collaboration & Internal Alignment

  • Work closely with Account Executives to prioritize accounts and refine outreach strategy.
  • Provide ongoing feedback to Product based on prospect objections, market signals, and emerging trends within the commercial auto insurance industry.
  • Support GTM initiatives tied to industry events through pre-event booking and post-event follow-up.

Systems, Reporting & Process Excellence

  • Maintain accurate data, notes, and qualification details in Salesforce.
  • Utilize sales engagement tools to improve productivity and streamline outbound workflows.
  • Participate in weekly meetings to review performance, account progress, and outbound results.
  • Contribute to the evolution of outbound playbooks, ICP profiles, and messaging frameworks.

Why Join?

  • Opportunity to help build the outbound function from the ground up.
  • Direct access to GTM leadership and high visibility across the organization.
  • Impactful role within a fast-growing logistics technology company.
  • Ability to influence messaging, strategy, and market penetration early in the GTM journey.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience selling transportation insurance or selling technology/data solutions to insurance organizations within the transportation and logistics space.
  • Experience in SaaS, Logistics, or Insurance (especially commercial auto) is a strong plus.
  • Commercial auto insurance industry knowledge preferred, with experience across multiple verticals (e.g., retailers, wholesalers, carriers, MGAs).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
  • Comfort with cold outreach and consistent outbound prospecting activity.
  • Coachable, driven, and reliable in daily execution and follow-through.
  • Experience using Salesforce and sales engagement tools.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment.

US SALARY RANGE

GenLogs establishes compensation based on role, level, experience, and location. Salary bands are benchmarked against high-growth technology companies and adjusted for market conditions.

BENEFITS

Healthcare

  • Employer-covered comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Employer contribution towards premiums of optional higher-end plans

Time Off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Sick leave
  • Company holidays (GenLogs observes all US Government holidays)
  • Flexible leave for caregiving and medical needs

Family Support

  • Paid parental leave

Professional Development

  • Budget availability for approved professional development courses, certifications, and training

Travel Support

  • 100% travel reimbursement for all approved company travel and spending

Retirement Savings

  • 401(k) plan

A recruiter can provide more detail about the specific compensation and benefits associated with this role.

Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

Poznaj Onwelo

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 400 specjalistów z silnymi kompetencjami seniorskim, a na koncie mamy 300+ zrealizowanych projektów dla dużych organizacji w Polsce, Europie i USA. Działamy z kilku polskich miast oraz z biur w Niemczech, Szwajcarii i USA, łącząc lokalną obecność z globalnym zasięgiem.

O projekcie

  • Projektowanie i tworzenie raportów oraz interaktywnych dashboardów w Microsoft Power BI

raw.description:
Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування.

Щомісяця мільйони людей у 66 країнах світу використовують Jooble для пошуку роботи та найму талантів. За цим стоїть команда з понад 300 професіоналів, які поєднують глибоку експертизу в аналітиці, технологіях та роботі з даними, щоб зробити цей процес простішим і ефективнішим.

Сьогодні Jooble входить до ТОП-10 найвідвідуваніших сайтів світу у сегменті Jobs and Employment, підтверджуючи свій глобальний вплив.

Про роль

Ми шукаємо креативного маркетинг-спеціаліста з досвідом від 2 років у B2C продукті (мобільний застосунок або вебпродукт), який буде створювати та тестувати рекламний контент для зниження CAC і підвищення ER у воронці залучення користувачів.

Приєднавшись до команди Jooble, ти отримуєш:

  • Зростання в індустрії: Jooble вже 20 років фокусується на пошуку роботи й продовжуватиме цей фокус, тож це твоя можливість для довгострокових ідей та впливу

  • Чесну користь для юзерів: ми допомагаємо людям знаходити роботу

  • Сильну внутрішню експертизу в performance marketing з мільйонами користувачів щомісяця

  • Глобальний вплив у 66 країнах

У цій ролі ти будеш:

  • Формувати контент-гіпотези для paid acquisition в Google, Meta, TikTok;

  • Будувати та підтримувати контент-тестинг флоу, щоб узгоджувати дата-інсайти з дизайн-брифами;

  • Відстежувати ефективність контенту та запобігати його «вигоранню»;

  • Брифувати внутрішню дизайн-команду та зовнішніх креаторів для тестування гіпотез;

  • Масштабувати найкращі рішення на різні ринки та аудиторні сегменти;

  • Вибудовувати AI-пайплайни для контенту, щоб мінімізувати рутину;

  • Спільно з командою paid traffic розробляти тактики acquisition під конкретні канали, ринки або сегменти юзерів;

  • Проводити конкурентний research, декомпозувати елементи реклами та виокремлювати best practices;

  • Тісно співпрацювати з performance marketing спеціалістами, user acquisition, design та аналітикою для досягнення вагомих бізнес-результатів.

Необхідні навички та досвід:

  • Досвід від 1 року у створенні контенту (digital, SMM) для mobile app або web продукту в кількох гео;

  • Розуміння вимог рекламних платформ (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads);

  • Досвід у ads копірайтингу;

  • Досвід експериментів з AI-тулами (Sora, NanoBanana, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, N8n тощо);

  • Аналітичне мислення, розуміння як впливати на performance marketing метрики (CAC, ER, CTR, CPM);

  • Зацікаваленість приносити нові ідеї та підходи;

  • Вміння декомпозувати ідеї на тестовані елементи;

  • Самомотивація та здатність брати ownership за таски та проєкти;

  • Амбіція впливати на глобальний продукт і бренд у 66 країнах;

  • Англійська на рівні B2+;

  • Комфортна робота в крос-функціональних командах та вміння тримати в голові кілька контекстів одночасно.

Якщо ти готовий/а впливати на життя мільйонів людей у всьому світі — надсилай резюме, і ми зв’яжемося з тобою найближчим часом.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking an Engagement Manager to lead the implementation of AI-driven initiatives powered by QVAC, Tether’s SDK for local AI and delegated inference. The role focuses on orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder deployments of decentralized AI solutions across enterprise, government, and institutional environments.

This position combines client engagement, technical coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure successful onboarding and execution of AI use cases, ranging from edge AI deployments to privacy-preserving inference systems. The Engagement Manager plays a central role in aligning client objectives with product capabilities, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, and driving implementations from initial scoping through production rollout.

Responsibilities

Client & Partner Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients and partners during AI implementation initiatives, ensuring clear communication, expectation alignment, and structured execution.

  • Guide clients in translating business requirements into AI deployment strategies leveraging QVAC capabilities (local inference, delegated compute, privacy-preserving architectures).

  • Support Expansion team in shaping AI-related opportunities by providing input on feasibility, integration complexity, and delivery approach.

  • Identify opportunities to extend implementations across additional use cases, geographies, or Tether technologies.

Implementations Oversight

  • Lead end-to-end coordination of QVAC-based implementations from kickoff through production deployment.

  • Define implementation roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across AI models, infrastructure, and integration layers.

  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and actual product capabilities, avoiding scope drift or mispositioning.

  • Track progress across multiple concurrent AI deployments, ensuring timely delivery and readiness for production environments.

Cross-functional Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to align on QVAC capabilities, limitations, and roadmap evolution.

  • Facilitate integration between client systems and QVAC components, including model deployment pipelines, APIs, and compute environments.

  • Work with legal and compliance teams where required, particularly in sensitive AI deployments involving data locality or privacy constraints.

  • Maintain structured communication flows across all stakeholders involved in the implementation lifecycle.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks including implementation plans, risk tracking, and decision logs.

  • Produce executive-level updates summarizing progress, risks, blockers, and next steps.

  • Ensure documentation of implementation architectures, deployment patterns, and key learnings for reuse across future projects.

  • Support escalation management and ensure timely resolution of technical or operational challenges.

Requirements

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical account management, or delivery roles within AI, data infrastructure, or complex technology environments.

  • Proven experience managing cross-functional implementations involving multiple stakeholders (internal teams, clients, external partners).

  • Strong ability to operate at the intersection of technical and business domains.

Technical Understanding

  • Familiarity with AI/ML deployment concepts, including model inference, edge/local AI, and distributed compute architectures.

  • Understanding of APIs, SDK integrations, and system architecture patterns.

  • Ability to engage in technical discussions with engineering teams while maintaining business-level clarity with clients.

Communication & Execution

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with enterprise or government entities.

  • Structured approach to project tracking, documentation, and governance.

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate in fast-evolving, early-stage environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with decentralized technologies, blockchain, or privacy-preserving systems.

  • Exposure to AI infrastructure tooling or MLOps workflows.

  • Experience in regulated industries or public sector projects.

  • Basic familiarity with programming or scripting environments (Python, APIs, CLI tools).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

About the Team/Role

The Business Intelligence Analyst II serves as a technical architect and automation lead within one or more of the domain areas within the Global Risk Operations organization. You will leverage enterprise-approved tools—Tableau, Python, SQL, and RPA—to modernize legacy workflows and drive operational scale. This role is the bridge between theoretical efficiency and the deployment of hardened, audit-ready automation.


You are a change agent dedicated to the continuous improvement of the department’s technical and automation capabilities. Your success will be determined by your ability to modernize the risk landscape through governed self-service. You will be evaluated on three primary pillars - operational scale, efficiency and impact, and integrity and compliance.

How you'll make an impact

SOLUTION ENGINEERING & AUTOMATION DELIVERY

  • Workflow Transformation: Identify manual bottlenecks and engineer automated, self-service replacements that adhere to enterprise technical standards.
  • Infrastructure Lead: Build and maintain the technical infrastructure required to automate complex financial risk workflows across assigned regions.
  • Scaling through AI: Proactively integrate AI-driven technologies to eliminate manual touchpoints, creating a self-scaling environment that grows without increasing headcount.
  • Change Agency: Serve as a departmental catalyst for technical evolution, applying strategic thinking and process re-engineering to transform manual workflows into scalable, automated solutions.

ADVANCED ANALYTICS & DATA STEWARDSHIP

  • Strategic Data Assets: Transform raw data into strategic assets, utilizing advanced analytics to provide stakeholders with predictive insights.
  • Self-Service Ecosystems: Develop and manage standardized reporting environments (Power BI/Tableau) that empower stakeholders with real-time data while maintaining a single source of truth.
  • Efficiency Engineering: Design and deploy technical solutions specifically intended to drive measurable cost savings and mitigate operational risks.
  • Insight Delivery: Perform deep-dive analysis of trends to identify and illustrate emerging issues, providing management with clear direction and data-backed explanations.

OPERATIONAL EXECUTION & TECHNICAL INTEGRITY

  • Performance Tracking: Implement processes and reporting to track work items, volume, and turnaround time, ensuring accurate capture of required operational data.
  • Reporting Administration: Oversee the lifecycle of departmental reporting, including KPIs, management dashboards, and both scheduled and ad-hoc requirements.
  • Sustainable Automation: Deliver innovative alternatives to manual processes by continuously educating the team on current applications and automated technology.

COMPLIANCE, GOVERNANCE & SOLUTION INTEGRITY

  • Financial Controls and Compliance: Maintain rigorous standards for data integrity, ensuring all automated reports and workflows are fully compliant with regulatory and internal audit standards.
  • Technical Integrity: Oversee report administration and version control to ensure the longevity and reliability of deployed solutions.
  • Risk Mitigation: Ensure all self-service tools are built with robust error handling and audit trails to prevent operational drift.

These statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed rather than give an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities.


Experience you'll bring

Minimum Required Qualifications for Consideration


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance) OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience.
  • 2-4 years in a Finance or Risk Operations environment.
  • Foundational understanding of SOX or similar regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven history of successfully converting manual processes into automated, scalable workflows.
  • Proficiency in complex joins and ETL processes.
  • Python: Intermediate proficiency, specifically utilizing Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation.
  • RPA: Hands-on experience with enterprise platforms like UiPath or Power Automate.
  • Must have intermediate or better SQL and Oracle database experience, working with large data sets.
  • Must successfully pass a background investigation.

Competencies:

  • Analytical mind that can trouble-shoot, problem solve, and think logically through multifaceted issues and provide clear direction and explanation.
  • Ability to effectively and calmly operate within a complex, fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Self-motivated, solution oriented and results driven.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent time management, prioritization skills, goals setting, planning and work scheduling skills.
  • Superior critical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize and react to discrepancies.
  • Emerging Tech: Experience with Prompt Engineering and building RAG systems or using LLM APIs to enhance automation.
  • SAS programming skills.
  • Experience interpreting contractual terms.
  • Knowledge of WEX systems and business processes.
  • A high degree of professional curiosity and a "systems thinking" approach to problem-solving.

raw.description:
MEISTÄ

Tekniq on suomalainen teknisen alan asiantuntijayritys, joka toimii energia-, meri- ja teollisuussektorien vaativissa projekteissa Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti. Noin 80 ammattilaisen tiimimme tukee asiakkaitamme projektien eri vaiheissa suunnittelusta ja projektinhallinnasta työmaapalveluihin ja käyttöönottoon sekä toimii tilaajan teknisenä asiantuntijana ja edustajana.

Olemme mukana siellä, missä projektit tapahtuvat – suunnittelupöydältä työmaille ja käyttöönottoon. Työskentelemme alan johtavien yritysten kanssa teknisesti vaativissa hankkeissa.

Lead Engineer

Etsimme sähkötekniikan pääsuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan Tekniqin asiantuntijatiimiä sähköasemaprojektiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävässä vastaat sähköteknisen suunnittelun kokonaisuudesta ja varmistat, että suunnittelu etenee laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa. Toimit sähkösuunnittelijoiden teknisenä tukena ja pidät projektin suunnittelun langat käsissäsi aina piirustusten tarkastamisesta suunnittelun etenemisen seurantaan.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

  • sähköasemaprojektin sähkösuunnittelun koordinointi

  • sähkösuunnittelijoiden työn ohjaaminen ja tekninen tukeminen

  • sähköpiirustusten ja muun suunnitteludokumentaation tarkastaminen

  • suunnitteluratkaisujen teknisen laadun varmistaminen

  • suunnittelun aikataulun ja etenemisen seuranta

  • eri suunnitteluosapuolten välisen yhteistyön koordinointi

  • teknisten kysymysten ja suunnitteluun liittyvien haasteiden ratkaiseminen

  • suunnittelukokonaisuuden hallinta projektin eri vaiheissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa ymmärrystä sähköasemaprojekteista ja niiden teknisistä kokonaisuuksista. Tekninen taustasi auttaa sinua ymmärtämään projektien tarpeita, arvioimaan tarvittavaa osaamista ja tukemaan tiimisi asiantuntijoita heidän tehtävissään.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • sähköinsinöörin (AMK/DI) tai vastaavaa teknistä koulutusta

  • hyvää sähköpiirustusten ja teknisen dokumentaation tuntemusta

  • Fingridin teknisten vaatimusten ja suunnitteluohjeiden tuntemusta

  • kokemusta sähköasemien ensiö- ja/tai toisiolaitteista

  • kokemusta 110 kV:n tai sitä korkeampien jännitetasojen sähköasemista

  • vahvaa kokemusta sähköasemien suunnittelutehtävistä

  • kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ja viedä niitä järjestelmällisesti eteenpäin

  • valmiutta ottaa vastuuta suunnittelun laadusta ja aikataulussa pysymisestä

  • hyviä yhteistyö- ja kommunikointitaitoja

  • sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

Miksi Tekniq?

Tekniqillä työskentelet vaativien sähkö- ja energiahankkeiden parissa. Asiakasprojektien vaihtuessa myös työn sisältö, toimintaympäristö ja ratkaistavat tekniset kysymykset vaihtuvat. Yhdessä projektissa painopiste voi olla suunnittelun koordinoinnissa, toisessa teknisten ratkaisujen arvioinnissa tai suunnitelmien tarkastamisessa. Erilaiset hankkeet tuovat työhön vaihtelua ja haastavat hyödyntämään osaamistasi uusissa tilanteissa.

Pääsuunnittelijana saat paljon vapautta vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja työtapoihisi. Kokeneena asiantuntijana voit hyödyntää omaa näkemystäsi ja kokemustasi siinä, miten viet suunnittelua eteenpäin. Vapauden mukana tulee myös vastuu: pidät huolen siitä, että suunnittelukokonaisuus, tekninen laatu ja aikataulu pysyvät hallinnassa.

Työn tekemisessä joustavuus näkyy myös käytännössä. Tekniqin toimistot sijaitsevat Vaasassa ja Tampereella, mutta tehtävä ei ole sidottu kumpaankaan paikkakuntaan, vaan voit työskennellä joustavasti eri puolilta Suomea.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si ainoastaan virallisen rekrytointikanavamme kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Hakemalla tehtävää liityt samalla hakijaverkostoomme, jolloin voimme huomioida sinut myös tulevissa osaamistasi, kokemustasi ja uratoiveitasi vastaavissa mahdollisuuksissa.

Valmis seuraavaan haasteeseen? Tule mukaan Tekniqille toteuttamaan projekteja, joilla on merkitystä.

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The ASC Solutions Architect is the commercial solutioning and deal-architecture lead for complex ambulatory surgery center opportunities. This role partners with ASC Development Leaders, regional and account sales teams, product specialists, finance, Healthcare Financial Services, service, legal, compliance, operations, and other stakeholders to translate customer requirements into coordinated, customer-centered, financially sound, and executable multi-modality solutions. The Solutions Architect owns the development of integrated equipment and service bundles, configurations, quotes, financing pathways, deal economics, approval materials, and commercial execution plans while supporting a consistent experience from discovery through booked order and implementation handoff.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Configuration

  • Partner with the ASC Development Leader and commercial teams to translate the customer’s clinical strategy, procedure mix, facility plan, workflow, timeline, budget, and growth objectives into a coordinated solution architecture.
  • Design scalable ASC bundles across relevant GE HealthCare equipment, software, digital, service, training, and partner capabilities, balancing customer requirements, clinical workflow, standardization, implementation readiness, and commercial objectives.
  • Coordinate modality inputs, technical requirements, room and infrastructure assumptions, product dependencies, compatibility considerations, and configuration decisions. Document open items, owners, risks, and required decisions.
  • Develop repeatable standard configurations and modular ASC offerings that can be adapted to independent, health system, MSO, private equity, and joint-venture customer models.

Commercial and Financial Solutioning

  • Build and evaluate deal economics, including equipment and service scope, pricing, margin, customer value, projected savings, financing structure, cash-flow considerations, revenue recognition inputs, risk, and expected commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance and Healthcare Financial Services to evaluate capital purchase, lease, financing, phased deployment, and other approved commercial structures that align with the customer’s capital strategy and GE HealthCare requirements.
  • Perform horizontal pricing analysis across modalities and offerings, identify tradeoffs, and develop recommendations that improve competitiveness while maintaining pricing discipline, compliance, and profitability.
  • Prepare clear financial models, scenario comparisons, approval summaries, and executive-level decision materials that simplify complex data and enable timely action.

Quoting, Governance, and Approvals

  • Coordinate the development, consolidation, quality review, and submission of multi-modality quotes, proposals, single-signature packages, and supporting commercial documentation.
  • Engage required stakeholders early and facilitate pricing, risk, legal, compliance, contracting, finance, and Delegation of Authority reviews. Track approvals and resolve gaps or escalations.
  • Maintain strong process discipline in CRM, quoting tools, opportunity documentation, version control, assumptions, milestones, and handoffs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions comply with applicable company policies, pricing governance, commercial approval requirements, contracting standards, and customer commitments.

Pursuit and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the solution-development partner to the ASC Development Leader, who remains the opportunity quarterback and owner of market development, executive relationships, opportunity strategy, pipeline, forecast, and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional working sessions to align account sales, product specialists, clinical resources, service, applications, project management, installation, finance, legal, compliance, supply chain, and external partners around one solution and action plan.
  • Support customer-facing discovery and solution reviews when technical, financial, workflow, implementation, or commercial expertise is required.
  • Anticipate execution risks, dependencies, lead times, partner requirements, and implementation constraints, and develop practical mitigation plans before customer commitments are finalized.
  • Provide a structured handoff after contract execution or order booking so project, installation, service, applications, and clinical teams understand scope, assumptions, dependencies, and customer commitments.

Standard Work and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop, document, and continuously improve ASC solutioning standard work, intake requirements, configuration guides, financial templates, quote checklists, approval workflows, and handoff tools.
  • Apply Lean and structured problem-solving methods to identify root causes, remove delays and rework, simplify processes, and improve speed, quality, transparency, and scalability.
  • Capture lessons learned and provide upstream feedback to product, finance, commercial enablement, service, operations, and leadership to strengthen future ASC offerings.
  • Champion appropriate tools, analytics, automation, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve repeatability and team effectiveness.

Measures of Success

  • Time from qualified request to coordinated solution, approved quote, and customer-ready proposal.
  • Accuracy and completeness of configurations, pricing, financial models, documentation, and approval packages.
  • Multi-modality attach rate and adoption of repeatable ASC bundles and standard configurations.
  • Pricing and margin performance within approved guardrails, with transparent management of exceptions and risk.
  • Quality of cross-functional coordination, customer experience, implementation readiness, and post-booking handoffs.
  • Reduction in quote rework, cycle-time delays, missed dependencies, and preventable escalations.
  • Contribution to ASC opportunity progression, win rate, orders, revenue, profitability, and strategic account growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years of commercial, financial, operational, proposal, deal-desk, or solution-development experience in healthcare, medical technology, capital equipment, financial services, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience with financial analysis, pricing, deal modeling, risk assessment, capital planning, financing solutions, or complex commercial structures.
  • Proven project-management capability, including facilitation, scheduling, prioritization, risk management, follow-up, tracking, documentation, and communication.
  • Ability to develop and coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder solutions in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert detailed financial, technical, and commercial information into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across commercial, clinical, technical, operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel 30% of the time.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Commercial solutioning background with experience structuring integrated equipment, service, digital, and financing offerings.
  • Strong financing solutions profile, including experience with leases, capital financing, cash-flow modeling, return-on-investment analysis, and alternative transaction structures.
  • Firsthand experience supporting ambulatory surgery centers, MSOs, private equity-backed healthcare platforms, IDNs, physician groups, de novo facilities, or complex outpatient capital projects.
  • Knowledge of the ASC market and the stakeholders involved in planning, building, financing, equipping, implementing, and operating an ASC.
  • Experience with cardiovascular, interventional, imaging, ultrasound, patient monitoring, anesthesia, digital, service, or other multi-modality healthcare solutions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Word, Teams, SharePoint, CRM, quoting, and proposal tools.
  • Ability to visually present complex, data-rich information in a simple format that enables efficient decision-making.
  • Functional knowledge of pricing compliance, revenue recognition, contracting, Delegation of Authority, commercial approvals, and risk management.
  • Experience with large-scale process improvement, Lean methods, workflow automation, and development of repeatable standard work.
  • Excellent process discipline and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple urgent priorities without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable coordinating across modalities, regions, functions, operating businesses, and external partners without direct authority.
  • Customer-facing experience and the ability to understand and represent the customer’s business, clinical, operational, and financial perspective.
  • Ability to remain calm, objective, and solutions-focused under pressure.
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $100,000.00-$150,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.
