raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co-founder partnership with founder-level equity and founder-level authority, not a salaried executive role.

We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity.

This is a full-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You'll co-create with a proven venture building team, including:

  • John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR

  • Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits

  • Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold

  • Prathna Ramesh – Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor

The Partnership

  • Founder-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds

  • Founder-level authority, including co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes

  • Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner — building alongside you.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

  • Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against

  • Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call

  • Customer & Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly

  • Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team-building second

  • Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence

  • Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes

  • Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability

  • Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on

  • Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build

  • Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted

  • Prior experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus

  • Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.excerpt: About PhorestPhorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.
raw.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, we're a SaaS company and a trusted partner to over 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide. Our all-in-one software and AI-driven tools help them manage bookings, take payments, market their services, grow their client base and get the best from their teams.

Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

As the Brand Operations Manager, you’ll turn creative output into an organisational capability, making it effortless for teams across Phorest globally to find, use, and get the most from our brand assets. Sitting within the Brand & Communications team, you will own the end-to-end strategy, structure, and ongoing development of our Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform (Brand Bank) and Notion Brand Hub. By bridging the gap between creative teams and global stakeholders, you will govern asset compliance, enable self-service workflows, streamline creative pipelines, and leverage usage data and AI enablement to guide future asset development.

What You'll Do

  • Brand Bank Strategy & DAM Ownership: Own and scale our global DAM system (Brand Bank), establishing intuitive folder structures, taxonomy, tagging, search functionality, and access permissions so assets are easily discoverable, version-controlled, and globally deployable.

  • Notion Brand Hub & Self-Serve Enablement: Maintain a central, accessible Notion Brand Hub featuring current guidelines, campaign launch kits, and reusable templates to reduce unnecessary creative requests and empower teams to work independently and consistently.

  • Governance, Standards & Rights Management: Define clear standards for file naming, version control, review cycles, and archiving. Put practical processes in place to support brand consistency, usage compliance, and rights management across all global markets.

  • Creative Workflow & Delivery Management: Lead the operational coordination of core brand building blocks (e.g., global photography banks, presentation decks, product visuals) from briefing through to delivery, eliminating bottlenecks and strengthening accountability against agreed service levels.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Feedback Loops: Build close partnerships across Creative, Marketing, Product, and regional teams. Establish regular feedback loops to identify common requests, missing resources, and barriers to self-service.

  • Reporting & Data Insights:Track and report on asset usage, adoption, and resource gaps using platforms like Looker, delivering actionable insights to guide future creative production and resource allocation.

  • AI Enablement & Continuous Improvement: Identify, test, and embed practical AI applications into creative operations to improve discoverability, reduce repetitive tasks, and drive continuous workflow enhancements with proper quality and brand safeguards.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in Brand Operations, Creative Operations, or Digital Asset Management with a proven track record of leading complex, global operational initiatives.

  • DAM & Tooling Mastery: Deep expertise implementing and managing DAM systems (metadata, taxonomy, access control) and strong fluency with tools like Notion, Looker, and modern project management software.

  • Creative Operations Understanding: Comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle—from brief intake and resource planning through execution, version control, and asset archiving.

  • Operational Discipline & Process Design:Skilled at building clear, scalable processes, establishing service levels, and maintaining operational rigor that works in practice.

  • Data-Informed & Strategic Thinking:Ability to combine asset usage data with stakeholder feedback to solve problems, connect operational decisions to business priorities, and guide creative strategy.

  • Enablement & Service Mindset: High empathy and collaboration skills; dedicated to understanding team pain points and building intuitive resources that make colleagues' daily work easier.

  • Innovation & AI Curiosity: Curious about emerging AI tools and eager to experiment with practical applications to improve creative workflows and self-service capabilities.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Occupancy Planner (Remote East Coast)

About The Role:

As a CBRE Occupancy Planner, you will provide space planning, data mining, reporting, and interpretation of space planning metrics for a small to medium-sized client's needs.
This job is part of the Moves, Additions and Changes function. They are responsible for building space design, construction, and moving services.

What You'll Do:

  • Review space requirements and provide conceptual plans and recommendations to the real estate team or collaborators.
  • Assist with creating block or stack plans and move lists.
  • Produce drawings and presentations for internal partners and client-facing steering committee meetings for review and feedback.
  • Collaborate with other team members to gain business intelligence including move and relocation sequencing and execution.
  • Attend client meetings, draft meeting minutes, and acquire approvals to proceed when required.
  • May attend space walks for validation and update of occupancy metrics.
  • Responsible for entering and maintaining occupancy data within the system of record.
  • Prepare forecasts and evaluate space planning trends in general business conditions.
  • Conduct interviews and discussions with clients to capture, coordinate and synthesize project requirements, and functional, operational, and cultural issues.
  • Partner with Architectural Vendors and Project Management to investigate code requirements and city or county permits when moving or reconfiguring office space.
  • Facilitate post-occupancy support and reviews to ensure deliverables were executed and client’s expectations were met.
  • Have some knowledge of standard principles with limited practical experience in applying them.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values.
  • Impact the quality of own work.
  • Work within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
  • Exchange straightforward information, ask questions, and check for understanding.

What You'll Need:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  • Bachelor's Degree preferred with up to 3 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Clinical and administrative experience with the ability to understand EMR data and how to use for scenario planning.
  • Capacity analysis experience analyzing productivity and capacity (annual encounter/visits per exam room) and FTE provider, hours of operation and annual cases per diagnostic and testing rooms.
  • Ability to use existing procedures to tackle standard problems.
  • Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
  • Intermediate math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Why CBRE:

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.

Our Values in Hiring:

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers:

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Occupancy Planner position is $75,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Occupancy Planner position is $85,000 annually. The compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance.
Equal Employment Opportunity:CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada). CBRE GWS
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) works with clients to make real estate a meaningful contributor to organizational productivity and performance. Our account management model is at the heart of our client-centric approach to delivering integrated real estate solutions. Each client is entrusted with a dedicated leader and is supported by regional and global resources, leveraging the industry's most robust platform. CBRE GWS delivers consistent, measurably superior outcomes for our clients at every stage of the lifecycle, and across industries and geographies.
Find out more
About CBRE Group, Inc.CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). raw.excerpt: RESUME AND COVER LETTER REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION Deadline to apply is November 19, 2026Salary: $75,000-$87,000 annually.
raw.description:
RESUME AND COVER LETTER REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION

Deadline to apply is November 19, 2026

Salary: $75,000-$87,000 annually. Salary is dependent on experience and qualifications.

SUMMARY

The Meeting Manager assumes full responsibility for the planning, management, production, and execution of face to face events (ranging in size of 10-800 people) or online events, including the Online Annual Conference. Responsibilities generally include complex project management, detailed planning, contingency planning, troubleshooting, executing and evaluating association conferences from inception to completion. This position develops and manages all related budgets associated with the meeting planning process and leads the ops teams. The Meeting Manager works with other staff, member volunteers, program committees and presenters; liaises with hotel suppliers, related vendors, and builds a positive and professional image for all EDUCAUSE events.

In addition, this position plays a critical role navigating the complexities of online conferences. This includes managing digital integrations, fostering engagement within virtual communities, and delivering value to members through seamless online experiences. This position is instrumental in enhancing member engagement and facilitating impactful learning experiences.

In this role, the Meeting Manager must be a creative problem-solver, an excellent communicator with exceptional project management abilities, confident in decision-making, and able to remain composed under pressure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management and Event Architecture

  • Works with the event stakeholders to ensure the event strategy will meet event objectives and align with organizational objectives, when applicable.
  • Designs and builds the event components in conjunction with stakeholders and vendors, but has the acumen to know when decisions can be made unilaterally.
  • Responsible for the full scope of event project management, creating a detailed timeline, and adhering to strict deadlines to ensure successful execution of event logistics.
  • Oversees and manages all aspects of meeting logistics, including but not limited to registration, food and beverage, audio/visual, exhibits/corporate displays, floorplans, website/marketing review, internet requirements and connectivity, security, rigging, electrical, and on-site operations. Develop detailed logistical meeting specifications and effectively communicate those plans to all vendors and facilities to ensure a successful conference or event.
  • Updates meeting information in EDUCAUSE database (netFORUM) ensuring information is accurate.
  • Oversees the entire event on-site or online and serves as liaison for the association and participants during the event to address and resolve concerns or issues.
  • Advise on external online learning trends and effective practices that support continuous improvement, event attendance growth, participant engagement, participant satisfaction, and cost effectiveness.
  • Analyze post-event data, including attendee and exhibitor feedback, satisfaction and net promoter scores, and other metrics or indicators to identify trends and insights to provide actionable recommendations for improving the planning, execution, and outcomes of future events.
  • Working with the Sr. Director of Conferences and the Sr. Meeting Manager, manages assigned functions for the in-person Annual Conference, in addition to the Online Annual Conference.

Conference OpsTeam Management

  • Leads and manages conference ops team composed of internal stakeholders and those responsible for a segment or function of the planning and execution of the event.
  • Facilitates regular scheduled monthly or bi-weekly meetings
  • Develops timelines and establishes metrics to ensure deadlines are met for all event tasks.
  • Consults with team members to troubleshoot challenges; recommends, provides, and implements logistical solutions

Request for Proposals (RFPs)

  • Creates, formalizes, and submits RFPs to include preferences of conference stakeholders as well as historical outcomes of previous or similar events
  • Compile, assess, and prioritize the facility and vendor recommendations resulting from the RFP.
  • Draft and present proposals of facility and vendor recommendations to event stakeholders and in collaboration with the Sr. Director of CE.
  • Analyzes information and preferences to determine favorable locale, facility, and vendor selection.

Vendor Relationship and Service Negotiation

  • Establish and communicate expectations with vendors regarding hotel accommodations, audio visual needs, food and beverage, security, decorating, and special requests.
  • Negotiate and/or look for cost-saving measures with vendor quotes.

Financial Management: Budgeting, Forecasting, and Invoices

  • Develop, propose, and manage the event budget with stakeholders, ensuring revenue, expenditures, profitability and additional financial targets contribute to the financial fitness of the event, and prioritize the allocation of resources.
  • Maintains awareness of budgetary limitations as well as the impact on revenues relative to adjustments to expenses during negotiations.
  • Oversees the expense management to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded.
  • Manages the process for re-forecasting the budget for the Online Annual Conference by tracking actual revenue and expenses that will affect the budget.
  • Carefully review detailed invoices for accuracy, ensuring they are correctly coded and processed in alignment with the budgeted natural accounts.

Association Service and Support

  • Participate in EDUCAUSE events and activities as needed. Travel may be required to support EDUCAUSE conferences/events, site visits, and external events relevant to the position.
  • Act as a departmental liaison with employees, members, volunteers, volunteer groups, and clients.
  • Supports members in a manner that facilitates their growth, engagement, and enhances their EDUCAUSE experience.
  • As a frontline user of EDUCAUSE systems and data services, complies with data quality standards; adheres to data governance policies, procedures, and processes for ensuring data integrity. May act as the application or data collection lead for the department.
  • Assists EDUCAUSE with support or production of other activities or events (such as Board Meetings, Home Week, PL events, etc.).
  • Represent EDUCAUSE in a professional manner at all times; engage with co-workers in a civil, caring, respectful way; and advance the mission and vision of EDUCAUSE
  • Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This role has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Required Bachelor’s degree. Training in related fields such as Hospitality Management,or Hotel Management is preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of eight years’ experience in meeting planning; hotel or convention center environments or a combination of education and experience.
  • A Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Event industry knowledge
  • Online Conference knowledge
  • Requires excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Requires high attention to detail with exceptional organizational skills
  • Knowledgeable and proficient in budget development and management
  • The ability to manage multiple projects with good team facilitation skills
  • Knowledgeable in basic accounting
  • The ability to prioritize tasks
  • Requires sound judgment, and good intuition
  • The ability to be a self- starter and motivated
  • Requires good interpersonal skills.
  • Skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Must be available to travel
  • Must be able to work outside of normal office hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed

Competencies

  • Leadership - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; Effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others; Gives appropriate recognition to others.
  • Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services.; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.
  • Delegation - Delegates work assignments; Matches the responsibility to the person; Gives authority to work independently; Sets expectations and monitors delegated activities; Provides recognition for results.
  • Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence; Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
  • Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Physical demands of travel such as sitting for long periods, handling luggage, time zone changes, and adjusting to new environments.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Scheduled working hours either in the employees time zone or EDUCAUSE core working hours or core working hours to be determined with the supervisor.
  • Be available and responsive during scheduled work hours.
  • Any time off or change in working hours must be pre-arranged according to department guidelines and consistent with the rules applicable to employment (e.g., vacation, sick, personal, leave of absence).

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

EDUCAUSE not only offers meaningful work and dedicated colleagues; we also have a robust benefit package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 2-for-1 employer match to your 403(b) retirement plan; up to 10% of your base salary
  • Employer-paid Life and AD&D, Short‐Term Disability, and Long‐Term Disability
  • 15 days of vacation and 6 days of personal time annually
  • 9 paid holidays
  • One week of paid time off when offices are closed between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • 36-hour work week (without any reduction in pay) amounting to 26 additional days of paid time off each year
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Emergency Travel Assistance
  • Professional development assistance
  • Monthly connectivity reimbursement

EEO Statement

EDUCAUSE is committed to an equal opportunity workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. EDUCAUSE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

EDUCAUSE recognizes that the unique backgrounds, talents, skills, and contributions of every individual improve and enhance the quality of the association. Creating an environment of equal opportunity is an EDUCAUSE organizational goal, which includes, but is not limited to:

  • Treating everyone with dignity, respect, and fairness
  • Creating a welcoming, supportive, and knowledgeable community that thrives on diverse voices and perspectives
  • Providing insights and input as a work contributor
  • Listening to and acknowledging others' contributions
  • Contributing to an open and welcoming environment across demographic categories and physical locations
  • Meeting others at their point of need to advance organizational achievement
  • For supervisors, ensuring everyone's input is heard and considered

Required Skills

  • Computational Biology and Bioinformatics
  • Genomics, Transcriptomics, and Proteomics
  • Python and/or R Programming
  • NGS, RNA-seq, and Variant Analysis
  • BLAST, GATK, Samtools, and Biopython

  • Support AI model benchmarking and validation.
  • Develop reproducible scientific workflows.
  • Document findings and communicate technical insights.

Qualifications

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a related field, or equivalent industry/research experience.
  • Hands-on experience with biological data analysis.
  • Strong Python/R programming and statistical reasoning skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Experience with AI/ML-assisted biology, structural biology, or drug discovery is preferred.

Sitting within the Brand & Communications team, you will own the end-to-end strategy, structure, and ongoing development of our Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform (Brand Bank) and Notion Brand Hub. By bridging the gap between creative teams and global stakeholders, you will govern asset compliance, enable self-service workflows, streamline creative pipelines, and leverage usage data and AI enablement to guide future asset development.

What You'll Do

  • Brand Bank Strategy & DAM Ownership: Own and scale our global DAM system (Brand Bank), establishing intuitive folder structures, taxonomy, tagging, search functionality, and access permissions so assets are easily discoverable, version-controlled, and globally deployable.

  • Notion Brand Hub & Self-Serve Enablement: Maintain a central, accessible Notion Brand Hub featuring current guidelines, campaign launch kits, and reusable templates to reduce unnecessary creative requests and empower teams to work independently and consistently.

  • Governance, Standards & Rights Management: Define clear standards for file naming, version control, review cycles, and archiving. Put practical processes in place to support brand consistency, usage compliance, and rights management across all global markets.

  • Creative Workflow & Delivery Management: Lead the operational coordination of core brand building blocks (e.g., global photography banks, presentation decks, product visuals) from briefing through to delivery, eliminating bottlenecks and strengthening accountability against agreed service levels.

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Feedback Loops: Build close partnerships across Creative, Marketing, Product, and regional teams. Establish regular feedback loops to identify common requests, missing resources, and barriers to self-service.

  • Reporting & Data Insights:Track and report on asset usage, adoption, and resource gaps using platforms like Looker, delivering actionable insights to guide future creative production and resource allocation.

  • AI Enablement & Continuous Improvement: Identify, test, and embed practical AI applications into creative operations to improve discoverability, reduce repetitive tasks, and drive continuous workflow enhancements with proper quality and brand safeguards.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in Brand Operations, Creative Operations, or Digital Asset Management with a proven track record of leading complex, global operational initiatives.

  • DAM & Tooling Mastery: Deep expertise implementing and managing DAM systems (metadata, taxonomy, access control) and strong fluency with tools like Notion, Looker, and modern project management software.

  • Creative Operations Understanding: Comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle—from brief intake and resource planning through execution, version control, and asset archiving.

  • Operational Discipline & Process Design:Skilled at building clear, scalable processes, establishing service levels, and maintaining operational rigor that works in practice.

  • Data-Informed & Strategic Thinking:Ability to combine asset usage data with stakeholder feedback to solve problems, connect operational decisions to business priorities, and guide creative strategy.

  • Enablement & Service Mindset: High empathy and collaboration skills; dedicated to understanding team pain points and building intuitive resources that make colleagues' daily work easier.

  • Innovation & AI Curiosity: Curious about emerging AI tools and eager to experiment with practical applications to improve creative workflows and self-service capabilities.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Occupancy Planner (Remote East Coast)

About The Role:

As a CBRE Occupancy Planner, you will provide space planning, data mining, reporting, and interpretation of space planning metrics for a small to medium-sized client's needs.
This job is part of the Moves, Additions and Changes function. They are responsible for building space design, construction, and moving services.

What You'll Do:

  • Review space requirements and provide conceptual plans and recommendations to the real estate team or collaborators.
  • Assist with creating block or stack plans and move lists.
  • Produce drawings and presentations for internal partners and client-facing steering committee meetings for review and feedback.
  • Collaborate with other team members to gain business intelligence including move and relocation sequencing and execution.
  • Attend client meetings, draft meeting minutes, and acquire approvals to proceed when required.
  • May attend space walks for validation and update of occupancy metrics.
  • Responsible for entering and maintaining occupancy data within the system of record.
  • Prepare forecasts and evaluate space planning trends in general business conditions.
  • Conduct interviews and discussions with clients to capture, coordinate and synthesize project requirements, and functional, operational, and cultural issues.
  • Partner with Architectural Vendors and Project Management to investigate code requirements and city or county permits when moving or reconfiguring office space.
  • Facilitate post-occupancy support and reviews to ensure deliverables were executed and client’s expectations were met.
  • Have some knowledge of standard principles with limited practical experience in applying them.
  • Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values.
  • Impact the quality of own work.
  • Work within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
  • Exchange straightforward information, ask questions, and check for understanding.

What You'll Need:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
  • Bachelor's Degree preferred with up to 3 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.

  • Capacity analysis experience analyzing productivity and capacity (annual encounter/visits per exam room) and FTE provider, hours of operation and annual cases per diagnostic and testing rooms.
  • Ability to use existing procedures to tackle standard problems.
  • Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.

  • Intermediate math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Why CBRE:

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to realize your full potential.

Our Values in Hiring:

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers:

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Occupancy Planner position is $75,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Occupancy Planner position is $85,000 annually. The compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada). raw.description:
RESUME AND COVER LETTER REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS POSITION

Deadline to apply is November 19, 2026

Salary: $75,000-$87,000 annually. Salary is dependent on experience and qualifications.

SUMMARY

The Meeting Manager assumes full responsibility for the planning, management, production, and execution of face to face events (ranging in size of 10-800 people) or online events, including the Online Annual Conference. Responsibilities generally include complex project management, detailed planning, contingency planning, troubleshooting, executing and evaluating association conferences from inception to completion. This position develops and manages all related budgets associated with the meeting planning process and leads the ops teams. The Meeting Manager works with other staff, member volunteers, program committees and presenters; liaises with hotel suppliers, related vendors, and builds a positive and professional image for all EDUCAUSE events.

In addition, this position plays a critical role navigating the complexities of online conferences. This includes managing digital integrations, fostering engagement within virtual communities, and delivering value to members through seamless online experiences. This position is instrumental in enhancing member engagement and facilitating impactful learning experiences.

In this role, the Meeting Manager must be a creative problem-solver, an excellent communicator with exceptional project management abilities, confident in decision-making, and able to remain composed under pressure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management and Event Architecture

  • Works with the event stakeholders to ensure the event strategy will meet event objectives and align with organizational objectives, when applicable.
  • Designs and builds the event components in conjunction with stakeholders and vendors, but has the acumen to know when decisions can be made unilaterally.
  • Responsible for the full scope of event project management, creating a detailed timeline, and adhering to strict deadlines to ensure successful execution of event logistics.
  • Oversees and manages all aspects of meeting logistics, including but not limited to registration, food and beverage, audio/visual, exhibits/corporate displays, floorplans, website/marketing review, internet requirements and connectivity, security, rigging, electrical, and on-site operations. Develop detailed logistical meeting specifications and effectively communicate those plans to all vendors and facilities to ensure a successful conference or event.
  • Updates meeting information in EDUCAUSE database (netFORUM) ensuring information is accurate.
  • Oversees the entire event on-site or online and serves as liaison for the association and participants during the event to address and resolve concerns or issues.
  • Advise on external online learning trends and effective practices that support continuous improvement, event attendance growth, participant engagement, participant satisfaction, and cost effectiveness.
  • Analyze post-event data, including attendee and exhibitor feedback, satisfaction and net promoter scores, and other metrics or indicators to identify trends and insights to provide actionable recommendations for improving the planning, execution, and outcomes of future events.
  • Working with the Sr. Director of Conferences and the Sr. Meeting Manager, manages assigned functions for the in-person Annual Conference, in addition to the Online Annual Conference.

Conference OpsTeam Management

  • Leads and manages conference ops team composed of internal stakeholders and those responsible for a segment or function of the planning and execution of the event.
  • Facilitates regular scheduled monthly or bi-weekly meetings
  • Develops timelines and establishes metrics to ensure deadlines are met for all event tasks.
  • Consults with team members to troubleshoot challenges; recommends, provides, and implements logistical solutions

Request for Proposals (RFPs)

  • Creates, formalizes, and submits RFPs to include preferences of conference stakeholders as well as historical outcomes of previous or similar events
  • Compile, assess, and prioritize the facility and vendor recommendations resulting from the RFP.
  • Draft and present proposals of facility and vendor recommendations to event stakeholders and in collaboration with the Sr. Director of CE.
  • Analyzes information and preferences to determine favorable locale, facility, and vendor selection.

Vendor Relationship and Service Negotiation

  • Establish and communicate expectations with vendors regarding hotel accommodations, audio visual needs, food and beverage, security, decorating, and special requests.
  • Negotiate and/or look for cost-saving measures with vendor quotes.

Financial Management: Budgeting, Forecasting, and Invoices

  • Develop, propose, and manage the event budget with stakeholders, ensuring revenue, expenditures, profitability and additional financial targets contribute to the financial fitness of the event, and prioritize the allocation of resources.
  • Maintains awareness of budgetary limitations as well as the impact on revenues relative to adjustments to expenses during negotiations.
  • Oversees the expense management to ensure revenue goals are met or exceeded.
  • Manages the process for re-forecasting the budget for the Online Annual Conference by tracking actual revenue and expenses that will affect the budget.
  • Carefully review detailed invoices for accuracy, ensuring they are correctly coded and processed in alignment with the budgeted natural accounts.

Association Service and Support

  • Participate in EDUCAUSE events and activities as needed. Travel may be required to support EDUCAUSE conferences/events, site visits, and external events relevant to the position.
  • Act as a departmental liaison with employees, members, volunteers, volunteer groups, and clients.
  • Supports members in a manner that facilitates their growth, engagement, and enhances their EDUCAUSE experience.
  • As a frontline user of EDUCAUSE systems and data services, complies with data quality standards; adheres to data governance policies, procedures, and processes for ensuring data integrity. May act as the application or data collection lead for the department.
  • Assists EDUCAUSE with support or production of other activities or events (such as Board Meetings, Home Week, PL events, etc.).
  • Represent EDUCAUSE in a professional manner at all times; engage with co-workers in a civil, caring, respectful way; and advance the mission and vision of EDUCAUSE
  • Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This role has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Required Bachelor’s degree. Training in related fields such as Hospitality Management,or Hotel Management is preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of eight years’ experience in meeting planning; hotel or convention center environments or a combination of education and experience.
  • A Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) certification is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Event industry knowledge
  • Online Conference knowledge
  • Requires excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Requires high attention to detail with exceptional organizational skills
  • Knowledgeable and proficient in budget development and management
  • The ability to manage multiple projects with good team facilitation skills
  • Knowledgeable in basic accounting
  • The ability to prioritize tasks
  • Requires sound judgment, and good intuition
  • The ability to be a self- starter and motivated
  • Requires good interpersonal skills.
  • Skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Must be available to travel
  • Must be able to work outside of normal office hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed

Competencies

  • Leadership - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; Effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others; Gives appropriate recognition to others.
  • Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services.; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.
  • Delegation - Delegates work assignments; Matches the responsibility to the person; Gives authority to work independently; Sets expectations and monitors delegated activities; Provides recognition for results.
  • Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence; Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
  • Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Physical demands of travel such as sitting for long periods, handling luggage, time zone changes, and adjusting to new environments.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Scheduled working hours either in the employees time zone or EDUCAUSE core working hours or core working hours to be determined with the supervisor.
  • Be available and responsive during scheduled work hours.
  • Any time off or change in working hours must be pre-arranged according to department guidelines and consistent with the rules applicable to employment (e.g., vacation, sick, personal, leave of absence).

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

EDUCAUSE not only offers meaningful work and dedicated colleagues; we also have a robust benefit package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • 2-for-1 employer match to your 403(b) retirement plan; up to 10% of your base salary
  • Employer-paid Life and AD&D, Short‐Term Disability, and Long‐Term Disability
  • 15 days of vacation and 6 days of personal time annually
  • 9 paid holidays
  • One week of paid time off when offices are closed between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • 36-hour work week (without any reduction in pay) amounting to 26 additional days of paid time off each year
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Emergency Travel Assistance
  • Professional development assistance
  • Monthly connectivity reimbursement

EEO Statement

EDUCAUSE is committed to an equal opportunity workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. EDUCAUSE provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

EDUCAUSE recognizes that the unique backgrounds, talents, skills, and contributions of every individual improve and enhance the quality of the association. Creating an environment of equal opportunity is an EDUCAUSE organizational goal, which includes, but is not limited to:

  • Treating everyone with dignity, respect, and fairness
  • Creating a welcoming, supportive, and knowledgeable community that thrives on diverse voices and perspectives
  • Providing insights and input as a work contributor
  • Listening to and acknowledging others' contributions
  • Contributing to an open and welcoming environment across demographic categories and physical locations
  • Meeting others at their point of need to advance organizational achievement
  • For supervisors, ensuring everyone's input is heard and considered

Job Title: Grant Reviewer, Community Schools (CSII)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its Community Schools Incentive Initiative (CSII) grant competition. OSSE is seeking reviewers with hands-on experience in community school models and integrated student supports who can evaluate the quality of school-community partnerships and implementation plans.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: June 15, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Assess each application's alignment with community school pillars and the feasibility of its proposed implementation plan.
  4. Evaluate partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership memoranda of understanding (MOUs), stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and strategies for shared leadership.
  5. Analyze data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to identified community priorities.
  6. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  7. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  8. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  9. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  10. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  11. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  12. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Demonstrated experience with community school models or integrated student supports, such as community schools, wraparound services, family engagement, or school-community partnerships.
  • Knowledge of whole-child and whole-family approaches, including strategies that address academic, social-emotional, and non-academic needs such as attendance interventions, health services, mental health supports, and community resource coordination.
  • Ability to review and score applications objectively, applying scoring rubrics consistently, assessing alignment with community school pillars, and evaluating the feasibility of implementation plans.
  • Skill in assessing partnership quality and collaboration structures, including partnership MOUs, stakeholder engagement plans, community needs assessments, and shared leadership strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills for reviewing data, budgets, and needs assessments for accuracy, alignment, and responsiveness to community priorities.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to provide clear, constructive, objective written feedback that helps applicants strengthen program design and implementation.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience reviewing competitive grant applications for OSSE or another government agency.

Compensation

  • $100 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.

We help retailers lower operating costs, improve billing accuracy for consumers, and enhance customer experience through automation and AI‑driven insight, all underpinned by modern, cloud‑native architecture.

ENSEK is at an exciting inflection point as we scale at pace towards new international horizons. If you’re driven by solving complex, real‑world problems and want to build modern technology that accelerates the global energy transition, you’ll feel right at home with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer to become the founding technical lead for ENSEK's AI/ML Platform.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a new strategic capability from the ground up. You'll lead the design, architecture and evolution of the shared platform that enables product teams across ENSEK to safely build, deploy and operate Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions at scale.

Working closely with Data Scientists, Platform Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll define the technical direction, standards and golden paths that allow teams to move from experimentation to production with confidence. You'll also play a key role in building the team, culture and operating model that will support AI innovation across the organisation for years to come.

Key responsibilities:

As a Staff AI/ML Engineer, you will:

  • Lead the architecture, technical strategy and roadmap for ENSEK's AI/ML Platform, evolving it into a scalable capability used across multiple product domains.

  • Design and build production-ready golden paths for Machine Learning, GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

  • Establish standards for model lifecycle management, prompt versioning, deployment, serving, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration and secure tool access.

  • Build robust MLOps and LLMOps capabilities, including evaluation frameworks, experimentation tooling, observability, monitoring and cost management.

  • Create and maintain registries for AI products, models and prompts to ensure visibility, governance and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with Data Scientists to operationalise machine learning models, GenAI applications and agentic workflows into reliable production services.

  • Define patterns for human-in-the-loop workflows, confidence-based routing and AI safety mechanisms.

  • Embed security, governance, compliance and responsible AI practices into the platform from day one.

  • Collaborate with Legal, Cyber Security, Risk and Product teams to ensure AI solutions remain safe, explainable and auditable within regulated environments.

  • Mentor ML Engineers and other developers across the organisation while helping establish engineering standards and best practices.

  • Contribute to the long-term growth, structure and operating model of ENSEK's AI Engineering capability.

Key outcomes:

You'll know you're making an impact when:

  • The platform's first AI-powered capabilities are running successfully in production and delivering measurable business value.

  • Multiple product teams are building, deploying and operating AI solutions through the platform's approved patterns and tooling.

  • AI products are consistently governed, observable and measurable through standardised evaluation, monitoring and reporting.

  • Every production AI capability is registered, auditable and supported by appropriate safety guardrails.

  • Teams have clear guidance on model selection, hosting approaches and platform capabilities.

  • The platform becomes the preferred route for AI innovation across ENSEK rather than teams developing isolated solutions.

  • A high-performing ML Engineering team is established with strong engineering practices and a close partnership with Data Science.

Experience required:

We're seeking an experienced technical leader who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in modern AI and Machine Learning platforms.

You'll bring:

  • Significant experience as an AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Software Engineer or Technical Lead delivering production Machine Learning and AI solutions.

  • Experience operating at Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer or equivalent technical leadership level.

  • Deep expertise in MLOps and production machine learning platforms, including model deployment, serving, monitoring, evaluation and lifecycle management.

  • Proven experience building and operating applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).

  • Strong hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks and agentic AI workflows.

  • Excellent software engineering skills, ideally in Python, alongside experience designing distributed systems and production services.

  • Experience building and operating cloud-native services on AWS using containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices.

  • Strong understanding of platform engineering principles, developer experience and self-service platform design.

  • Experience implementing AI governance, model safety, privacy controls and responsible AI practices.

  • The ability to make pragmatic technical decisions while balancing performance, cost, scalability and risk.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar emerging standards.

  • Experience building enterprise AI platforms supporting multiple product teams.

  • Experience with lakehouse data platforms and data engineering ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of regulated industries such as Energy, Utilities, Financial Services or Healthcare.

  • Experience working with Agentic AI architectures and tool-using AI systems.

  • Familiarity with emerging AI observability, evaluation and governance tooling.

Company Benefits

  • 25 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Option to buy or sell 5 extra annual leave days per year

  • Vitality Health Insurance, including private healthcare, virtual GP access, mental‑health support and wellbeing perks (50% off gym memberships-Virgin Active, Nuffield, PureGym)

  • Pensionwith5% matched contribution

  • Regular team‑wide and company‑wide events

  • 2 volunteering days per year to give back

  • Remote‑first working environment with offices in London and Nottingham

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
