SEE how you can make a difference! Be part of an innovative company that cares about its associates and helps members enjoy the wonders of sight through healthy eyes and vision.

About Versant Health Versant Health is a leading managed vision care company dedicated to making healthy vision a reality for everyone. Through our Davis Vision® and Superior Vision® networks, our purpose is to make healthy vision a reality for everyone by improving access to care and education in the communities we serve. Fueled by our mission to improve members' lives with easy-to-use vision benefits rooted in choice, value, and care, we believe that everyone has the power to become anything they set their sights on. Position Overview Versant Health is a visionary and results-oriented Chief Strategy Officer (CSO) to join our Executive Leadership Team. Reporting directly to the CEO, the CSO will lead the development and execution of the organization's long-term strategic vision, growth agenda, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This executive leader will serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors, providing insight into market trends, growth opportunities, competitive dynamics, strategic investments, partnerships, and emerging healthcare innovations. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, business acumen, analytical rigor, and the ability to translate ideas into measurable business results. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Strategy

Lead the development, execution, and ongoing refinement of the organization's three-to-five-year enterprise strategy in partnership with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team. Establish and maintain a comprehensive fact base encompassing market dynamics, competitive trends, customer needs, regulatory developments, healthcare delivery transformation, emerging technologies, and industry economics. Evaluate strategic opportunities and risks, develop actionable recommendations, and present decision-ready alternatives to executive leadership and the Board of Directors. Direct the annual enterprise strategic planning process and ensure strategic priorities remain responsive to changing market conditions and business needs. Partner with Finance to align strategic priorities with financial plans, capital allocation decisions, and long-term investment strategies.

Growth and Portfolio Strategy

Develop and drive enterprise growth strategies across customer segments, products, service lines, markets, geographies, and adjacent business opportunities. Collaborate with business leaders to identify, assess, and prioritize organic and inorganic growth opportunities. Evaluate emerging opportunities within commercial and government-sponsored healthcare markets, specialty benefits, healthcare services, digital health, value-based care, care navigation, and alternative funding models. Establish and oversee a disciplined strategic framework for determining when to build, buy, partner, invest, or divest. Maintain an enterprise portfolio perspective to ensure effective allocation of capital, resources, and organizational focus.

Corporate Development and Strategic Partnerships

Develop and manage a pipeline of potential acquisitions, investments, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships that support long-term business objectives. Lead strategic assessments, business case development, due diligence support, and transaction evaluations in partnership with Finance, Legal, and operational leaders. Identify external capabilities, technologies, and partnerships that accelerate growth, expand market access, or strengthen competitive differentiation. Support integration planning, synergy realization, and value capture initiatives for acquisitions and strategic partnerships.

Market Intelligence and Competitive Insights

Build and lead an enterprise-wide market intelligence capability focused on competitors, customers, healthcare trends, regulatory developments, providers, technology disruption, and evolving business models. Conduct market analyses and scenario planning to anticipate industry shifts and emerging opportunities. Deliver actionable insights that inform strategic planning, investment decisions, and risk mitigation efforts. Provide the CEO and Executive Leadership Team with forward-looking assessments of market opportunities, competitive threats, and strategic implications.

Strategic Execution and Enterprise Performance

Translate enterprise strategy into a focused portfolio of strategic priorities with defined outcomes, milestones, executive accountability, and financial targets. Establish governance processes and strategy review mechanisms to monitor progress and ensure enterprise alignment. Evaluate the performance of strategic initiatives and recommend course corrections, acceleration, investment adjustments, or discontinuation as appropriate. Lead complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives sponsored by the CEO and Executive Leadership Team. Promote enterprise-wide collaboration while preserving business and functional leaders' accountability for execution and results.

Executive Leadership and Board Partnership

Serve as a trusted strategic advisor and thought partner to the CEO on the organization's most critical business decisions. Provide objective, fact-based analysis and constructively challenge assumptions to improve decision-making quality. Simplify complex issues into clear strategic choices, trade-offs, and actionable recommendations. Partner with the CEO to develop strategic content for Board meetings, executive presentations, and governance discussions. Present strategic analyses, market insights, growth opportunities, and investment recommendations to the Board of Directors. Foster alignment and collaboration across the Executive Leadership Team on enterprise-wide priorities and transformational initiatives.

Leadership and Organizational Effectiveness

Build and lead a high-performing strategy function focused on innovation, analytical rigor, and business impact. Develop strategic planning capabilities across the organization and promote a culture of enterprise thinking and informed decision-making. Influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization to drive alignment, accountability, and successful execution of strategic priorities. Champion a data-driven approach to strategic decision-making and organizational transformation.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Economics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, healthcare, insurance, corporate development, or a related field. Demonstrated success leading enterprise strategy, growth initiatives, and organizational transformation. Strong understanding of healthcare, health insurance, specialty benefits, or healthcare services. Experience evaluating strategic investments, partnerships, mergers, and acquisitions. Exceptional analytical, financial, communication, and executive presentation skills. Proven ability to influence senior executives, Boards of Directors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our associates remain engaged through a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes health and dental insurance, tuition reimbursements, 401(k) with company match, pet insurance and FREE vision insurance for you and your family. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religious beliefs, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), national origin, ancestry, status as a protected veteran or disabled veteran, physical or mental disability or history of disability, genetic information, marital status, or any and all other categories protected by under applicable Federal, state or local law. This policy extends to all associates and to all aspects of the employment relationship. Any associate who violates this policy will be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination

🏆 Great Place to Work® Certified | USA

Harbor Compliance is a leading technology platform for entity compliance, helping more than 80,000 businesses and nonprofits manage licensing, tax registration, and legal entity requirements nationwide. Founded in 2012 and recognized repeatedly by the Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500, we've grown through five strategic acquisitions — and are now backed by a 2026 majority growth investment from Bregal Sagemount to accelerate product, AI, and customer experience. We're a passionate team making compliance simpler and smarter for every organization we serve.

Harbor Compliance is consolidating fragmented revenue ownership into a single, accountable leader — a foundational executive hire to unify revenue functions (sales, partnerships, marketing, account management) into one coordinated land-and-expand motion. As Chief Revenue Officer, you'll report directly to the CEO and own all revenue end-to-end: new logo growth, customer retention, expansion mechanics, and the data and accountability systems that connect them. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build from the ground up and drive 4x ARR growth ($60M → $250M) over five years.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own revenue end-to-end. You own all revenue targets, budget requests, hiring approvals, and the GTM strategy.
  • Consolidate and lead revenue functions. Manage 5 leaders across sales, partnerships, marketing, & account management. Hire, develop, and retain 48+ new GTM team members in 2027.
  • Execute the 2027 GTM strategy. Build outbound sales motion and launch an enterprise sales team. Open new verticals with coordinated sales + marketing. Grow ARR from $60M to $250M with $100M from organic growth and $100M from M&A.
  • Design and run the revenue model. Build the lead-to-revenue model bottoms-up — establish gates at each level.
  • Build and own revenue metrics and accountability. Report to CEO and Present quarterly results to PE board.
  • Partner cross-functionally. Partner with the CFO on M&A integration, revenue forecasting, and financial reporting. Partner with the Chief Customer Officer on cross-sell mechanics and churn drivers. Work with VP of Engineering and Product to ensure delivery aligns with commercial commitments.
  • Establish and scale GTM infrastructure. Build repeatable playbooks for new logo sales, expansion, and retention.

Requirements

  • B2B SaaS revenue leadership experience. You have deep, hands-on experience leading revenue in B2B SaaS environments. You understand subscription models, ARR/NRR metrics, customer acquisition costs, LTV, and how to build repeatable, scalable revenue motions in software businesses.
  • Direct sales team management. You have proven experience directly managing a sales team or revenue-producing function.
  • Demonstrated revenue organization improvement. You've taken a revenue organization from one state to a materially better state.
  • GTM fundamentals. You can articulate your GTM strategy in clear, data-driven terms. Competitive positioning, pricing strategy, funnel dynamics, and conversion rates. You think in terms of unit economics and can defend your revenue model all the way down to the lead level.
  • Experience in high-velocity, lower-ACV SaaS. You've successfully scaled revenue in a similar environment (high volume, lower deal size, land-and-expand model).
  • Ability to build and scale from ambiguity. You're comfortable with a lean, scrappy, fast-moving environment. GTM processes don't exist yet; you'll build them. Org structure is being designed around you. You're energized by building from the ground up.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Outbound sales and land-and-expand motions. Built or significantly scaled outbound programs and both land and expand revenue models.
  • Channel/partnership GTM. Worked with channel partners or built partnership go-to-market; experience structuring, incentivizing, and enabling partners.
  • PE-backed experience. Worked at PE-backed portfolio company; understand board cadence, growth targets, exits, and aggressive scaling.
  • Enterprise sales leadership. Built or led enterprise sales motions; experience scaling from SMB → mid-market → enterprise.
  • Revenue operations and sales comp design. Built RevOps infrastructure (quota, territory, forecasting, comp tracking). Designed comp models that drive performance-based behavior.

Salary is one part of Harbor Compliance’s total compensation package. Other benefits may include health benefits, flexible paid time off, parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k), and educational reimbursement. Description

The Risk Manager (Clinical Research) plays a pivotal role in developing and executing risk-based monitoring strategies, ensuring data quality and integrity in clinical research projects. This position involves cross-functional collaboration to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the clinical trial lifecycle, supporting the seamless implementation of Risk-Based Study Management (RBSM) principles in a CRO or pharma industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Risk Manager must:

  • Provide subject matter expertise for developing and updating the risk-based monitoring strategy tailored to project needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with complex indications.
  • May have to coordinate with central monitor team and verify work.
  • Point sur provide budget recommendations, change orders.
  • Draft initial risk assessments and support the finalization of Risk Assessment and Categorization Tools (RACT).
  • Guide Project Managers (PMs) in transferring identified risks to the appropriate tracking systems and ensure ongoing reviews.
  • Advise on developing functional plans to mitigate risks effectively.
  • Utilize available tools to conduct remote data reviews and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
  • Facilitate internal and sponsor reviews of findings, seeking cross-functional support for complex risks and mitigations.
  • Deliver initial and ongoing training for study teams on risk assessment, centralized monitoring, and risk-based monitoring strategies.
  • Escalate risks or deliverables at risk to the PM, including scope changes.
  • Provide strategic input on risk characterization and reporting to leadership.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as required, ensuring qualifications and training align with assigned tasks.

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research;

Experience

  • Must have experience in a CRO or pharma industry
  • Minimum of 3 years in risk management within a clinical research setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience across clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety.

Requirements:

  • Expertise in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R3) Guidelines and other regulatory requirements.
  • Proficiency in Risk-Based Monitoring strategies, processes, and tools.
  • Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, pivot tables).
  • Advanced skills in analytical data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and web based RACT tools.
  • Strong analytical and statistical understanding.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to anticipate critical issues and develop proactive contingency plans.
  • Skilled in project workflows and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Training, mentoring, and organizational capabilities.
  • High level of autonomy.
  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with the ability to plan, monitor, and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Excellent understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

OUR COMPANY

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

Tasks may include research, design, concept development, planning, client interactions, business and proposal development, construction support, and staff mentorship. Supports project development through disciplined engineering practices, coordination across multidisciplinary teams, and adherence to established quality and safety standards. Ensures responsibilities are executed with a level of technical excellence, clarity, and functional performance that meets or exceeds industry expectations.

  • Lead project teams of varying sizes.
  • Travel to client offices/field/vendor facilities, as needed.

Department Support

  • Support resource forecasting.
  • Support recruitment efforts.
  • Provide business improvement methodologies and procedures.
  • Support staff performance and technical development with department leadership.
  • Contribute to the business planning efforts.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering
  • 5-7 years’ experience in the transmission field of designing/managing projects and leading multi-disciplinary teams
  • Professional Engineering (PE) licensure.
  • Understanding of the NESC, RUS, and/or GO-95.
  • Strong understanding of transmission line fundamentals and PLS-CADD operation
  • The candidate must have a strong command of the English language with good written and oral communication skills to work effectively with internal team members and external client personnel.
  • Experience using the Microsoft Office software suite
  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Field program planning, management, and execution.
  • Subcontractor management.
  • Cost estimating and scheduling.
  • Field experience.
  • MBA degree from an accredited university.
  • Involvement in technical societies (IEEE, CIGRE, ASCE…)

  • POLE and TOWER experience.

Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

Leads multidisciplinary teams in delivering on the design, execution, strategy and management of various development, clinical pharmacology and regulatory engagements, from early translation to late development.


Responsibilities

  • Works collaboratively with and leads Certara team members and clients to develop clinical pharmacology and quantitative program strategies that are fit-for purpose to enable development and regulatory decisions for IND/First in human to NDA/BLA.
  • Develops new innovative and impactful clinical pharmacology approaches to processes and drug development strategies and can assemble a multidisciplinary team to execute the components of clinical pharmacology program.
  • Leverage quantitative modelling and simulation tools to answer development questions and to design and inform clinical trial designs and clinical development strategy.
  • Represent clients at meetings and advisory hearings with global health authorities as a subject matter expert.
  • Lead others in authoring and contributes to documents summarizing clinical pharmacology data and program strategy including CSRs, reports, and health authority documents.
  • Interpret DMPK data with a focus on translation and applies information to support clinical pharmacology study design and strategy.
  • Contributes to training and mentoring for staff, develops junior staff for broader functional roles either as a direct manager or on project teams.
  • Interprets and integrates NCA and pharmacometric results to support decision making including evolving clinical pharmacology strategy and development strategy.
  • Actively collaborates with multidisciplinary peers (e.g., biostats, clinical, pharm/tox, CMC) and has a working understanding of the multidisciplinary requirements of drug development.
  • Co/authoring peer-reviewed manuscripts and publications.
  • Reviews publications to keep apprised to keep apprised of new clinical pharmacology and therapeutic area developments.
  • Involvement in program committees, workshops, and other professional organization meetings/sessions.
  • Participate in company initiatives.
  • Leads in business development initiatives and independently generates business. development leads and represents respective line function and broader Certara capabilities on client scoping calls.
  • Identifies project opportunities, structures WO and budget, formulates teams and identifies needs and resources necessary to execute projects. Authors work orders when necessary.

Qualifications

  • Must be recognized applied development practitioner, experienced in both design and stewardship of clinical pharmacology components of clinical development plans and optimal application of pharmacometrics approaches to support decision making and regulatory success.
  • PhD or PharmD degree or equivalent degree with specialization in pharmacology or pharmacokinetics, or in a related scientific discipline.
  • MS in Pharmaceutical Science with job related experience in the field of drug development and clinical pharmacology.
  • 12+ years of experience including clinical pharmacology experience in the pharmaceutical industry or government.
  • Previous consulting experience or thought leader in clinical pharmacology or drug development space.
  • Broad therapeutic area and small and/or biologic molecule therapeutics experience.
  • Experienced in designing and executing clinical pharmacology studies.
  • Experience with translational and clinical pharmacology work at different stage of development and for regulatory submissions (e.g. INDs, NDAs, and BLAs).
  • Experience in providing input on clinical pharmacology plans and preparation of regulatory submissions (e.g. INDs, NDAs, BLAs and/or significant sNDAs/sBLAs).
  • Demonstrated track record in a functional role on cross functional dug development team.
  • Understanding of the CMC, pharm/tox, biostats, clinical and other multidisciplinary requirements of drug development.
  • Experience building and leading successful teams (within and/or across functions).

Skills & Abilities:

  • Advanced understanding of the clinical pharmacology discipline.
  • Strong initiative, self-motivation and demonstrated ability of coordinating multiple projects and/or tasks.
  • Possess a strong focus on influencing at high levels, innovation, and customer centricity.
  • Strong client and alliance management skills.
  • Ability to mentor and develop junior PK scientist on clinical pharmacology science and strategy either as a direct mentor or on project teams.
  • Ability to work across functions to implement company initiatives
  • Excellent written, verbal and inter-personal communications skills.
  • Must be able to work well and lead a team in a multidisciplinary environment.
  • MS Office products including Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

Missions proposées :

Les unités flottantes offshore (FPSO, FLNG, etc…) sont constituées de plusieurs modules pesant plusieurs milliers de tonnes et supportés par la coque.
Chacun de ces modules repose sur la coque au travers de « bearing nodes », nœuds structuraux qui permettent de transmettre les efforts du module vers la coque tout en accommodant les mouvements relatifs entre ces deux structures.

Ces « bearing nodes » sont des structures complexes, comportant un nombre important de pièces et de soudures engendrant des temps significatifs d’analyses, de fabrication et d’inspection.

L’objectif du stage est d’étudier la faisabilité d’un concept de « bearing node » simplifié et standardisé couvrant plusieurs plages de chargement et pouvant être décliné sur de futurs projets.

L’étude portera sur :

  • Analyse du design de référence
    • Revue des concepts existants sur différents projets
    • Identification des paramètres dimensionnants
    • Analyse des difficultés de fabrication et de modélisation
  • Développement d’un concept simplifié et standardisé
    • Simplification de la géométrie
    • Réduction du nombre de pièces et d’assemblages soudés
    • Simplification des procédés de soudage
    • Définition d’une gamme de variantes par plage de charges admissibles
  • Evaluation des bénéfices
    • Constructibilité et facilité de fabrication
    • Performance
    • Temps et complexité des calculs
    • Impact poids

L'étude devra mettre en évidence les avantages, les limitations et le domaine d'application du concept proposé, ainsi que son potentiel de standardisation pour les futurs projets.

Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.

Profil recherché:

Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • En cours de Bac +5 dans une école d'ingénieurs
  • Vous suivez une formation en ingénierie des structures offshore ou navale
  • Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques
  • Vous avez des connaissances en Elément Finis
  • Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?

Envoyez-nous votre candidature!

Votre carrière chez nous :

Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives. Entouré(e) de personnes diverses aux nombreux talents, vous vous sentirez accueilli(e), respecté(e) et impliqué(e). Vous évoluerez dans un environnement sûr et bienveillant où vous pourrez proposer de nouvelles idées, réinventer l'avenir et conduire le changement. Au fur et à mesure de l'évolution de votre carrière, vous bénéficierez des possibilités d'apprentissage offertes par T.EN University, telles que le programme « Future Ready », et du soutien de votre manager, par exemple à l'occasion de l'entretien de mi-année, qui favorisent votre épanouissement et développement continus.

Prochaines étapes :

Nous vous demandons un peu de patience pendant que l’équipe traite le volume de demandes dans les meilleurs délais ! Vous pourrez suivre son avancement via votre compte personnel à partir du profil que vous avez créé lors de votre candidature.

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

Job Description Summary
The Neogen Corporation, a Lansing MI based leader in Food Safety products and solutions, is seeking a candidate for a Customer Service Representative for the food safety diagnostic division. The ideal candidate will be able to provide customers with expert assistance to a wide variety of questions and problems. Unlike traditional customer service roles, you will build ongoing relationships with customers through consultative relationship building. Our Customer Service Representatives are self-motivated and driven by a desire to exceed expectations. Strong multi-tasking skills, sense of urgency, and excellent verbal and written communication are encouraged. Interpersonal skills and the ability to establish rapport, build solid relationships with a variety of internal partners and customers is critical. Neogen provides comprehensive training on internal process and systems.

Job Summary

The Customer Service Representative supports internal and external customers by processing orders, responding to customer inquiries, coordinating shipment and account-related issues, and partnering with Sales, Accounts Receivable, Planning, Purchasing, and Shipping. This role requires accuracy, organization, responsiveness, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a customer-focused environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Handle inbound customer calls and make outbound calls regarding order status, order-entry issues, and other customer needs.
  • Enter and process customer orders received by phone, fax, and email using CRM and Solomon systems.

  • Enter customer complaints related to merchandise, equipment, and loaners into the appropriate CMS system.

  • Review open-order reports and identify shipments requiring follow-up or confirmation.
  • Assist Sales representatives with customer quotes and convert approved quotes into orders as needed.
  • Provide invoice copies to customers and Sales representatives.
  • Maintain knowledge of Neogen products, services, and internal processes.
  • Use product knowledge to identify appropriate opportunities to support or expand customer orders.
  • Participate in customer and sales campaigns as assigned.

  • Maintain and update departmental training documentation and procedures for assigned divisions.
  • Partner with Purchasing, Planning, and Shipping to resolve inventory and order-related issues.
  • Communicate professionally with internal and external customers by phone and email.
  • Partner with Accounts Receivable to help resolve purchase order discrepancies, account balances, case-related issues, and other customer account concerns.
  • Participate in special projects as assigned.
  • Maintain regular and reliable attendance consistent with the requirements of the role.
  • Work occasional adjusted hours based on business and customer needs.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • One or more years of customer service, order processing, administrative support, or related experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
  • Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Ability to enter and maintain information accurately in computer-based systems.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external customers by phone and email.
  • Ability to read and interpret written procedures, instructions, and routine business documents.
  • Ability to prepare routine written correspondence.
  • Ability to organize work, manage multiple priorities, and meet established deadlines.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate or bachelor's degree.
  • Experience in a customer service or order-entry environment.
  • Experience using CRM, ERP, or order-management systems.
  • Experience with Solomon or similar ERP software.
  • Experience processing customer payments, purchase orders, invoices, or account-related transactions.
  • Ability to type approximately 50-60 words per minute accurately.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Professional phone and email communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify issues, gather relevant information, and work with appropriate partners to resolve customer concerns.
  • Ability to adapt communication style based on customer and business needs.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of customer and business information.
  • Ability to learn Neogen products, systems, procedures, and processes.
  • Ability to accept feedback and apply it to improve performance and work quality.

Physical Demands

The physical requirements described below represent those associated with performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to operate computer and office equipment, and communicate verbally and electronically. The employee may occasionally be required to stand or walk and may occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 25 pounds. The position requires the ability to perform computer-based work and review detailed information for extended periods.


Work Environment

This position is generally performed in an office or similar work environment. The noise level is typically low. The employee may occasionally encounter workplace odors associated with the surrounding business environment.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.


Equal Employment Opportunity

Neogen is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

Overview

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

The R&D Partner is a senior individual contributor who sells large, complex, multi-year deals that bring together Certara’s software and services across the full drug development lifecycle, from discovery through regulatory approval and market access. These deals are not single-product sales. They combine capabilities from several Certara portfolios into one integrated solution for pharmaceutical and biotech customers, and they may involve partners within Certara’s ecosystem. [Confirm ecosystem scope, e.g., alliance, channel, and partner-involved deals.]
The role sits in the Transformative Growth team and works through the regional account teams, Global Account Directors, and Portfolio Leaders, not around them.


Responsibilities

  • Originate and close large integrated deals: Identify, shape, and win multi-portfolio opportunities that span discovery, preclinical, clinical, regulatory, and post-approval needs.
    • Sell the full-cycle story: Position Certara’s combined software, modeling and simulation, regulatory, and consulting capabilities against a customer’s development pipeline and business goals.
    • Engage senior buyers: Build and sustain executive relationships (R&D, clinical development, regulatory, and procurement leadership) at pharmaceutical and biotech customers.
    • Orchestrate Certara: Assemble the right pursuit team across Portfolio Leaders, Solutions Consultants, scientific and delivery leads, Commercial Operations, Legal, and Finance. Lead the deal strategy and the customer conversation.
    • Structure the deal: Work with Commercial Operations, Finance, and Legal on pricing, contract structure, and terms for complex, multi-year, multi-element agreements.
    • Work the ecosystem: Where deals involve alliance, channel, or other ecosystem partners, develop and manage those relationships within agreed governance and approval rules. [Confirm.]
    • Coordinate to avoid account conflict: Agree in advance with regional heads, Global Account Directors, and Portfolio Leaders on account ownership, shared bookings credit, and escalation, and document it.
    • Forecast and report: Keep CRM records current, provide accurate forecasts, and take part in pipeline and business reviews.
    • Share market insight: Bring customer and market feedback on integrated-R&D buying trends back into commercial strategy.

Success Measures

  • Attainment of individual bookings quota on integrated, multi-portfolio deals.
    • Qualified pipeline and win rate on large integrated opportunities.
    • Number of customers buying across software and services, and growth in cross-portfolio penetration.
    • Deal quality: margin, contract term, and successful handoff to delivery.

• Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline.

  • Feedback from customers and internal account teams on coordination and value delivered.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise sales, business development, or account leadership experience selling complex software and/or scientific or consulting services to pharmaceutical or biotech companies.
    • Proven record of closing large, multi-year, multi-million-dollar deals, preferably combining software and services.
    • Strong understanding of the drug discovery and development process, from discovery through regulatory submission and market access.
    • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior R&D and executive buyers.
    • Experience leading complex pursuits across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
    • Experience with consultative or value-based selling methodologies and Salesforce CRM.
    • Strong negotiation, communication, and executive presence.
    • Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in life sciences, business, or a related field preferred.
    • Willingness and ability to travel extensively.

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: At Mindera, we believe that software is built by people, for people with high performance systems that impact users worldwide.
raw.description:
At Mindera, we believe that software is built by people, for people with high performance systems that impact users worldwide. We are looking for a SeniorData Engineer to build and run the pipelines and platforms that move our customers' data: from source systems to the warehouse, on production systems with real consequences.

We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re looking for someone who loves to build, learn, and guide others. You’ll be working closely with our leadership (CEO/COO) and our clients, so clear communication and a collaborative spirit are key.

At Mindera we encourage the use of AI to assist with coding and related tasks. We find a persons skill in engineering and software craft, has a big impact long term successful delivery, with or without AI. Our goal in the interview process is to understand the candidates knowledge and skill with engineering.

If you need to, or plan to use AI, please be transparent with us when you're using it, to avoid issues and misunderstandings that can either: impact your chance of securing the role or impact your success at Mindera.

National and international expected traveling time varies according to project/client and organizational needs: 0%-15% estimated.

💪 How You'll Contribute

  • Pipeline Engineering: Build and operate robust ingestion pipelines (both batch and streaming) from databases, event streams, and third-party APIs.
  • Storage & Performance: Own storage architecture across the lake, lakehouse, and warehouse, optimizing for partitioning, cost efficiency, and query speed.
  • Reliability & Observability: Keep pipelines observable and restartable by implementing orchestration, automated testing, alerting, and ensuring clean recovery when something breaks at 08:00.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Work like a true software engineer by implementing infrastructure as code, CI/CD for data workloads, code reviews, and strict version control.
  • Data Contracts & Governance: Agree on data contracts with data-producing teams to keep schema drift under control, while managing access, retention, and lineage.
  • Lasting Documentation: Produce clear and comprehensive documentation that ensures your work outlives the engagement.

Requirements

🌿 We're Looking for Someone Who...

  • Has Proven Production Experience: You have built and ran data pipelines in production and, more importantly, you can articulate what you learned when they broke.
  • Is an AI-Augmented Engineer: You seamlessly integrate AI tooling into your daily workflow, but you maintain the strict review discipline to verify what it generates before it ships.
  • Is a Confident Communicator: You possess fluent English and are completely comfortable working directly with customer teams.
  • Has a Cost Engineering Mindset (Valued): You know how to make a pipeline cheaper and can quantify the savings.
  • Understands Compliance (Valued): You have exposure to regulated environments, including GDPR obligations, access control, and auditable lineage.

🛠️ Your Technical Toolkit:

  • Core Languages: Advanced, production-grade SQL and Python.
  • Cloud Platforms: Production depth in one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with a solid grasp of principles to move between them. (A second cloud platform is a plus).
  • Orchestration: Production experience with an orchestrator from a main vendor (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent).
  • Warehousing & Transformation (Nice to have): Warehouse depth in Snowflake or BigQuery (dimensional or Data Vault modelling), and experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks.
  • Processing & Streaming (Nice to have):Spark or PySpark at scale, Databricks, and streaming/pub-sub brokers like Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or MQTT-class brokers.
  • AI Data Infrastructure & Formats (Nice to have): Embedding pipelines, vector stores, retrieval feeds, feature stores, and open table/file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta).
  • DevOps & Quality (Nice to have):Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and data quality frameworks in production (Great Expectations, Soda, Monte Carlo).
  • Source Systems (Nice to have): NoSQL stores (like MongoDB) and marketing/ad-platform data (Google Ads, Meta, CRM platform APIs).

💬 Recruitment Stages

  • Screening - Reviewing CVs and eligibility verification.
  • 1st Call - 30 minute call to access Technical & Culture Fit with IT Recruiter.
  • Tech Interview - 2 hour call with two of our data engineers to assess your technical knowledge in depth. The interview includes a theoretical section based on test-case scenarios as well as live practical exercises
  • Cultural Interview - 1-hour call with a Minder to assess cultural fit with Mindera and align expectations for both parties.
  • Project/Client Call - A 30 minute to 1 hour call with the client or project team to assess your technical fit for a specific project and align expectations.

Benefits

🎊 What’s in it for You?

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Fullstack Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

Job Description: Student Loan Specialist

Role Type: Contractor
Location: United States (Remote)

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Student Loan Specialists to support an AI training and evaluation project focused on federal student loan programs. In this role, you will leverage your borrower counseling and student loan expertise to evaluate AI-generated questions and responses, ensuring they reflect real-world borrower concerns and provide accurate, relevant, and helpful guidance.

Your knowledge will help improve how AI systems understand federal student loan policies, repayment options, forgiveness programs, and loan servicing processes. No prior AI experience is required; your subject matter expertise is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review sample federal student loan questions and identify or flag inquiries that do not accurately reflect real-world borrower concerns.
  2. Develop and refine evaluation rubrics defining the standards for accurate, complete, and helpful answers related to repayment, forgiveness, and loan relief programs, including Income-Driven Repayment (IDR) plans and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).
  3. Expand rubric coverage to include loan servicing challenges, deferment, forbearance, and student loan default management scenarios.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated responses using established rubrics, identifying inaccuracies, missing information, and outdated guidance.
  5. Provide concise, constructive written feedback to the project team asynchronously to support continuous improvements in response quality.
  6. Identify and report incorrect guidance, unclear borrower communication, and potentially misleading or inappropriate loan servicing recommendations.
  7. Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure evaluation rubrics and feedback reflect current federal student loan policies and practices.

Required Qualifications

  1. Minimum of one year of direct experience advising borrowers on federal student loans through nonprofit counseling organizations, college or university financial aid offices, loan servicing companies, or default management programs.
  2. Strong knowledge of federal student loan repayment strategies, including Income-Driven Repayment (IDR) plans, forgiveness programs such as PSLF, deferment, forbearance, and default resolution.
  3. Practical understanding of loan servicing operations, common servicer-related challenges, and effective borrower communication strategies.
  4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex student loan policies and technical guidance clearly.
  5. Experience reviewing or developing student loan guidance documents, evaluation rubrics, educational resources, or training materials.
  6. Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment and provide detailed, actionable feedback through digital platforms.
  7. Must be a U.S. resident with familiarity with federal student loan regulations and current administrative practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience evaluating borrower-facing communications, student loan guidance, or financial counseling materials for accuracy and clarity.
  2. Familiarity with federal student loan servicing systems, repayment administration, and borrower support processes.
  3. Experience with AI training, model evaluation, data annotation, or content quality assurance projects.

raw.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Senior Content Strategist for a project that supports the development, operation, and continuous improvement of a federal health agency’s open data platform. The platform hosts more than 170 public data products — datasets, interactive tools, and dashboards — contributed by offices across the agency and used by hundreds of thousands of people each month, from first-time visitors to seasoned analysts and data experts. The program’s mission is to make the agency’s public data easy to discover, access, and use, and to consolidate a fragmented data web presence into a single, coherent destination that meets federal accessibility, security, and data governance standards.

The Senior Content Strategist owns the platform’s content strategy, taxonomy, and editorial governance. This is a senior, largely autonomous Key Personnel role responsible for setting content guidelines and standards, planning and evolving the site’s taxonomy and information architecture, and leading the content side of migrating and consolidating other agency data websites onto the platform — while advising Government stakeholders, data owners, and design, research, and development teams on how to make complex data understandable for every type of user.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one base period and four optional years. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA, with occasional travel to the client’s headquarters in Baltimore, MD. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $100,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the platform’s content strategy, aligning it with program objectives, quarterly OKRs, and the product roadmap.

  • Develop and maintain content guidelines, style standards, and editorial workflows that keep content consistent across multiple contributing agency offices.

  • Lead a cohesive data and content governance approach, including standard guides, guided authoring steps, and role-based publishing workflows in Drupal.

  • Maintain and evolve the site structure, taxonomy, and metadata so users can quickly find the data they need, including consistent naming conventions across data products.

  • Partner with developers and web analytics staff to improve search relevance and findability, using data from tools such as Adobe Analytics and Google Search Console.

  • Apply open data metadata standards (e.g., DCAT-US) to dataset pages and supporting content.

  • Plan and lead content migration from other agency data websites onto the platform, including content inventories, audits, content mapping, and redirect planning.

  • Contribute the content, taxonomy, and information architecture approach to the program’s data website consolidation strategy, and guide its execution once approved.

  • Ensure every new data page launches with complete supporting documentation, including plain-language descriptions, methodology documents, and data dictionaries.

  • Coach data owners across the agency on content standards and review their submissions before public release, supporting at least 10 new data product releases per year.

  • Contribute to help desk FAQs, user guides, release notes, and other user-facing communications.

  • Use user research, help desk trends, and analytics to identify content gaps and translate findings into user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, Program Increment planning, demos, and retrospectives, and keep content standards current in Confluence.

  • Ensure all content meets Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA requirements and maintain human oversight of any AI-assisted content.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • BA in Communications, English, Information Science, Library Science, Journalism, or a related field.

  • At least 10 years of experience in content strategy.

  • At least 5 years of experience creating content guidelines and taxonomy planning for public-facing data websites.

  • Experience with federal content migration projects.

  • Experience working in agile delivery teams, using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong plain-language writing and editing skills for audiences with very different levels of data fluency.

  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards (Section 508/WCAG 2.1 AA) for web content and documents.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with federal health programs or health data.

  • Experience consolidating multiple websites into a single platform.

  • Familiarity with open data metadata standards such as DCAT-US 1.1, and with data dictionaries and methodology documentation.

  • Experience authoring and governing content in Drupal.

  • Familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System, agency design systems, and the Digital Services Playbook.

  • Experience working alongside user researchers, including on studies subject to the Paperwork Reduction Act.

  • Master’s degree in a related field.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.

You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

  • Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

  • Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

  • Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

  • Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

  • System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM or Multi-Modal pre-training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.

  • Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.

  • Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.

  • Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join the People Helping People

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.

The Opportunity:

The Client Delivery Program Manager will work closely with senior leadership across Velera’s enterprise in addition to the assigned financial institution (FI) to develop and execute on the client’s strategic plans and provide centralized oversight of the implementation of initiatives within the program. The position oversees the FI program consisting of project and product implementations while partnering very closely with Client Growth Management, Client Service Delivery and Project Delivery teams. This role requires very strong influencing and client facing skills and requires travel to FI and their vendor locations as needed. Incumbent will support and foster in-depth and productive client relationships while being an advocate for the FI within Velera with the goal to improve consultative service, promote use of products and services, oversee initiatives while achieving increased loyalty, endorsement and revenue. The incumbent will also serve as a consultant to senior leadership teams within Velera to build detailed resolution action plans while monitoring program risks, health and addressing project related issues.

Day in the Life:

Strategic Planning & Relationships

  • Strengthen top strategic relationships by identifying and managing FI program needs by supporting the development of a strategic roadmap having accountability for the delivery of FI Program initiatives

  • Consistently demonstrate strong client relationship management skills encompassing strategic planning, program management, solution delivery, new product delivery, issue resolution while ensuring regulatory compliance

  • Responsible for the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple programs and projects aligning Velera’s team to meet financial institution’s strategic goals and objectives.

  • Effectively develop and leverage partnerships with all Velera business units, vendors and partners to ensure client initiatives and projects are executed expeditiously to the client’s satisfaction including Mastercard, Visa, various software vendors, networks, Fiserv, FIS and other processors.

Program Management

  • Accountable for resolution management communication and successful delivery of projects and initiatives ranging from the basic to the complex: card processing implementations, product implementation, strategic initiatives, and client initiatives

  • Serve as management point of contact for FI for project related items and escalated issue resolution

  • Lead and/or participate in assigned projects including cross-functional teams in support of Velera, business unit, and/or department goals and objectives.

  • Utilize relationships with FI, vendors and partners to leverage and ensure expedient and quality solutions and issue resolution

Professional Services and Consultation

  • Possess a deep knowledge of partner organizations and platforms and be able to translate that skill into action to benefit client relationships

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking an Oracle Identity & Access Management Engineer supporting Hosting, Operations and Maintenance (HOM) services for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Healthcare Integrated General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) program.


HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Functional administration and maintenance of our 12c Oracle Identity Management application including Oracle Access Manager (OAM), Oracle Internet Directory (OID), and Oracle Identity Governance (OIG).
  • Provide support to and participate in IAM continuous monitoring activities including monitoring new and removed identities, access and permissions changes, privilege escalation, bot activity, and other related activities.
  • Support user access provisioning, authentication, and access management processes.
  • Actively participate in troubleshooting sessions for OIG/OAM in Prod and Non-Prod.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs) and configuration guides.
  • Having a strong affinity toward security-oriented practices – including coding, to avoid creating vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with technical subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure technical and operational security controls are operating as expected.

REQUIREMENTS / EXPERIENCE FOR SUCCESS:

  • 5+ years’ experience in the Identity & Access Management domain.
  • Expertise in implementing, maintaining, and migrating OIG, OAM 12c components (WebLogic, OIM, SOA, BI, OAM, OAA, OARM), and OID 12c.
  • Strong Java coding skills with proficiency in OIG/OAM APIs (REST and Java APIs) for custom development of webpages, scheduled job deployments, automations.
  • Thorough understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Federation, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Entitlements, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Open Authorization (OAuth), etc.
  • Extensive exposure to SSO integrations – designing and implementing SSO solutions using OOTB and custom options with OAM or other Identity tools.
  • Strong knowledge of identity and access management, role- and attribute-based access controls (RBAC/ABAC), segregation of duties, least privilege, privilege escalation, etc.
  • Hands on development experience with Scheduled jobs, Adapters, Event handlers, Notifications, plugins and custom connectors (ICF/CI), web pages (for custom page development).
  • Ability to troubleshoot, identify and resolve issues related to OIG/OAM in Prod, non-prod environments.
  • Strong understanding of SQL queries – ability to write custom queries to support custom functionalities, create reports, resolve any issues with existing SQL objects.
  • Experience with BI Publisher reports creation/updates/migration/maintenance.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously, without impacting deadlines. It is critical for you to be a highly motivated contributor who can track items to completion without constant reminders.
  • Experience with LDAP directories (like OID, AD, etc.) and LDAP queries, and an ability to troubleshoot & resolve any issues (data or otherwise).
  • Experience with BI Publisher reports creation/updates/migration/maintenance.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability and comfort level to conduct presentations for existing customer audiences.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Upgrade experience from FMW 12c to 14c
  • Knowledge of WebAuthn / FIDO2, device-level signaling, and other relevant Zero Trust identity functions.
  • Relevant identity and access management certifications (e.g., CIAM, CIGE, etc.).
  • Hands-on implementation experience with Oracle Access Manager (OAM) 12c - incl. WebGate config/deployment and SAML, OIDC, OAUTH protocols.
  • Experience in addressing audit requirements – specifically related to Certifications, user operations, access grants, request approvals, etc.
  • Knowledge of Splunk, including the ability to independently investigate any logs for relevant issues.

CERTIFICATIONS (strongly preferred):

  • CISSP
  • CISA
  • CISM
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Technology specific certifications

.
