CLEARANCE: Ability to pass CMS background check and meet the residency requirement for having resided in the US at least (3) three out of the last (5) five years.

raw.description:
Large Ticket - Credit Analyst - Equipment Finance - Remote

Altius Search Group is recruiting a Large Ticket - Credit Analyst for an established national equipment finance company. This remote position will underwrite commercial borrowers and equipment finance transactions, prepare well-supported credit recommendations, and partner with sales, operations, documentation, and credit leadership throughout the approval process.

Direct commercial equipment finance underwriting experience is required. Candidates without prior underwriting experience in the equipment finance industry will not be considered. General commercial lending, banking, consumer finance, accounts receivable, or leasing experience without direct equipment finance underwriting experience does not meet the requirements for this position.

The ideal candidate will have three to seven years of direct equipment finance underwriting experience and the ability to independently manage assigned transactions while appropriately escalating complex structures, policy exceptions, and higher-risk issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite commercial equipment finance transactions by analyzing financial statements, tax returns, cash flow, credit reports, bank information, collateral, guarantor support, and repayment capacity.

  • Evaluate equipment loans, finance leases, capital leases, operating leases, sale-leaseback transactions, vendor finance programs, and other commercial equipment finance structures.

  • Assess equipment values, collateral quality, advance rates, proposed terms, transaction structure, industry conditions, borrower strength, and concentration exposure.

  • Identify material credit risks, policy exceptions, documentation concerns, and appropriate structural or financial mitigants.

  • Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported credit memoranda and approval recommendations for new transactions, renewals, amendments, and other credit requests.

  • Present transactions and respond to questions from senior credit leadership or the credit committee as needed.

  • Collaborate with sales, operations, documentation, asset management, and credit leadership to obtain required information and move qualified transactions efficiently through the approval process.

  • Maintain complete and accurate credit files, approval conditions, workflow status, and supporting documentation.

  • Monitor assigned transactions for adverse trends, emerging risks, missing information, and unresolved approval conditions.

  • Communicate credit concerns promptly and exercise sound independent judgment within established policies and approval guidelines.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Three to seven years of direct commercial equipment finance underwriting experience.

  • Prior underwriting experience in the equipment finance industry is required.

  • Candidates without direct equipment finance underwriting experience will not be considered.

  • Demonstrated experience underwriting commercial equipment loans, leases, or other equipment finance transactions.

  • Strong financial statement, cash flow, liquidity, leverage, collateral, and repayment-capacity analysis skills.

  • Experience evaluating equipment values, advance rates, transaction terms, guarantor support, and repayment risk.

  • Demonstrated ability to prepare concise, accurate, and well-supported credit memoranda and underwriting recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of commercial equipment finance structures, collateral considerations, documentation requirements, and credit policies.

  • Ability to manage multiple transactions independently, meet service expectations, and escalate complex or higher-risk matters appropriately.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with sales, operations, documentation, asset management, and credit partners.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and commercial credit or portfolio management systems.

  • Ability to work remotely from within the United States during required business hours.

Education

A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent direct commercial equipment finance underwriting experience may be considered.

Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate

  • Consistent, accurate, and timely commercial equipment finance credit analysis.

  • Credit recommendations that clearly explain repayment capacity, transaction structure, risks, mitigants, and approval conditions.

  • Strong ownership of assigned workflow with limited rework or avoidable delays.

  • The ability to balance business objectives with independent credit judgment.

  • Demonstrated experience underwriting commercial equipment finance transactions rather than only general commercial credit, banking relationships, or portfolio management.

  • Clear communication with internal partners and timely escalation of material credit concerns.

  • Sound judgment when evaluating complex structures, policy exceptions, collateral issues, and higher-risk borrowers.

Compensation

The estimated base salary range is $90,000–$105,000, depending on experience and qualifications.

raw.description:
A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You'll own implementation projects end to end — from kickoff through go-live and a documented handoff to Customer Support — because a smooth start is how customers come to trust us with their mission-critical work
  • You'll build project plans, timelines, and resource allocations from customer requirements, and stay ahead of risks, issues, and dependencies before they become blockers
  • You'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers during implementation, leading workshops, discovery sessions, and requirements conversations that start with questions before solutions
  • You'll keep customers and internal teams aligned through clear, consistent status reporting, executive-level steering committee materials, and honest conversations about scope and priorities
  • You'll coordinate internal technical resources, consultants, solution architects, engineers, and customer stakeholders to deliver on time and clear blockers quickly
  • You'll oversee data migration, integrations, and user acceptance testing, confirming that configured solutions meet customer business needs and follow best practices and our implementation methodologies
  • You'll partner with Sales and Digital Transformation during pre-sales cycles on scoping, estimating, and proposal development, and bring customer feedback back to Sales, Product, and Support
  • You'll help us get better as we go by improving implementation methodologies, templates, and playbooks, and finding ways to make delivery more efficient and scalable
  • Other duties as assigned
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 3–7+ years of project management experience, ideally within SaaS, software implementation, or IT services
  • Strong understanding of SaaS delivery models, data migration, integrations, and cloud technologies
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects
  • Experience translating business requirements into actionable technical tasks
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the country where this role is based

Preferred

  • PMP, CSM, PRINCE2, or other project management certification
  • Prior experience in a Professional Services or Customer Success organization
  • Familiarity with API integrations and data mapping concepts
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS software (e.g., CRM, ERP, HRIS, security, analytics)
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
  • Productive Collaboration: Works hand in hand with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Sales through clear plans and clean handoffs, and runs workshops and steering conversations where every stakeholder is heard and the work keeps moving together
  • Service Orientation: Treats a customer's go-live as the moment their mission gets stronger — listens before recommending, explains technical concepts in clear business terms, and sets honest expectations on scope and priorities
  • Adaptive Achievement: Keeps several implementations on track and on quality as priorities and requirements shift, flags risks early, and follows through to go-live even when the path changes
  • Business Insight: Understands how adoption, customer satisfaction, and a healthy transition to Customer Success connect to Foundant's success, and how foundations, grantmakers, and nonprofits use our software to drive impact
  • Active Learning: Stays current on the platform, integration and data migration practices, and the philanthropic sector, and turns customer and colleague feedback into better playbooks
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the communication industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential and thrive in this new world.

Competitive and Market Intelligence Manager


Calix is seeking a highly motivated Competitive andMarket Intelligence Manager to serve as the primary competitive intelligence partner to the sales organization. This highly visible, high-impact role is responsible for transforming competitive, market, and customer insights into actionable sales strategies that improve competitive win rates and accelerate revenue growth.


As the face of Market Intelligence for Sales, this individual will act as the critical link between market intelligence and sales execution. The successful candidate will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product Management, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to help Calix anticipate competitive threats, identify market opportunities, and win against key competitors.


A key objective this role serves as the voice of the field into the company while providing a feedback loop actionable positioning and battlecard back out to the field and tracking success. The successful candidate will own Calix's competitive Win/Loss program, provide strategic guidance on key opportunities, and ensure competitive insights are translated into actions that improve sales effectiveness and business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Sales-Facing Competitive Positioning Strategy

  • Serve as the primary competitive intelligence advisor to the Calix sales organization.
  • Develop competitive sales plays, talking points, objection handling guidance, differentiation frameworks, and deal-specific win strategies.
  • Partner with account teams on strategic opportunities and provide actionable recommendations that improve win rates.
  • Identify competitive threats, market shifts, and emerging industry trends and communicate business implications to sales leadership.
  • Help shape sales strategies that strengthen Calix's competitive position and accelerate growth.
  • Automate timely content delivery to the field at the point of need, track usage and success metrics for impact and improvement.

Win/Loss Program Leadership

  • Own and evolve Calix's competitive Win/Loss program.
  • Develop and implement a systematic process for capturing, analyzing, and communicating competitive outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, and Customer Success to identify the root causes of wins, losses, no-decisions, and competitive displacements.
  • Translate Win/Loss findings into actionable recommendations that improve sales execution, product strategy, messaging, and go-to-market effectiveness.
  • Measure and communicate competitive performance against key competitors and market segments.
  • Identify recurring competitive strengths, weaknesses, objections, and buying criteria that influence purchasing decisions.

Competitive Intelligence & Market Analysis

  • Monitor competitor products, pricing, partnerships, acquisitions, go-to-market strategies, and industry developments.
  • Conduct market, customer, competitor, and opportunity research to uncover actionable insights.
  • Analyze information from multiple sources and synthesize findings into concise, executive-ready recommendations.
  • Deliver intelligence that influences sales strategy, product direction, and business planning.

Sales Enablement & Training

  • Create and maintain battlecards, competitive briefs, executive updates, opportunity guides, and sales playbooks through a seamless delivery anticipating then needs before requested.
  • Design and facilitate engaging training sessions for sales teams, sales engineers, and customer-facing teams.
  • Enable the field to confidently position Calix and effectively respond to competitive challenges and effectively position to every role in the customer C-Suite.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement to embed market differentiation into onboarding and ongoing education programs.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership.
  • Establish scalable processes for gathering, analyzing, and distributing market intelligence.
  • Drive a culture of differentiated value, business outcomes across the organization.

Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Market Intelligence, Competitive Intelligence, Sales Strategy, Corporate Strategy, Product Management, or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of technology markets, telecommunications, networking, broadband, SaaS, or cloud-based solutions.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of business impact analysis
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience developing competitive positioning, sales messaging, and field enablement content.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive alignment without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting direct and channel sales organizations.
  • Experience leading or supporting formal Win/Loss programs.
  • Experience conducting customer interviews, opportunity reviews, competitive deal analysis, and sales feedback sessions.
  • Knowledge of broadband, managed Wi-Fi, subscriber experience platforms, cloud services, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, and intelligence platforms to scale competitive programs.

New Client Pricing

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About the role

We are hiring an RFP Analyst in India, within Embrace Shared Services (ESS), to find, sort and track US government RFPs and RFIs for Fairfax Software. Fairfax sells payment processing, document capture and AI document processing to state and local government.

Over the last three years our feeds carried about 850 open solicitations in and around our space. About 60% were out of scope. Roughly 45 a year fit our core products and another 65 are adjacent. We plan to bid 22 in 2027, about double today.

The job is to make sure none of the good ones are missed, and that each reaches the Bid Manager early, tagged and ranked. The work starts with Fairfax. Over time the same approach will cover other Embrace companies that sell to US government.

What you'll do
  • Watch the market every day.Monitor GovSpend, BidNet, state and county procurement portals, and agency notices for RFPs, RFIs, pre-solicitations, sole-source notices and contract renewals.
  • Match opportunities to what we sell.Read each solicitation's scope and requirements and tag it by product fit (core, adjacent, out of scope), state, agency and department type: state revenue, county treasurer and clerk, state agency, city, court.
  • Keep the keyword library current.Maintain the terms we use to find and score opportunities, and tune them as you see what we miss and what we bid on.
  • Keep one clean master list.Every record has agency, solicitation number, issue date, due date, Q&A deadline, value if known, and a link to the documents. No duplicates.
  • Track contract expirations.Build the calendar of incumbent contracts coming up for renewal or rebid, so we see opportunities 12–24 months before the RFP.
  • Prepare the weekly bid/no-bid list.A short, ranked list of new opportunities with a one-paragraph summary of each, ready for the weekly bid/no-bid meeting.
  • Record what happens.For every bid, log the outcome, the winner, the award value and the reason for a loss where it can be found.


Requirements

  • 2–5 years in research or analysis, ideally on US RFPs, bid tracking, or market research for US clients.
  • Strong reading of long documents.You can go through a 150-page solicitation and pull out scope, requirements, dates and deal-breakers quickly and accurately.
  • Good with data.Advanced Excel or Google Sheets. You keep lists clean and consistent without being asked.
  • Comfortable with AI toolsfor search, summarizing and classification, and careful enough to check what they produce.
  • Clear written English.Your summaries are short and plain.
  • Willing to work part of your day on US Eastern timeso you can join the weekly bid/no-bid meeting and answer questions the same day.

Nice to have: experience with GovSpend, BidNet or similar US bid databases, and some understanding of how US state and local government buys.

Who this role is for

You might be a research analyst at a market-research or KPO firm serving US clients, a bid-tracking analyst at a proposal services company, or a data analyst who wants to move into sales and government work.

This is an analysis role. You don't need to know payments or government tax systems on day one; we will teach the products. You do need to be precise, fast and curious about why we win or lose.

It is also not a proposal-writing role. Proposal writers answer the RFP once we decide to bid. You decide which RFPs we see in the first place.

Proposal writer

RFP Analyst at Fairfax

Core job

Write the response to an RFP we are bidding

Find, tag and rank RFPs and RFIs before we decide to bid

Starting point

A chosen RFP

Every solicitation in the market

Output

A submitted proposal

A clean master list and a weekly ranked shortlist

Measured on

Quality and on-time submission

Nothing good missed; records complete; outcomes logged

Skill that matters

Persuasive writing

Careful reading, classification and data discipline

Career path

Senior proposal manager

Senior analyst, Bid Manager, capture

Reporting and how success is measured

You work within ESS and report to the Bid Manager, who takes your shortlist to the bid/no-bid decision. You do the research behind those decisions.

  • Nothing good missed.No core-fit RFP in our segments that we find out about too late to bid.
  • New opportunities triaged within two business daysof being posted.
  • Complete records.Every opportunity on the master list has its solicitation number, dates, agency and fit tag.
  • Weekly shortlist delivered on time, every week, ready for the bid/no-bid meeting.
  • Every bid's outcome logged, so we know our real win rate and why we lose.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team within a remote work setting.

raw.description:
About the Company

Our client is an Australian legal services group of around 55 people, including an existing and well-integrated offshore team, trading as two boutique law firm brands. One brand relies on a constant pipeline of new leads, while the other relies on staying in touch with existing clients and referral partners, and an internal program of staff engagement, quarterly themes and events runs across both. An external agency now sets the marketing strategy, SEO and paid media, so the client needs a dedicated Marketing Coordinator to own the day-to-day execution: designer, publisher and campaign builder in one. This is a newly created full-time position, established to maintain continuity of marketing delivery across both brands.

About the Role

  • This is an execution-focused role. The agency handles strategy, targeting and messaging, and the Marketing Coordinator works from approved strategy, briefs and messaging to turn them into graphics, website updates, email campaigns and internal communications across both brands. The role is weighted towards creative design and content production, with graphics, communications, website updates and email execution making up the bulk of the work. Both brands are supported equally and concurrently.

  • The role is a designer, publisher and campaign builder in one: creating graphics in Canva and AI tools, publishing on both WordPress sites, building email campaigns in a template-based platform, and supporting social content, events and internal communications.

  • Design is the most important skill. The Marketing Coordinator receives a clear brief and direction and is trusted to bring it to life with strong layout, creativity and attention to detail. Brand kits, colour palettes and Canva templates are already established for both brands, so the work builds on existing assets rather than starting from a blank page.

  • The role makes a real contribution to internal culture. Each quarter the firms launch a new internal theme, supported by posters, communications and presentation slides. Planning takes place in December for an early January launch, so the work is fast paced. External materials follow strict brand standards, while internal content is expected to be creative, engaging and fun.

  • The workload is project and event driven rather than a fixed daily routine. For example, a new team member joining triggers a series of tasks such as photography, website updates and email campaigns. As a guide, the websites are updated at least weekly, each website publishes at least one article a month, and each brand sends one to two email campaigns a month.

  • Attention to detail is essential in a legal brand. Every piece goes through quality checks in Australian English, with a test sent before anything goes out, and all new or materially changed content (including website landing pages, service pages, articles, EDMs and downloadable resources) must be approved by a Senior Solicitor for accuracy and compliance before publication.

  • The Marketing Coordinator works closely with the Sales & Marketing Manager, including a short team huddle each morning and close support during the first six months. A structured onboarding is provided, supported by a handover from the existing team member, documented processes, training videos and recorded walkthroughs.

  • The client values great communication, aptitude and enthusiasm, together with confidence, curiosity and a personable, engaging style that fits a close-knit team. The email platform and the client's custom template blocks can be learned, so a positive attitude and willingness to learn matter as much as tool experience.

  • SEO strategy and paid media remain with the external agency, and major website development is not a core task. The Marketing Coordinator supports on-page SEO and generative engine optimisation (GEO) within the website and content work, and supports the agency relationship by coordinating briefs, assets and approvals with the Sales & Marketing Manager.

  • This is a home-based role, like the client's existing offshore team. Software licences the role logs into, such as Canva and the email platform, are issued by the client.

Primary Purpose

To execute the firm's marketing accurately and consistently across both brands and the internal program, turning approved briefs into creative, on-brand graphics, website updates, email campaigns and communications, with every piece checked and approved before it goes out, so that the Sales & Marketing Manager and the agency can focus on strategy and growth.

Key Responsibilities

    Design & Creative (Canva and AI Tools)

    • Create graphics in Canva and AI tools from ideas and briefs, for social media, LinkedIn job ads, banners, invitations and email, using approved brand standards

    • Design the quarterly theme campaign and its materials, including posters, internal communications and presentation slides, bringing a creative and engaging style to internal content

    • Design or update promotional materials, including pull-up banners, flags, signage and event collateral, and client and firm collateral

    • Create presentation slides, quarterly campaign materials and internal visual assets (Canva and PowerPoint)

    • Apply each brand's established kit, templates and colours consistently, while meeting deadlines that are agreed transparently with the Sales & Marketing Manager

    • Use AI tools responsibly to speed up creative and content work, without putting confidential client information into public tools. The marketing team uses ChatGPT projects (set up for each firm) and Microsoft Copilot to generate draft communications, which are reviewed and refined before use

      • Website Publishing (WordPress)

      • Publish and update content on both WordPress websites (custom, block-template sites), including articles, page updates, service pages, forms and landing pages, and select images, with updates at least weekly and an article on each site at least monthly

      • Keep staff profiles and page structures consistent across the sites

      • Implement directed website UX, conversion pathway and digital positioning improvements

      • Support on-page SEO and GEO optimisation of site content, in coordination with the agency

      • Implement approved marketing-related changes across booking, CRM, payment and digital platforms (for example Microsoft Bookings, Clio Grow, Stripe and Zapier), coordinating with the Sales & Marketing Manager

        • Email Marketing, CRM & Automation

        • Build email campaigns in the email platform (Ortto) from approved content and existing template blocks, then test, schedule and send to the right audience, at least once a month and up to twice a month for each brand

        • Execute automated email journeys, forms, integrations, audience segmentation and lead nurturing

        • Maintain segmented mailing lists and CRM data (Clio Grow), keeping segmentation and contact records accurate

        • Manage marketing systems and automated workflows (Ortto, Clio Grow and Zapier), working within approved workflows and change controls

          • Internal Communications & Social

          • Deliver internal communications, including quarterly themes, staff engagement activities, event invitations and company events

          • Create social content, including posting event and team photos, and schedule approved posts (Loomly)

          • Publish approved vacancies and promote open roles, including LinkedIn job ads

            • Events & Referral Partners

            • Create event invitations and execute approved event communications for referral partner and client events, from invitations to promotion and post-event follow-up

            • Coordinate event promotion across email, social, website and referral channels

            • Coordinate branded merchandise and promotional items with internal stakeholders and suppliers

              • Agency Support, Reporting & Strategy Support

              • Support the agency relationship by coordinating briefs, assets and approvals with the Sales & Marketing Manager

              • Maintain and update monthly and quarterly marketing reporting frameworks, aligned to business strategy and management objectives

              • Support implementation of brand positioning and business strategy across digital channels and client touchpoints, and implement agreed marketing priorities and initiatives

                • Quality & Compliance

                • Carry out quality checks on every piece, in Australian English, with a test send before anything goes out

                • Make sure all new or materially changed content has Senior Solicitor approval before it is published or sent, and only publish approved content

                  • Communication & Collaboration

                  • Take part in the daily team huddle, contribute to discussions and ask questions to understand priorities and the reasons behind them

                  • Respond promptly on email and Teams, and flag deadlines, conflicts or blockers early

                  • Work comfortably across both brands and across the wider team, including colleagues in other offices

                    • Hours & Location

                  • Remote, home based. Full-time, 8:30 am to 5:00 pm Australian Eastern time with a lunch break from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm, working agreed Australian business hours and following the Australian public holiday calendar

                  • Reliable internet, backup internet, power backup and a suitable workspace required, with the home setup checked before starting

What Success Looks Like

  • Create engaging, on-brand graphics, banners, invitations and presentations, delivered on time.

  • Keep both WordPress websites accurate, updated and consistent.

  • Build and deliver email campaigns with proper testing and attention to detail.

  • Maintain accurate mailing lists, CRM records and marketing workflows.

  • Deliver internal communications, social content and event materials on schedule.

  • Work closely with the Sales & Marketing Manager and external agency to keep marketing activities running smoothly.

  • Communicate proactively, manage priorities and contribute positively to the team.

Must-have (essential)

  • Strong Canva design skills, able to turn briefs and ideas into on-brand graphics for social media, LinkedIn job ads, banners, event invitations, presentations and print collateral, supported by a design portfolio that shows creative and conceptual ability (required at application)

  • Genuine design and conceptual skill, with the ability to take a brief and create something creative and engaging, rather than relying on AI-generated output

  • Hands-on WordPress experience publishing and updating articles, pages and staff profiles, selecting images, and keeping page structures consistent (WordPress is essential)

  • Experience with template-based email marketing platforms (Ortto, or similar such as HubSpot, ActiveCampaign or Mailchimp), building campaigns from approved content and existing template blocks, then testing, scheduling and sending to the right audience

  • Strong written English, with excellent editing and proofreading in Australian English

  • Exceptional attention to detail: quality checks on every piece, a test send before anything goes out, and accurate links, forms and audiences

  • Able to work within a content approval process, where new or materially changed content is approved by a Senior Solicitor before publication

  • Hands-on marketing coordination or digital marketing experience (3+ years is ideal), working from approved strategy and briefs

  • Great communication, aptitude and enthusiasm, with a willingness to learn new tools and custom templates, and the confidence to contribute, ask questions and engage with the team

  • Available full-time on the fixed hours (8:30 am to 5:00 pm Australian Eastern time) and the Australian public holiday calendar, with reliable internet, backup internet, power backup and a suitable home workspace

Nice-to-have (preferred)

  • Strong preference: SEO and GEO experience, supporting the optimisation of website content and performance

  • Strong preference: practical experience using AI tools (including AI image tools and AI-assisted writing, such as ChatGPT projects and Microsoft Copilot) to speed up design and content work, used responsibly with confidential data

  • Strong preference: automation experience, such as marketing automation journeys and workflow tools like Zapier that connect forms, CRM and email

  • Strong preference: marketing experience in legal or professional services, or another approval-led, regulated industry

  • Experience supporting Australian clients or businesses

  • Formal design training or a relevant qualification is valued but not prescriptive. Hands-on experience and the quality of your work matter most.

  • CRM and mailing list management (Clio Grow or similar), and social scheduling (Loomly or similar)

  • Event marketing, including invitations, promotion and post-event follow-up, and recruitment marketing such as LinkedIn job ads

  • Experience with Ortto, Clio Grow, Loomly and Zapier specifically (equivalent platforms are accepted)

  • Familiarity with PowerPoint, Microsoft Bookings, Stripe and Google Analytics or similar reporting tools

How to Apply

    Please submit a CV along with a short cover note outlining your years of marketing coordination experience, whether you have worked with Australian clients, the platforms you have used (Canva, WordPress and an email marketing platform), and your availability for full-time work on the fixed Australian Eastern hours (8:30 am to 5:00 pm), including your notice period and earliest start date. A design portfolio is required: please include links to a selection of your creative work, such as social media creatives, posters, presentation slides, LinkedIn posts, Canva designs, web pages and email campaigns. If you have used AI tools, SEO or GEO techniques, or automation to save time or create content, include a brief example. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to progress to the next stage of the process.

raw.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Communication Agents for Freight & Logistics
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead HawkAI, an enterprise AI venture for US logistics brokerages, carriers, and warehouse operators.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead HawkAI, an enterprise AI venture for US logistics brokerages, carriers, and warehouse operators. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

HawkAIdeploys always-on, multi-channel "AI workers" that autonomously manage high-volume freight communications across calls, texts, and emails, integrating directly with core freight systems including TMS, load boards, and broker/carrier databases. The platform handles track-and-trace calls, appointment scheduling, carrier rate negotiation, proof-of-delivery capture, and shipment status updates end-to-end — autonomously resolving 90%+ of routine communications and escalating only exceptions to human staff. Rather than another point tool layered on top of existing systems, HawkAI is designed to operate as the always-on communication layer for logistics teams, enabling them to focus on exceptions and value-driving work.

We are now seeking the founder to lead the venture from here.

Market Context

  • The US logistics BPO market for outsourced communications is approximately $26B, representing a major automation opportunity in a labour-intensive industry

  • Approximately 150,000 US freight forwarders, 3PLs, and warehouses form the target market, with tiered subscription pricing yielding a $1.5B annual TAM

  • Mid-sized US brokerages handle thousands of daily calls, with staff unable to answer or follow up on every transaction, contributing to OTIF (On Time/In Full) penalties and costly delays

  • Early customers deploying AI communication assistants report approximately 33% lower operating costs and significantly faster call resolution

  • AI supply chain software is growing at approximately 23% CAGR globally from 2025–2031, with North America seeing 30–45% annual growth in AI-driven logistics spend

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning across freight brokerages, 3PLs, carriers, and warehouse operators

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with mid-sized to enterprise freight brokerages, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion targeting Heads of Logistics, Supply Chain, and Operations

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback, with a focus on TMS and load board integrations, conversational AI quality, and autonomous workflow execution

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to logistics, supply chain, freight brokerage, transportation, or B2B enterprise software serving these industries, with familiarity in AI agents/LLMs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
Job Title: Cyber Security Manager
Employment Type: Full-time | Permanent | Remote
Location: We welcome applications from candidates across Bulgaria for this fully remote role.Please note that you will need to have the right to work in the Bulgaria, as we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship.
WE ARE ZIGZAG - THE WORLD’S MOST CONNECTED ​POST-PURCHASE AND RETURNS NETWORK
We are an award-winning eCommerce returns and post purchase specialist, founded in 2015.

With over 250 team members across the UK, Bulgaria, France, Portugal, Germany, and Spain, we are continually innovating the after-checkout experience for our retailers by reducing cost and complexity, driving sustainability, and fostering customer loyalty.

Today, our SaaS platform provides access to over 3,000 carrier lanes across 170 countries, supporting more 1,100 retailers including our leading enterprise and logistics clients The Very Group, New Look, Boden, Selfridges, Sports Direct, The Hut Group, Swarovski, L’Occitane, Photobox, Carrefour, Lands’ End and DHL.

We were the experts in returns. Now we are the experts in the whole post-purchase experience!
👉 Discover more:

OUR CULTURE AND VALUESOur culture is built on three core values, Start-up Spirit, Human Heart, and a Grown-up Mindset which guide how we collaborate and make decisions.
It isn’t something written on posters – it’s something we bring to life every day through our actions, our relationships, and how we show up for each other and our customers.
Everyone plays a role in shaping our culture through how we communicate, support one another, and celebrate success. Being a ZigZagger means taking ownership, bringing curiosity and energy to everything you do, showing resilience when challenges arise, and leading with care by putting “we before me.” You’ll use sound judgment, stay open to new perspectives, and continuously look for ways to learn, grow, and improve.

About the Role

As our Cyber Security Manager & Data Protection Officer (DPO), you will lead and strengthen security, privacy, and compliance across our SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, and wider technology environment.
You will develop and deliver security and data protection strategies, manage cyber and privacy risks, ensure compliance with GDPR and industry standards, and protect both company and customer data. Working closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, IT, Legal, and business leaders, you will champion security and privacy-by-design principles, drive best practice, and promote a strong culture of security awareness.
As the designated DPO, you will oversee data protection governance, provide expert GDPR guidance, and act as the key contact for privacy-related matters. This is a hands-on role combining strategic leadership with operational delivery, helping to safeguard the business, maintain customer trust, and support continued growth.
Core Responsibilities

Security Operations, Threat Detection & Incident Response
  • Detect Attacks: Take a hands-on role in monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to cyber threats and security incidents affecting the organisation.
  • Investigate Attacks: Investigate security alerts, suspicious activity, attempted intrusions, compromised accounts, and potential breaches.
  • Prevent Attacks: Proactively identify and address security weaknesses through security assessments, hardening activities, and the implementation of appropriate technical controls.
  • Respond to Breaches: Lead and coordinate the investigation and response to security incidents, including ransomware, phishing, credential theft, unauthorised access, account takeover, malicious API activity, and cloud infrastructure compromise. Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive remediation activities to strengthen security resilience.
  • Manage Vulnerabilities: Lead vulnerability management activities, ensuring risks are identified, prioritised, remediated, and tracked to completion.
  • Implement and manage security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities using technologies such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud-native security monitoring, and other security tools.
  • Analyse security logs, network activity, endpoint telemetry, and cloud events to identify indicators of compromise and potential attacks.
  • Develop and maintain security detection rules, alerting capabilities, and automated security controls.
  • Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Product teams to secure applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and business systems.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting activities to identify suspicious behaviour, indicators of compromise, and emerging threats that may not trigger automated alerts.
  • Manage relationships with external security providers, auditors, and incident response partners when specialist support is required.
  • Improve Resilience: Ensure security incidents and assessments result in measurable improvements to controls, monitoring, and overall security resilience.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Own and maintain the organisation's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Maintain the information security risk register and conduct organisation-wide security risk assessments.
  • Develop and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Report on security posture, risks, incidents, and improvement initiatives to senior stakeholders.
  • Ensure security and privacy requirements are embedded into business projects, products, and technology initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities.
  • Oversee supplier and third-party security assurance activities.
Compliance & Audit
  • Lead and maintain compliance with recognised standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Manage internal and external security, compliance, and data protection audits, ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
  • Support customer security and privacy due diligence activities, including questionnaires, assessments, and audits.
  • Assess security and data protection risks associated with third-party suppliers and service providers.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory, security, and privacy requirements, ensuring policies, controls, and processes remain compliant and effective.
  • Champion a culture of security and privacy by design, embedding security and privacy requirements throughout the organisation.
Data Protection Officer (DPO)
  • Act as the organisation's appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO).
  • Oversee data protection governance, privacy compliance, Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and privacy risk management.
  • Manage data subject rights requests, privacy incidents, breach management, and regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for regulators, customers, and internal stakeholders on data protection and privacy matters.
  • Provide expert guidance on GDPR and wider privacy obligations across the business.
Training & Awareness
  • Develop and deliver security awareness and privacy training programmes.
  • Provide practical security guidance to technical and business teams.
  • Promote a security-first culture across the organisation.
Leadership
  • Lead and mentor security specialists or analysts where applicable.
  • Manage external security vendors and consultants.
  • Drive continuous improvement across security capabilities and processes.

Essential Technical Experience

The successful candidate must demonstrate:
  • Proven hands-on experience leading cyber security investigations, incident response activities, and risk-based decision-making during security incidents.
  • Experience implementing and managing Identity & Access Management (IAM) controls, including authentication, authorisation, privileged access, and identity governance.
  • Experience leading vulnerability management programmes, including risk assessment, remediation, and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of security architecture principles and secure-by-design approaches across SaaS and cloud environments.
  • Experience designing and maintaining network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, and secure connectivity.
  • Expertise in endpoint security, including EDR/XDR, device management, and threat protection.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM technologies, including log analysis, alert tuning, threat detection, and investigation.
  • Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into software development and deployment lifecycles.
  • Strong knowledge of application security, including secure coding, security testing, and secure SDLC practices.
  • Strong understanding of common cyber threats, attack techniques, threat actors, and exploitation methods.
  • Hands-on experience securing SaaS applications, APIs, authentication systems, and cloud environments, ideally within AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, Product, and business teams.
Qualifications (Desirable)
  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CCSP
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
  • Data protection qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection (PC.dp), or equivalent.

What We Offer

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus public holidays, with additional holiday entitlement awarded for each completed year of service (up to a maximum of six extra days). Plus, to celebrate you, enjoy an extra day off on your birthday.
  • Collaborative working environment
  • Remote or hybrid work options – remote working with possibility to work from our Varna office
  • Healthcare insurance with dental service included
  • Food vouchers ( €102.26 month per person)
👉Explore our full range of benefits here: ZigZag Bulgaria Social Benefits.pdf
If you are interested, please send your CV in English.

Equity, Inclusion & Transparency
In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to transparency and will share the salary range for this role prior to the interview stage.

A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging is a priority, and applications are welcomed from people of all backgrounds and experiences. Reflecting how we live our own values of meritocracy over hierarchy, even if not every requirement is met, interest in the role is encouraged.
Hiring focuses on people as well as skills—if this opportunity resonates, you’re encouraged to apply and bring your unique perspective.

raw.description:
Overview POSITION SUMMARY: The Senior Estimator position will generally lead large conceptual EPC bids where experience plays a vital role in developing a good estimate. Additionally, this position will be the lead Senior Estimator in a given industry/market. Senior Estimator will report to the Estimating Manager in their service line. This position will provide leadership and coordination to their given industry/market and will also be assigned to large projects with responsibility for all aspects of RFP requirements, winning proposal strategies, alternate contracting strategies and risk management. Company Overview MasTec Industrial is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) business segment. The CE&I segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our renewables, industrial, infrastructure, and general building operating groups. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #13 Transportation Contractor). Responsibilities ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: Listen to directions and suggestions from supervisors or other employees regarding safe and proper work practices, evaluate that information and implement a plan based on that evaluation for carrying out the duties of this position. Be motivated and work productively. Read and understand company policies and procedures and other literature and other documents applicable to assigned tasks. With regard to that portion of the work assigned, develop complete understanding of the applicable company policies and procedures and plan and execute the assigned work in accordance with those policies and procedures. Examine/inspect office conditions and/or procedures and identify problems, inaccuracies, and cost saving measures that arise or that may be encountered. Manages the work of direct report(s). Inspect their work for accuracy and compliance with company’s policies and procedures, point out deficiencies and explain and take any corrective action needed. Responsible for hiring, firing, performance appraisals, and pay reviews for direct reports Produce quality work, meeting requirements of the company policies, procedures, and industry standards. Identify workplace hazards and take all necessary corrective action to eliminate or minimize them. Understand and respond appropriately to all safety hazards and warnings devices (i.e. back-up alarms, smell of smoke, different color warning tags, warning sirens). Provide leadership, coordination, and guidance to other Estimators (I, II, & III) in their assigned industry or market. Lead strategic initiatives related to company, department or industry/market specific improvements. Work hours required to complete work assigned by established deadlines. Manage the available bid time to insure accurate and timely preparation of a complete estimate. Function as a team player; create an environment where other groups and individuals want to work with you. Perform complete conceptual estimates for large, complex EPC projects from receipt of bid package through final bid review, including site visits, scope determination, MTO, input data into computerized estimating systems, questions to Owner/Engineer and qualifications. Utilize ability and experience to conceptualize portions of estimate. Organize and detail the estimate so that manhours can be properly applied, easily understood for review purposes, and efficiently turned over to the field personnel. When representing MIC to clients, engineers, vendors, or competitors, always maintain the highest standards of professionalism, fairness, and ethical behavior. Through daily practice, carry out the spirit and intent MIC’s Company Beliefs Perform entire conceptual estimates for large EPC, design build, general construction, and joint venture projects from receipt of bid packages through proposal to Owner. Senior Estimator IIs have uniquely demonstrated an advanced knowledge of all aspects of Construction Estimating and consistently manage bid teams for large, complex projects. All Senior Level Estimators have the responsibility of training other employees in the estimating department. Responsibilities will include mastery of technical estimating responsibilities including lead responsibilities such as: Site visits and jobsite exposure Scope determination Input into estimating software Understanding RFQ requirements Questions to owner/engineer Written clarifications to owner/engineer/estimators Turnover of bid estimate to the field Responsibilities will include a mastery knowledge of discipline specific responsibilities including lead responsibilities such as: Material Take Offs Comprehension of drawings and specifications Manhour analysis Understanding of material pricing Understanding of subcontracts Understanding of strategies and variables Understanding range of manhours Providing field assistance Standard coding support Lead Estimator Designation: When the Senior Estimator is designated as the Lead Estimator on an estimate, the following additional responsibilities will be required: Supervise and line out all people on the bid team, provide adequate information to team members and establish bidding schedule with deadlines. Assure successful kick off meetings, mid-bid reviews, and final reviews. Get the Regional VP of Operations involved if they are available. Review and understand owner provided specifications and documentation for all portions of the work and ensure the needed costs have been incorporated into the estimate. Perform final reviews at least two (2) days before bid due date. Review all work performed by team members. Critically analyze each aspect of the estimate to ensure a competitive bid. Apply appropriate labor rates and methods of construction based on provided information and expected site conditions. Explore options which could shorten the construction schedules and minimize indirect and construction equipment. Recognize risks and apply contingency and escalation when appropriate. Know when and how to capitalize on opportunities. Manage, lead direct reports, and mentor. SUPERVISORY: Must have the ability to manage, supervise, and lead multiple employees including an Estimator I, Estimator II, and Estimator III on bid pursuits. Qualifications EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: Bachalor degree or equivalent education and experience Minimum of 5-7 years of construction estimating experience Knowledge of construction techniques, estimating and construction management Knowledge of various contract types including EPC, DB and JV Experience in contract negotiations Experience in working with a variety of vendors and clients Experience in leading bids on a regular basis KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED: Be knowledgeable of MIC Health and Safety programs and project specific regulations. When on-site, actively participate in daily toolbox meetings with crews and subcontractors. Set a personal example of safe behavior. Other may duties may be assigned PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This position requires prolonged sitting at a desk and working at a computer. Must be able to lift up to 20 pounds at times. HOURS: This position is a standard full-time position, with general business 40-hour operating schedule, Monday-Friday. TRAVEL: Must be able to travel up to 10-25% of the time. What's in it for You Financial Wellbeing Compensation $145,000-$175,000 / year, commensurate with experience Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase 401(k) with company match & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Flexible spending account (Healthcare & Dependent care) Health & Wellness Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) - coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance, Weight Management Drug Discount Discounted National Gym Membership Network Family & Lifestyle Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave Military Leave, including Benefits Continuation Employee Assistance Program Planning for the Unexpected Short and long-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death & dismemberment Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage Emergency Travel Assistance Program Group legal plan Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need accommodation as part of the employment process, contact . Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up-to-date information. MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. Disclaimer: MasTec and our Subsidiaries will never ask prospective employees for any form of payment or money transfer as part of job application or onboarding. We do not ask prospective employees for information about credit cards or personal passwords, and it does not require applicants to purchase equipment or software. Ensure that all recruiter email addresses end in @mastec.com or @talent.icims.com. Welcome to Devlane! We are a dynamic software development company with a strong presence across Latin America. Currently, we specialize in offering staff augmentation services to clients worldwide, with a particular focus on North America.

Joining our team offers you the opportunity to shine and make a significant impact on the projects you work on. Many of our clients are modern small to medium-sized businesses experiencing rapid growth, and they're eager to add core members like you to their teams. This environment ensures you'll stay up-to-date with the latest technology trends.

At Devlane, our values are straightforward: we foster a collaborative environment and prioritize building long-lasting relationships where you can develop your skills as a software engineer and learn from your peers.

What's the role about?

  • Familiarity with standard frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to maintain and adjust internal tools, without needing to be a frontend expert.

raw.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineering Manager to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and career development for a team of software engineers.
  • Contribute toward the success of our Product organization which includes Engineering, Product Management, and Design. We operate in Pods of 2-4 engineers plus a Product Manager and Designer, and each Engineering Manager handles 2-3 such Pods.
    Pods work across the codebase to implement features, address shortcomings, and answer customer requests.
  • Provide technical direction in projects as needed, as well as growing the technical leadership capabilities of the engineers reporting to you.
  • Help in growing the organization: interviewing and recruiting, guiding the development of the engineering culture, developing processes as we grow.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Experience as a people manager: we are not yet at a size and level of maturity as an engineering org to provide the training and support for someone new in the management role.
  • Achieve significant business outcomes through cross-functional collaboration with product managers, data scientists, and designers
  • Help your team to improve their performance, the quality of their work; make major design decisions
  • Hire, nurture, and oversee a team of engineers while fostering an atmosphere of psychological well-being, embracing diversity and promoting inclusion.
  • Lead a team responsible for managing a critical production service, including operational concerns (monitoring, alerting, on call, etc)
  • Manage healthy conflict by moderating design discussions and cultivating a positive culture of feedback with candor and kindness
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams across the organization to complete complex projects spanning multiple technical domains
  • Drive planning across multiple time horizons, from immediate tactical needs to long-term strategic direction.

What We Are Looking For

  • Demonstrated leadership with substantial experience in managing and mentoring Engineering teams, including performance evaluations, career development, and fostering a collaborative work environment
  • Background building and operating production services with high availability and performance targets.
  • Expertise managing on call rotations and incident response
  • A highly technical manager, able to independently evaluate complex technical tradeoffs in design conversations while leaning on experts in the team for design and implementation
  • Experience developing in Go, used for much of the system
  • Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$206,000—$257,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

WebTPA, a GuideWell Company, is a healthcare third-party administrator with over 30+ years of experience building unique benefit solutions and managing customized health plans.

What is your impact?
As a Claim Examiner, you will handle processing and adjudication for healthcare claims. This will include claims research where applicable and a range of claim complexity.

What Will You Be Doing:

Vice President, Marketing
Confidential Executive Search
Location: 100% Remote — United States
Salary Range: $250,000–$340,000 annually

The Opportunity

An innovative organization is seeking an experienced Vice President of Marketing to lead its marketing and communications strategy through product commercialization and continued growth.

This executive will guide brand development, market positioning, audience engagement, product launch planning, and corporate communications. The role requires a leader who can establish strategic direction, execute priorities, and build a marketing function that supports measurable business results.

Reporting to commercial leadership, the Vice President will lead and develop an existing marketing team while partnering with colleagues across the organization.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Marketing will develop an integrated strategy for reaching both professional and consumer audiences. This includes defining target markets, shaping clear and credible messaging, selecting effective channels, and establishing measures of success.

Initial priorities will include strengthening market awareness, refining positioning, developing audience education strategies, and preparing for anticipated product introductions. As commercialization progresses, the role will expand the team and capabilities needed to support launch execution and sustained growth.

The Vice President will also oversee corporate communications, ensuring that organizational developments, research progress, publications, and partnerships are communicated clearly and consistently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an integrated marketing and communications strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Establish brand positioning that earns the trust of professional audiences while remaining accessible and relevant to consumers.
  • Define audience segments, messaging, channel strategies, and engagement plans.
  • Lead product launch planning, coordinating marketing readiness with product development and applicable regulatory milestones.
  • Build awareness and understanding of emerging products and their potential value.
  • Develop educational content and campaigns that support professional engagement and consumer demand.
  • Establish performance measures appropriate to each stage of development and commercialization.
  • Direct corporate messaging related to research, product development, publications, partnerships, and organizational progress.
  • Partner with executive leadership to translate business priorities into focused marketing plans.
  • Lead daily execution while maintaining accountability for strategic objectives.
  • Assess team capabilities, recruit additional talent as needed, and develop marketing professionals.
  • Identify opportunities to build awareness through compelling content, partnerships, and organic engagement.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline. MBA is highly preferred.
  • Experience building or substantially developing a marketing function.
  • A record of marketing effectively to both professional and consumer audiences.
  • Successful product launch experience, including the ability to apply lessons from previous launches.
  • Strong judgment in brand strategy, positioning, messaging, and creative execution.
  • The ability to translate complex information into clear, credible, and engaging communications.
  • Experience setting strategy with executive leadership while remaining actively involved in execution.
  • Success hiring, coaching, and developing marketing talent.
  • Comfort working through uncertainty, setting priorities, and establishing meaningful performance measures.
  • The ability to collaborate across disciplines and adapt plans as business needs evolve.

Preferred Experience

  • Marketing within healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
  • Building awareness and engagement without relying primarily on a substantial paid media budget.
  • Supporting commercialization within an emerging or evolving product category.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $250,000–$340,000 annually. The benefits package includes:

  • Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and dependents.
  • Home office equipment support.
  • Professional development funding.
  • Wellness support.
  • Unlimited vacation and paid holidays.
  • Equity participation through stock options.

Working Environment

The organization values thoughtful decision-making, collaboration, accountability, and clear communication. Leaders are expected to welcome different perspectives, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and balance ambitious goals with disciplined execution.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The employer is committed to equal employment opportunity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Career Category
